decisions.focus: Functional analysis and integration of metabolomics data

The paper presents a comprehensive update to the MetaboAnalyst platform, focusing on improving the integration and analysis of metabolomics data from raw spectra to functional insights. The key contributions include enhanced data processing pipelines, advanced functional analysis modules, and improved meta-analysis capabilities for global metabolomics datasets. These updates significantly lower the barriers to metabolomics analysis by providing user-friendly tools that streamline the workflow from raw data to biological interpretation. The improvements in parameter optimization, pathway enrichment analysis, and network-based integration represent substantive advancements in analytical methods for metabolomics.

classification_audit.abstract: Abstract Since its first release over a decade ago, the MetaboAnalyst web-based platform has become widely used for comprehensive metabolomics data analysis and interpretation. Here we introduce MetaboAnalyst version 5.0, aiming to narrow the gap from raw data to functional insights for global metabolomics based on high-resolution mass spectrometry (HRMS). Three modules have been developed to help achieve this goal, including: (i) a LC–MS Spectra Processing module which offers an easy-to-use pipeline that can perform automated parameter optimization and resumable analysis to significantly lower the barriers to LC-MS1 spectra processing; (ii) a Functional Analysis module which expands the previous MS Peaks to Pathways module to allow users to intuitively select any peak groups of interest and evaluate their enrichment of potential functions as defined by metabolic pathways and metabolite sets; (iii) a Functional Meta-Analysis module to combine multiple global metabolomics datasets obtained under complementary conditions or from similar studies to arrive at comprehensive functional insights. There are many other new functions including weighted joint-pathway analysis, data-driven network analysis, batch effect correction, merging technical replicates, improved compound name matching, etc. The web interface, graphics and underlying codebase have also been refactored to improve performance and user experience. At the end of an analysis session, users can now easily switch to other compatible modules for a more streamlined data analysis. MetaboAnalyst 5.0 is freely available at https://www.metaboanalyst.ca .

items.action:
MetaboAnalyst 5.0在代谢组学数据分析中扮演着重要角色，其主要目标是缩小从原始数据到功能洞察之间的差距。该版本引入了三个核心模块：LC-MS光谱处理模块、功能分析模块和功能元分析模块。其中，LC-MS光谱处理模块提供了易于使用的流程，能够自动优化参数并实现可恢复的分析，显著降低了LC-MS1光谱处理的门槛；功能分析模块扩展了之前的MS峰到通路模块，允许用户直观选择感兴趣的峰组，并评估其潜在功能的富集情况；功能元分析模块则结合来自互补条件或相似研究的多个全局代谢组学数据集，以获得全面的功能洞察。此外，该版本还包含许多新功能，如加权联合通路分析、数据驱动网络分析、批次效应校正、合并技术重复等。Web界面、图形和底层代码库也进行了重构，以提高性能和用户体验。在分析会话结束时，用户可以轻松切换到其他兼容模块，实现更流畅的数据分析。MetaboAnalyst 5.0是免费提供的，并且通过多个新功能提升了代谢组学数据的处理与解读能力。

MetaboAnalyst 5.0的工作流程涵盖了针对和非靶向代谢组学数据的分析。在适当的数据处理后，所有主要输入都可以在统计分析、功能分析和元分析框架内一致地处理，并且具有统一的界面设计和支持。这些更新使用户能够轻松执行他们的分析工作流，并更专注于理解自己的数据。

MetaboAnalyst 5.0的功能分析模块允许将HRMS峰表直接转化为生物洞察。该版本首次实现了基于mummichog算法的“MS峰到通路”模块，通过考虑不同的加合物和离子模式对MS峰进行假设注释，并将其映射到用户选择的路径库中以预测通路活动。在MetaboAnalyst 5.0中，该算法被升级为版本2，整合了m/z和保留时间维度，进一步提高了功能解读的准确性。

MetaboAnalyst 5.0的功能分析模块还允许用户进行交互式热图分析，以便对任何手动选择的兴趣区域进行功能分析。此外，该版本还引入了功能元分析模块，以解决不同研究中非靶向代谢组学数据整合的挑战，通过路径水平整合或峰池化策略来实现全面的功能洞察。
items.research_logic: 作者通过引入MetaboAnalyst 5.0，提出了一种将原始数据转化为功能洞察的假说。首先，开发了LC-MS谱处理模块，自动化优化参数并实现可恢复分析，降低用户使用门槛（p1）。随后，功能分析模块扩展为允许用户直观选择感兴趣的峰组，并评估其潜在功能（p16）。最后，功能元分析模块整合多个全局代谢组学数据集，以获得综合的功能洞察（p18）。这些步骤通过逐步验证和排除替代解释，确保了结果的可靠性。综述部分通过组织和比较证据，如路径整合、网络分析等方法（p20, p22），提高了功能解读的准确性。每一步都基于实际数据处理需求，例如参数优化（p12）、路径预测（p16）和元分析（p18）。这些步骤确保了从原始数据到功能洞察的转化过程既高效又准确。（evidence_ids: [p1, p5, p10, p11, p12, p15, p16, p17, p18, p19, p20, p22, p23, p24, p25, p26, p27, p28]）
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，MetaboAnalyst 5.0通过整合多个模块实现了从原始数据到功能洞察的高效转化。其核心在于开发了针对目标和非目标代谢组学的统一工作流程，并引入了数据驱动的网络分析和联合通路分析，以提升多组学整合的准确性与适用性。该平台通过优化参数自动调整、增强数据库更新及可视化工具，显著降低了用户操作门槛，同时保证了跨研究的数据一致性。这一设计原则可迁移至其他多组学数据整合场景，但需注意不同实验条件下的数据异质性可能影响分析效果。
items.selection_reason: MetaboAnalyst 5.0通过引入三个核心模块显著提升了代谢组学数据从原始谱图到功能解读的转化效率。其LC-MS谱图处理模块实现了自动化参数优化与可中断分析，降低了LC-MS1数据处理门槛；功能分析模块允许用户直观选择感兴趣的峰群并评估其潜在功能富集性；而功能元分析模块则通过整合不同研究条件下的全局代谢组学数据，提供更全面的功能洞察。此外，该版本还支持加权联合通路分析、数据驱动网络分析等新功能，并优化了界面与代码库以提升性能。这些改进使用户能够更专注于数据分析而非工具操作，体现了对代谢组学数据处理流程的系统性优化和创新性设计。
items.application_prospects: MetaboAnalyst 5.0在代谢组学领域的应用前景广阔，其通过改进的流程整合和功能分析模块，显著提升了全局代谢数据的处理效率与准确性。该版本支持多种数据分析模块，包括针对靶向和非靶向数据的流程整合、功能元分析以及多组学整合分析。其核心优势在于优化了参数自动调整和数据预处理流程，降低了用户操作门槛，并通过增强的可视化工具提升了数据解读能力。然而，其应用仍受限于实验条件的一致性及数据质量，特别是在不同实验室间因设备差异导致的数据异质性问题。
items.future_directions: MetaboAnalyst 5.0的更新功能为未来研究提供了新的方向。例如，如何利用其增强的代谢通路分析模块更准确地识别疾病相关代谢特征？此外，结合多组学数据进行功能元分析，能否进一步揭示复杂疾病的机制？后续实验可设计基于不同疾病模型的全局代谢组学数据集整合分析，以验证功能元分析在跨研究数据融合中的有效性。

fields.en:
MetaboAnalyst 5.0 plays an important role in metabolomics data analysis, with the main goal of bridging the gap between raw data and functional insights. The version introduces three core modules: the LC-MS spectrum processing module, the functional analysis module, and the functional meta-analysis module. Among them, the LC-MS spectrum processing module provides an easy-to-use workflow that can automatically optimize parameters and achieve recoverable analysis, significantly lowering the threshold for LC-MS1 spectrum processing; the functional analysis module expands the previous MS peak to pathway module, allowing users to intuitively select the interested peak groups and evaluate the enrichment of their potential functions; the functional meta-analysis module combines multiple global metabolomics datasets from complementary conditions or similar studies to obtain comprehensive functional insights. In addition, the version includes many new features, such as weighted joint pathway analysis, data-driven network analysis, batch effect correction, and merging technical replicates. The web interface, graphics, and underlying code library have also been restructured to improve performance and user experience. At the end of an analysis session, users can easily switch to other compatible modules for a more smooth data analysis. MetaboAnalyst 5.0 is freely available and enhances the processing and interpretation capabilities of metabolomics data through multiple new features.

The workflow of MetaboAnalyst 5.0 covers the analysis of targeted and non-targeted metabolomics data. After appropriate data processing, all major inputs can be consistently processed within a statistical analysis, functional analysis, and meta-analysis framework, with a unified interface design and support. These updates allow users to easily execute their analysis workflows and focus more on understanding their own data.

The functional analysis module of MetaboAnalyst 5.0 allows the direct conversion of HRMS peak tables into biological insights. This version first implemented a "MS peak to pathway" module based on the mummichog algorithm, which assumes annotations for MS peaks by considering different adducts and ionization patterns, and maps them to the user-selected pathway database to predict pathway activity. In MetaboAnalyst 5.0, the algorithm was upgraded to version 2, integrating m/z and retention time dimensions, further improving the accuracy of functional interpretation.

The functional analysis module of MetaboAnalyst 5.0 also allows users to perform interactive heat map analysis for functional analysis of any manually selected interest regions. Furthermore, this version introduces a functional meta-analysis module to address the challenges of integrating non-targeted metabolomics data across different studies, achieving comprehensive functional insights through pathway-level integration or peak pooling strategies.

paragraphs.zh: MetaboAnalyst 5.0在代谢组学数据分析中扮演着重要角色，其主要目标是缩小从原始数据到功能洞察之间的差距。该版本引入了三个核心模块：LC-MS光谱处理模块、功能分析模块和功能元分析模块。其中，LC-MS光谱处理模块提供了易于使用的流程，能够自动优化参数并实现可恢复的分析，显著降低了LC-MS1光谱处理的门槛；功能分析模块扩展了之前的MS峰到通路模块，允许用户直观选择感兴趣的峰组，并评估其潜在功能的富集情况；功能元分析模块则结合来自互补条件或相似研究的多个全局代谢组学数据集，以获得全面的功能洞察。此外，该版本还包含许多新功能，如加权联合通路分析、数据驱动网络分析、批次效应校正、合并技术重复等。Web界面、图形和底层代码库也进行了重构，以提高性能和用户体验。在分析会话结束时，用户可以轻松切换到其他兼容模块，实现更流畅的数据分析。MetaboAnalyst 5.0是免费提供的，并且通过多个新功能提升了代谢组学数据的处理与解读能力。

paragraphs.en: The workflow of MetaboAnalyst 5.0 covers the analysis of targeted and non-targeted metabolomics data. After appropriate data processing, all major inputs can be consistently processed within a statistical analysis, functional analysis, and meta-analysis framework, with a unified interface design and support. These updates allow users to easily execute their analysis workflows and focus more on understanding their own data.
paragraphs.zh: MetaboAnalyst 5.0的工作流程涵盖了针对和非靶向代谢组学数据的分析。在适当的数据处理后，所有主要输入都可以在统计分析、功能分析和元分析框架内一致地处理，并且具有统一的界面设计和支持。这些更新使用户能够轻松执行他们的分析工作流，并更专注于理解自己的数据。

paragraphs.en: The functional analysis module of MetaboAnalyst 5.0 allows the direct conversion of HRMS peak tables into biological insights. This version first implemented a "MS peak to pathway" module based on the mummichog algorithm, which assumes annotations for MS peaks by considering different adducts and ionization patterns, and maps them to the user-selected pathway database to predict pathway activity. In MetaboAnalyst 5.0, the algorithm was upgraded to version 2, integrating m/z and retention time dimensions, further improving the accuracy of functional interpretation.
paragraphs.zh: MetaboAnalyst 5.0的功能分析模块允许将HRMS峰表直接转化为生物洞察。该版本首次实现了基于mummichog算法的“MS峰到通路”模块，通过考虑不同的加合物和离子模式对MS峰进行假设注释，并将其映射到用户选择的路径库中以预测通路活动。在MetaboAnalyst 5.0中，该算法被升级为版本2，整合了m/z和保留时间维度，进一步提高了功能解读的准确性。

paragraphs.en: The functional analysis module of MetaboAnalyst 5.0 also allows users to perform interactive heat map analysis for functional analysis of any manually selected interest regions. Furthermore, this version introduces a functional meta-analysis module to address the challenges of integrating non-targeted metabolomics data across different studies, achieving comprehensive functional insights through pathway-level integration or peak pooling strategies.
paragraphs.zh: MetaboAnalyst 5.0的功能分析模块还允许用户进行交互式热图分析，以便对任何手动选择的兴趣区域进行功能分析。此外，该版本还引入了功能元分析模块，以解决不同研究中非靶向代谢组学数据整合的挑战，通过路径水平整合或峰池化策略来实现全面的功能洞察。

fields.en: The author introduces MetaboAnalyst 5.0 and proposes a hypothesis for converting raw data into functional insights. First, an LC-MS spectrum processing module is developed to automate parameter optimization and enable recoverable analysis, reducing the user's entry threshold (p1). Subsequently, the functional analysis module is expanded to allow users to intuitively select the groups of interest peaks and evaluate their potential functions (p16). Finally, the functional meta-analysis module integrates multiple global metabolomics datasets to obtain comprehensive functional insights (p18). These steps ensure the reliability of the results through step-by-step validation and exclusion of alternative interpretations. The review part improves the accuracy of functional interpretation by organizing and comparing evidence, such as pathway integration, network analysis, etc., (p20, p22). Each step is based on actual data processing needs, such as parameter optimization (p12), pathway prediction (p16) and meta-analysis (p18). These steps ensure that the process of converting from raw data to functional insights is both efficient and accurate.(evidence_ids: [p1, p5, p10, p11, p12, p15, p16, p17, p18, p19, p20, p22, p23, p24, p25, p26, p27, p28])
fields.zh: 作者通过引入MetaboAnalyst 5.0，提出了一种将原始数据转化为功能洞察的假说。首先，开发了LC-MS谱处理模块，自动化优化参数并实现可恢复分析，降低用户使用门槛（p1）。随后，功能分析模块扩展为允许用户直观选择感兴趣的峰组，并评估其潜在功能（p16）。最后，功能元分析模块整合多个全局代谢组学数据集，以获得综合的功能洞察（p18）。这些步骤通过逐步验证和排除替代解释，确保了结果的可靠性。综述部分通过组织和比较证据，如路径整合、网络分析等方法（p20, p22），提高了功能解读的准确性。每一步都基于实际数据处理需求，例如参数优化（p12）、路径预测（p16）和元分析（p18）。这些步骤确保了从原始数据到功能洞察的转化过程既高效又准确。（evidence_ids: [p1, p5, p10, p11, p12, p15, p16, p17, p18, p19, p20, p22, p23, p24, p25, p26, p27, p28]）

fields.en: My conclusion is that MetaboAnalyst 5.0 achieves efficient conversion from raw data to functional insights by integrating multiple modules. Its core lies in developing a unified workflow for both targeted and non-targeted metabolomics, and introducing data-driven network analysis and joint pathway analysis to enhance the accuracy and applicability of multi-omics integration. The platform significantly reduces user operational barriers through optimized parameter auto-adjustment, enhanced database updates, and visualization tools, while ensuring consistency across studies. This design principle can be transferred to other multi-omics data integration scenarios, but one must be aware that data heterogeneity under different experimental conditions may affect analysis effectiveness.
fields.zh: 我的归纳是，MetaboAnalyst 5.0通过整合多个模块实现了从原始数据到功能洞察的高效转化。其核心在于开发了针对目标和非目标代谢组学的统一工作流程，并引入了数据驱动的网络分析和联合通路分析，以提升多组学整合的准确性与适用性。该平台通过优化参数自动调整、增强数据库更新及可视化工具，显著降低了用户操作门槛，同时保证了跨研究的数据一致性。这一设计原则可迁移至其他多组学数据整合场景，但需注意不同实验条件下的数据异质性可能影响分析效果。

fields.label_en: Why selected and what is innovative
fields.label_zh: 推荐理由与创新点（详细）
fields.en: MetaboAnalyst 5.0 significantly improves the efficiency of converting metabolic data from raw spectra to functional interpretation by introducing three core modules. Its LC-MS spectrum processing module realizes automated parameter optimization and interruptible analysis, reducing the threshold of LC-MS1 data processing; The functional analysis module allows users to intuitively select the peak groups of interest and evaluate their potential functional enrichment. The functional module analysis integrates global metabolomics data across different experimental conditions to provide more comprehensive functional insights. In addition, this version supports new features such as weighted joint pathway analysis and data-driven network analysis, and optimizes the interface and code library to enhance performance. These improvements allow users to focus more on data analysis rather than tool operation, reflecting systematic optimization and innovative design in the processing workflow of metabolomics data.

fields.en: The application prospects of MetaboAnalyst 5.0 in metabolomics are broad. It significantly improves the efficiency and accuracy of global metabolic data processing through improved workflow integration and functional analysis modules. The version supports multiple data analysis modules, including workflow integration for targeted and non-targeted data, functional meta-analysis, and multi-omics integration analysis. Its core advantages lie in optimizing parameter automatic adjustment and data preprocessing workflows, reducing user operational barriers, and enhancing data interpretation capabilities through improved visualization tools. However, its application is still limited by the consistency of experimental conditions and data quality, particularly the issue of data heterogeneity caused by equipment differences between different laboratories.
fields.zh: MetaboAnalyst 5.0在代谢组学领域的应用前景广阔，其通过改进的流程整合和功能分析模块，显著提升了全局代谢数据的处理效率与准确性。该版本支持多种数据分析模块，包括针对靶向和非靶向数据的流程整合、功能元分析以及多组学整合分析。其核心优势在于优化了参数自动调整和数据预处理流程，降低了用户操作门槛，并通过增强的可视化工具提升了数据解读能力。然而，其应用仍受限于实验条件的一致性及数据质量，特别是在不同实验室间因设备差异导致的数据异质性问题。

fields.en: The updated features of MetaboAnalyst 5.0 provide new directions for future research. For example, how can its enhanced metabolic pathway analysis module be utilized to more accurately identify disease-related metabolic features? Additionally, can the integration of multi-omics data for functional metadata analysis further reveal the mechanisms of complex diseases? Subsequent experiments could design global metabolomic datasets integrated across different disease models to validate the effectiveness of functional metadata analysis in fusing data across studies.
fields.zh: MetaboAnalyst 5.0的更新功能为未来研究提供了新的方向。例如，如何利用其增强的代谢通路分析模块更准确地识别疾病相关代谢特征？此外，结合多组学数据进行功能元分析，能否进一步揭示复杂疾病的机制？后续实验可设计基于不同疾病模型的全局代谢组学数据集整合分析，以验证功能元分析在跨研究数据融合中的有效性。

decisions.focus: Cross-docking and redocking reveal distinct determinants of success in physics-based and AI-driven binding pose prediction in protein–ligand complexes

The study provides a comprehensive benchmarking of physics-based and AI-driven methods for predicting protein–ligand binding poses under realistic cross-docking conditions, highlighting the importance of cross-docking and training-overlap-aware evaluation in structure-based drug discovery. The findings offer practical guidance for selecting and integrating complementary computational approaches based on cavity-topology considerations.

classification_audit.abstract: Protein–ligand pose prediction is central to structure-based drug discovery, yet the relative performance of physics-based and AI-driven methods under realistic cross-docking conditions remains insufficiently characterized. Here, we compare physics-based docking methods (AutoDock4, AutoDock Vina, and DOCK 6) with data-driven approaches, including the deep-learning model GNINA 1.3 and the diffusion-based frameworks AlphaFold 3, Boltz-2, and DiffDock. Performance was evaluated using standardised redocking and cross-docking protocols across three Alzheimer's disease targets representing distinct binding-site architectures: acetylcholinesterase (AChE; deep gorge), β-secretase 1 (BACE1; flexible flap-controlled site), and glycogen synthase kinase-3β (GSK-3β; open, solvent-exposed pocket). Physics-based methods were competitive during redocking but showed substantial performance reductions under cross-docking, whereas diffusion-based approaches generally maintained higher cross-docking accuracy. GNINA 1.3 rigid achieved an 87.7% minimum heavy-atom RMSD success rate during redocking, which decreased to 13.5% during cross-docking, whereas AlphaFold 3, Boltz-2, and DiffDock achieved cross-docking success rates of 93.1%, 89.6%, and 85.7%, respectively. AlphaFold 3 consistently outperformed Boltz-2 despite its smaller training set, suggesting that predictive performance is influenced not only by training-data volume but also by factors such as model architecture and confidence calibration. Training-overlap analysis further showed that AI-based methods retained substantial failure rates even for complexes represented in their training data, indicating that training-data overlap alone does not ensure reliable pose prediction. Under the current protocol conditions, rigid docking outperformed flexible protocols, while flexible-docking pocket volumes showed more restricted sampling relative to experimental holo structures. Among the GNINA 1.3 configurations, CNN rescoring with refinement produced the highest pose-recovery success rates, followed by CNN rescoring alone and the default Vina/empirical scoring approach in cross-docking. Receptor conformational preference was target-dependent: holo structures provided higher docking accuracy for AChE and BACE1, whose ligand-bound cavities exhibited greater structural complexity and geometric confinement that favoured pose discrimination, whereas the apo GSK-3β structure contained a larger, more solvent-exposed cavity that improved ligand accessibility and docking performance. Overall, these findings demonstrate the importance of cross-docking and training-overlap-aware evaluation for assessing docking performance under realistic conditions and provide cavity-topology-based considerations for selecting docking strategies in structure-based drug discovery.

items.action:
蛋白质-配体相互作用（PLI）预测是结构导向药物发现的关键组成部分，其性能受多种因素影响，包括配体几何形状、物理化学互补性以及受体构象动态。尽管方法学发展已有数十年，准确预测配体结合姿态仍具挑战性，尤其是在具有显著结构性质变化或配体诱导构象变化的目标中。这些挑战在多因素疾病如阿尔茨海默病（AD）中尤为突出，其中治疗靶点涵盖多样化的功能类别和结合位点架构。

本研究通过全面的基准测试，对三个药理学重要的目标——乙酰胆碱酯酶（AChE）、β-分泌酶1（BACE1）和糖原合成酶激酶-3β（GSK-3β）进行了比较。这些目标涵盖了从深邃封闭沟槽到 flap 控制位点以及溶剂暴露口袋的多样结合环境。使用标准化的红 docking 和 cross-docking 协议，我们比较了七种代表性方法，包括基于物理的方法、深度学习方法和扩散基方法。通过直接对比 AlphaFold 3 和 Boltz-2，同时系统评估受体构象和结合位点架构的影响，我们识别了影响 docking 成功的关键因素，并为结构导向药物发现中选择和整合互补计算方法提供了实践指导。

在数据提取和预处理阶段，使用 RDKit Morgan 指数和 Tanimoto 相似性对配体进行了额外的分组。Butina 算法用于将结构相似的配体分为不同的组别。在 docking 设置中，使用 AutoDock Vina、GNINA 1.3 和 AutoDock4 进行了刚性和柔性 docking 计算。网格盒中心位于实验确定的结合口袋坐标上，并且对于不同目标采用了不同的选择标准以确保最优的实验可靠性和可重复性。通过这些方法，我们能够评估不同方法在实际条件下的性能，并提供基于结合位点拓扑学的选择 docking 策略的考虑。

本研究结果表明，在现实条件下评估 docking 性能时，cross-docking 和 training-overlap-aware 评估的重要性。同时，这些发现为结构导向药物发现中选择 docking 策略提供了基于结合位点拓扑学的考量。
items.research_logic: 作者通过系统比较不同方法在红 docking 和 cross-docking 条件下的性能，提出假说并验证其有效性。首先，选择三个具有代表性的靶标进行实验，确保数据的多样性与代表性；其次，采用标准化协议对七种方法进行评估，包括基于物理的方法、深度学习方法和扩散基方法。通过直接比较 AlphaFold 3 和 Boltz-2 的性能，并系统分析受体构象和结合位点结构的影响，识别出影响 docking 成功的关键因素。在实验设计中，作者特别关注训练数据重叠对预测结果的潜在影响，通过分析不同方法在相同测试集上的表现，排除了训练数据重叠单一因素对预测可靠性的影响。此外，作者还考虑了受体构象偏好对 docking 性能的影响，特别是对于 AChE 和 BACE1 这类结构复杂且几何受限的结合位点，holo 结构提供了更高的 docking 准确性。最后，通过统计分析和置信区间计算，确保结果的可靠性与可重复性。这些步骤的设置旨在全面评估 docking 方法在真实条件下的性能，并为结构基药物发现提供实用指导。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，本研究通过对比不同方法在交叉对接条件下的表现，揭示了物理方法和AI方法在预测结合位点时的差异。实验表明，在真实条件下，扩散型方法在跨对接中表现更优，而刚性方法在红对接中表现较好。这提示在结构导向药物发现中，应根据结合位点拓扑特性选择合适的对接策略，并考虑训练数据重叠对预测可靠性的影响。该结论适用于评估不同对接方法在复杂靶标中的适用性，但受限于实验条件和目标结构的多样性。
items.selection_reason:
本研究通过对比物理方法与AI驱动方法在交叉对接条件下的表现，揭示了不同方法在预测蛋白质-配体结合构象时的关键决定因素。物理方法在重对接中表现良好，但在交叉对接中显著下降，而扩散基方法在交叉对接中保持较高准确性。GNINA 1.3的刚性对接在重对接中达到87.7%的成功率，而在交叉对接中降至13.5%，而AlphaFold 3、Boltz-2和DiffDock的交叉对接成功率分别为93.1%、89.6%和85.7%。AlphaFold 3尽管训练数据较少仍优于Boltz-2，表明预测性能不仅受训练数据量影响，还与模型架构和置信度校准有关。AI方法即使在训练数据重叠的情况下仍存在失败率，说明训练数据重叠不足以确保可靠预测。研究还发现刚性对接在当前协议条件下优于柔性对接，而柔性对接口袋体积相对受限。GNINA 1.3的CNN重评分加优化产生最高构象恢复成功率。受体构象偏好因靶标不同而异，全构象结构对AChE和BACE1的对接精度更高，而apo GSK-3β结构更有利于配体接近性。这些发现强调了交叉对接和训练数据重叠意识评估在真实条件下的 docking 性能评估中的重要性，并提供了基于口袋拓扑学的选择 docking 策略的考虑。

本研究通过系统分析不同方法在交叉对接条件下的表现，揭示了物理方法与AI驱动方法在预测蛋白质-配体结合构象时的关键差异。GNINA 1.3和AlphaFold 3等AI方法在交叉对接中表现出更高的准确性，而物理方法在交叉对接中性能显著下降。研究还发现训练数据重叠并不保证可靠的预测结果，且柔性对接的口袋体积相对受限。这些发现为结构基于药物发现中的 docking 方法选择提供了实践指导。

本研究通过对比不同方法在交叉对接条件下的表现，揭示了物理方法与AI驱动方法在预测蛋白质-配体结合构象时的关键差异。GNINA 1.3和AlphaFold 3等AI方法在交叉对接中表现出更高的准确性，而物理方法在交叉对接中性能显著下降。研究还发现训练数据重叠并不保证可靠的预测结果，且柔性对接的口袋体积相对受限。这些发现为结构基于药物发现中的 docking 方法选择提供了实践指导。
items.application_prospects: 本文通过对比物理方法与AI驱动方法在跨对接条件下的表现，揭示了不同 docking 策略在真实化学环境中的应用前景。物理方法在红对接中表现良好，但在跨对接中性能显著下降；扩散基方法在跨对接中保持较高准确性。GNINA 1.3 在红对接中表现优异，但跨对接时效果下降明显。AlphaFold 3、Boltz-2 和 DiffDock 在跨对接中均表现出色，其中 AlphaFold 3 表现最佳。研究还指出，训练数据重叠并不能保证预测可靠性，且刚性对接在当前条件下优于柔性对接。这些结果为结构基药物发现中的 docking 策略选择提供了依据。
items.future_directions: 本文揭示了在真实条件下，物理方法和AI驱动方法在跨对接中的性能差异。未来可检验的问题包括：如何优化AI模型以提高训练数据重叠情况下的预测可靠性？是否可以通过改进柔性对接策略来增强对不同结合位点架构的适应性？此外，基于空腔拓扑学的 docking 策略选择需进一步验证其在结构导向药物发现中的有效性。

fields.en:
Predicting protein-ligand interactions (PLI) is a key component of structure-based drug discovery, and its performance is influenced by multiple factors, including the geometry of the ligand, chemical compatibility, and conformational dynamics of the receptor. Despite decades of methodological development, accurately predicting the binding pose of the ligand remains challenging, especially in targets with significant changes in structural properties or conformational changes induced by the ligand. These challenges are particularly evident in multifactorial diseases such as Alzheimer's disease (AD), where therapeutic targets span a wide range of functional classes and binding site architectures.

This study conducted an extensive benchmarking to compare three pharmacologically important targets—acetylcholinesterase (AChE), beta-secretase 1 (BACE1), and glycogen synthase kinase-3 beta (GSK-3beta). These targets cover a variety of binding environments ranging from deep, enclosed grooves to flap control sites and solvent-exposed pockets. Using standardized red docking and cross-docking protocols, we compared seven representative methods, including physics-based methods, deep learning methods, and diffusion-based methods. By directly comparing AlphaFold 3 and Boltz-2, while systematically evaluating the impact of receptor conformation and binding site architecture, we identified key factors affecting docking success and provided practical guidance for selecting and integrating complementary computational methods in structure-guided drug discovery.

During the data extraction and preprocessing stage, additional grouping of ligands was performed using RDKit Morgan fingerprints and Tanimoto similarity. The Butina algorithm was used to group structurally similar ligands into different groups. In the docking setup, rigid and flexible docking calculations were performed using AutoDock Vina, GNINA 1.3, and AutoDock4. The grid box centers were located on experimentally determined binding pocket coordinates, and different selection criteria were applied for different targets to ensure optimal experimental reliability and reproducibility. Through these methods, we were able to evaluate the performance of different methods under actual conditions and provide considerations for a docking strategy based on the topology of the binding site.

The results of this study indicate the importance of cross-docking and training-overlap-aware evaluation when assessing docking performance under real-world conditions. Meanwhile, these findings provide considerations based on the topology of binding sites for selecting docking strategies in structure-guided drug discovery.

paragraphs.zh: 本研究通过全面的基准测试，对三个药理学重要的目标——乙酰胆碱酯酶（AChE）、β-分泌酶1（BACE1）和糖原合成酶激酶-3β（GSK-3β）进行了比较。这些目标涵盖了从深邃封闭沟槽到 flap 控制位点以及溶剂暴露口袋的多样结合环境。使用标准化的红 docking 和 cross-docking 协议，我们比较了七种代表性方法，包括基于物理的方法、深度学习方法和扩散基方法。通过直接对比 AlphaFold 3 和 Boltz-2，同时系统评估受体构象和结合位点架构的影响，我们识别了影响 docking 成功的关键因素，并为结构导向药物发现中选择和整合互补计算方法提供了实践指导。

paragraphs.en: During the data extraction and preprocessing stage, additional grouping of ligands was performed using RDKit Morgan fingerprints and Tanimoto similarity. The Butina algorithm was used to group structurally similar ligands into different groups. In the docking setup, rigid and flexible docking calculations were performed using AutoDock Vina, GNINA 1.3, and AutoDock4. The grid box centers were located on experimentally determined binding pocket coordinates, and different selection criteria were applied for different targets to ensure optimal experimental reliability and reproducibility. Through these methods, we were able to evaluate the performance of different methods under actual conditions and provide considerations for a docking strategy based on the topology of the binding site.
paragraphs.zh: 在数据提取和预处理阶段，使用 RDKit Morgan 指数和 Tanimoto 相似性对配体进行了额外的分组。Butina 算法用于将结构相似的配体分为不同的组别。在 docking 设置中，使用 AutoDock Vina、GNINA 1.3 和 AutoDock4 进行了刚性和柔性 docking 计算。网格盒中心位于实验确定的结合口袋坐标上，并且对于不同目标采用了不同的选择标准以确保最优的实验可靠性和可重复性。通过这些方法，我们能够评估不同方法在实际条件下的性能，并提供基于结合位点拓扑学的选择 docking 策略的考虑。

paragraphs.en: The results of this study indicate the importance of cross-docking and training-overlap-aware evaluation when assessing docking performance under real-world conditions. Meanwhile, these findings provide considerations based on the topology of binding sites for selecting docking strategies in structure-guided drug discovery.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究结果表明，在现实条件下评估 docking 性能时，cross-docking 和 training-overlap-aware 评估的重要性。同时，这些发现为结构导向药物发现中选择 docking 策略提供了基于结合位点拓扑学的考量。

fields.en: The author proposes hypotheses and validates their effectiveness by systematically comparing the performance of different methods under red docking and cross-docking conditions. First, three representative targets are selected for experiments to ensure data diversity and representativeness; second, seven methods are evaluated using standardized protocols, including physics-based methods, deep learning methods, and diffusion-based methods. By directly comparing the performance of AlphaFold 3 and Boltz-2, and systematically analyzing the impact of receptor conformation and binding site structure, key factors affecting docking success are identified. In the experimental design, the author particularly focuses on the potential influence of training data overlap on prediction results, excluding the effect of training data overlap as a single factor on prediction reliability by analyzing the performance of different methods on the same test set. Additionally, the author considers the impact of receptor conformation preference on docking performance, especially for complex and geometrically constrained binding sites such as AChE and BACE1, where holo structures provide higher docking accuracy. Finally, statistical analysis and confidence interval calculations are used to ensure the reliability and reproducibility of the results. These steps are set up to comprehensively evaluate the performance of docking methods under real conditions and provide practical guidance for structure-based drug discovery.
fields.zh: 作者通过系统比较不同方法在红 docking 和 cross-docking 条件下的性能，提出假说并验证其有效性。首先，选择三个具有代表性的靶标进行实验，确保数据的多样性与代表性；其次，采用标准化协议对七种方法进行评估，包括基于物理的方法、深度学习方法和扩散基方法。通过直接比较 AlphaFold 3 和 Boltz-2 的性能，并系统分析受体构象和结合位点结构的影响，识别出影响 docking 成功的关键因素。在实验设计中，作者特别关注训练数据重叠对预测结果的潜在影响，通过分析不同方法在相同测试集上的表现，排除了训练数据重叠单一因素对预测可靠性的影响。此外，作者还考虑了受体构象偏好对 docking 性能的影响，特别是对于 AChE 和 BACE1 这类结构复杂且几何受限的结合位点，holo 结构提供了更高的 docking 准确性。最后，通过统计分析和置信区间计算，确保结果的可靠性与可重复性。这些步骤的设置旨在全面评估 docking 方法在真实条件下的性能，并为结构基药物发现提供实用指导。

fields.en: My conclusion is that this study reveals the differences between physical methods and AI methods in predicting binding sites by comparing their performance under cross-docking conditions. The experiments show that diffusion-type methods perform better in cross-docking under real conditions, while rigid methods perform better in redocking. This suggests that in structure-guided drug discovery, appropriate docking strategies should be selected based on the topological characteristics of the binding site, and the influence of training data overlap on prediction reliability should be considered. This conclusion is applicable for evaluating the suitability of different docking methods in complex targets, but is limited by experimental conditions and the diversity of target structures.
fields.zh: 我的归纳是，本研究通过对比不同方法在交叉对接条件下的表现，揭示了物理方法和AI方法在预测结合位点时的差异。实验表明，在真实条件下，扩散型方法在跨对接中表现更优，而刚性方法在红对接中表现较好。这提示在结构导向药物发现中，应根据结合位点拓扑特性选择合适的对接策略，并考虑训练数据重叠对预测可靠性的影响。该结论适用于评估不同对接方法在复杂靶标中的适用性，但受限于实验条件和目标结构的多样性。

fields.label_en: Why selected and what is innovative
fields.label_zh: 推荐理由与创新点（详细）
fields.en:
This study reveals the key determining factors for predicting protein-ligand binding conformations by comparing the performance of physical methods and AI-driven methods under cross-docking conditions. Physical methods perform well in re-docking but significantly decline in cross-docking, while diffusion-based methods maintain higher accuracy in cross-docking. The rigid docking of GNINA 1.3 achieves an 87.7% success rate in re-docking, but drops to 13.5% in cross-docking, whereas the cross-docking success rates of AlphaFold 3, Boltz-2, and DiffDock are 93.1%, 89.6%, and 85.7%, respectively. Although AlphaFold 3 has fewer training data, it outperforms Boltz-2, indicating that prediction performance is not only influenced by the amount of training data but also by model architecture and confidence calibration. AI methods still have failure rates even when there is overlap in training data, suggesting that overlapping training data is insufficient to ensure reliable predictions. The study also finds that rigid docking performs better than flexible docking under current protocol conditions, while flexible docking has relatively limited pocket volume. The CNN re-ranking optimization of GNINA 1.3 produces the highest conformation recovery success rate. Receptor conformation preferences vary depending on targets, with full-conformation structures showing higher docking accuracy for AChE and BACE1, whereas apo GSK-3β structure is more favorable for ligand accessibility. These findings emphasize the importance of assessing cross-docking and training data overlap in evaluating docking performance under real conditions, and provide considerations for docking strategies based on pocket topology.

This study reveals key differences between physical methods and AI-driven methods in predicting protein-ligand binding conformations through systematic analysis of their performance under cross-docking conditions. AI methods such as GNINA 1.3 and AlphaFold 3 show higher accuracy in cross-docking, while physical methods experience a significant decline in performance. The study also finds that overlapping training data do not guarantee reliable prediction results, and the volume of flexible docking pockets is relatively constrained. These findings provide practical guidance for selecting docking methods in structure-based drug discovery.

本研究通过对比物理方法与AI驱动方法在交叉对接条件下的表现，揭示了不同方法在预测蛋白质-配体结合构象时的关键决定因素。物理方法在重对接中表现良好，但在交叉对接中显著下降，而扩散基方法在交叉对接中保持较高准确性。GNINA 1.3的刚性对接在重对接中达到87.7%的成功率，而在交叉对接中降至13.5%，而AlphaFold 3、Boltz-2和DiffDock的交叉对接成功率分别为93.1%、89.6%和85.7%。AlphaFold 3尽管训练数据较少仍优于Boltz-2，表明预测性能不仅受训练数据量影响，还与模型架构和置信度校准有关。AI方法即使在训练数据重叠的情况下仍存在失败率，说明训练数据重叠不足以确保可靠预测。研究还发现刚性对接在当前协议条件下优于柔性对接，而柔性对接口袋体积相对受限。GNINA 1.3的CNN重评分加优化产生最高构象恢复成功率。受体构象偏好因靶标不同而异，全构象结构对AChE和BACE1的对接精度更高，而apo GSK-3β结构更有利于配体接近性。这些发现强调了交叉对接和训练数据重叠意识评估在真实条件下的 docking 性能评估中的重要性，并提供了基于口袋拓扑学的选择 docking 策略的考虑。

本研究通过系统分析不同方法在交叉对接条件下的表现，揭示了物理方法与AI驱动方法在预测蛋白质-配体结合构象时的关键差异。GNINA 1.3和AlphaFold 3等AI方法在交叉对接中表现出更高的准确性，而物理方法在交叉对接中性能显著下降。研究还发现训练数据重叠并不保证可靠的预测结果，且柔性对接的口袋体积相对受限。这些发现为结构基于药物发现中的 docking 方法选择提供了实践指导。

paragraphs.zh: 本研究通过对比不同方法在交叉对接条件下的表现，揭示了物理方法与AI驱动方法在预测蛋白质-配体结合构象时的关键差异。GNINA 1.3和AlphaFold 3等AI方法在交叉对接中表现出更高的准确性，而物理方法在交叉对接中性能显著下降。研究还发现训练数据重叠并不保证可靠的预测结果，且柔性对接的口袋体积相对受限。这些发现为结构基于药物发现中的 docking 方法选择提供了实践指导。

fields.en: This study reveals the potential applications of different docking strategies in real chemical environments by comparing the performance of physical methods and AI-driven approaches under cross-docking conditions. Physical methods perform well in redocking but show a significant decline in performance under cross-docking; diffusion-based methods maintain relatively high accuracy under cross-docking. GNINA 1.3 performs exceptionally well in redocking, but its performance drops significantly under cross-docking. AlphaFold 3, Boltz-2, and DiffDock all demonstrate good performance under cross-docking, with AlphaFold 3 showing the best results. The study also highlights that overlapping training data cannot guarantee prediction reliability, and rigid docking is superior to flexible docking under current conditions. These results provide a basis for selecting docking strategies in structure-based drug discovery.

fields.en: This paper reveals the performance differences between physical methods and AI-driven methods in cross-docking under real conditions. Future testable questions include: How can AI models be optimized to improve prediction reliability in situations with overlapping training data? Can the flexibility of docking strategies be enhanced to improve adaptability to different binding site architectures? Additionally, the selection of docking strategies based on cavities' topology needs further verification of their effectiveness in structure-guided drug discovery.

decisions.focus: Site-Specific Dual Encoding and Labeling of Proteins via Genetic Code Expansion

The article presents a comprehensive review of the use of genetic code expansion (GCE) for site-specific dual encoding and labeling of proteins, highlighting its role in chemical biology. The central contribution is the detailed analysis of the principles, challenges, and solutions in achieving mutual orthogonality between two distinct ncAA-encoding subsystems for DEAL. This work provides a critical synthesis of current methodologies and identifies key considerations for improving the reliability and application of GCE-based DEAL, particularly in in vivo settings.

evidence.text: The ability to selectively attach two different labels onto biomolecules enables powerful approaches to detect, construct, characterize and study biomolecules and/or their interacting partners with great precision, even in their native contexts. In general, achieving this requires a two-step process composing of 1) biochemical encoding of two distinct bioorthogonal and mutually orthogonal reactive groups or “handles” into the targeted macromolecule(s), and 2) the subsequent selective labeling of

Genetic code expansion relies on the action of an exogenous aminoacyl-tRNA synthetases and their cognate tRNAs (aaRS/tRNA pairs) to outcompete endogenous decoding systems and/or release factors to encode an ncAA. This process has historically been called suppression since such a process worked to suppress the action of release factors, but we will simply refer to it as encoding . An ncAA-encoding “subsystem” is comprised of four components ( Figure 2A ): 1) the ncAA to be encoded, 2) the tRNA th

Permissivity or “polyspecificity” ( Figure 2C ) refers to an aaRS exhibiting specificity for more than one ncAA 75 . While this property is generally useful for increasing the number of ncAAs that can be encoded by a single aaRS 75 - 77 , in the case of DEAL it can lead to a breakdown in the mutual orthogonality of the two ncAA-encoding subsystems. This may be particularly problematic as, from our experience, many aaRSs have at least some permissivity towards structurally similar ncAAs 75 - 78 .

classification_audit.abstract: The ability to selectively modify proteins at two or more defined locations opens new avenues for manipulating, engineering, and studying living systems. As a chemical biology tool for the site-specific encoding of noncanonical amino acids into proteins in vivo , genetic code expansion (GCE) represents a powerful tool to achieve such modifications with minimal disruption to structure and function through a two-step “Dual Encoding And Labeling” (DEAL) process. In this review, we summarize the state of the field of DEAL using genetic code expansion. In doing so, we describe the basic principles of GCE-based DEAL, catalogue compatible encoding systems and reactions, explore demonstrated and potential applications, highlight emerging paradigms in DEAL methodologies, and propose novel solutions to current limitations.

items.action:
蛋白质位点特异性双重编码和标记通过基因密码扩展实现，是化学生物学中一种重要的工具。该技术能够将非天然氨基酸（ncAA）以特定位置引入蛋白质中，并通过双重编码与标记过程（DEAL）进行精准操控。在DEAL过程中，需要两个相互正交的解码子系统来分别编码两种不同的ncAA，这要求每个ncAA-编码子系统之间具有足够的正交性。这种正交性主要体现在三个分子识别步骤中：ncAA-aaRS、aaRS-tRNA以及tRNA抗密码子-密码子识别。在这些步骤中，需要确保外源ncAA-编码子系统与宿主系统之间的正交性足够高，以避免对天然氨基酸的污染或非预期的编码。此外，在DEAL过程中，对于每个ncAA-aaRS的正交性要求更高，因为如果选择的aaRS对某些天然氨基酸具有一定的活性，则可能导致在没有ncAA的情况下出现背景编码。然而，当存在足够的相对正交性时，即使绝对正交性较低，也可以实现有效的编码效率。因此，在设计DEAL实验时，需要仔细评估ncAA-aaRS之间的兼容性和正交性，并通过实验验证其相对正交性以确保系统的稳定性与可靠性。此外，对于aaRS-tRNA的正交性也至关重要，因为如果两个子系统之间存在重叠的身份因子，则可能导致非预期的编码和解码错误。因此，在实际应用中，需要选择具有足够正交性的ncAA-编码子系统，并通过实验验证其兼容性和正交性以确保系统的稳定性与可靠性。

在DEAL过程中，除了对ncAA-aaRS和aaRS-tRNA的正交性要求外，还需要考虑其他因素，如permissivity（多特异性）等。这些因素可能会影响两个子系统之间的相互正交性，并可能导致编码错误或非预期的交叉反应。因此，在实际应用中，需要选择具有足够正交性的ncAA-编码子系统，并通过实验验证其兼容性和正交性以确保系统的稳定性与可靠性。

综上所述，DEAL技术在蛋白质工程和生物传感平台设计方面具有广泛的应用前景。通过基因密码扩展实现的DEAL方法能够提供一种通用且高效的蛋白质标记和操控策略，为研究蛋白质相互作用、动态监测以及生物传感器开发提供了新的工具和方法。
items.research_logic: 作者通过总结现有文献，提出利用遗传密码扩展（GCE）实现双编码和标记（DEAL）的假说。首先，作者指出在生物系统中选择性修饰蛋白质需要两个步骤：1) 生化编码两种不同的生物正交反应基团；2) 选择性标记这些基团。接着，作者通过分析已有研究，总结了GCE-based DEAL的基本原理和兼容的编码系统，并探讨了其潜在应用。为确保DEAL的准确性，作者强调了保持编码子系统的正交性的重要性，特别是在同时编码两种不同非天然氨基酸（ncAA）时，需要更高的正交性以避免交叉污染。此外，作者指出在实际操作中，相对正交性比绝对正交性更重要，因为即使存在一定的绝对正交性不足，只要相对正交性足够，仍可实现有效的DEAL实验。最后，作者通过分析已有研究，提出如何选择和验证兼容的编码子系统以确保其正交性，并强调了在实际应用中需要对这些子系统进行实证检验。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，DEAL实验设计中需优先考虑相对保真度而非绝对保真度，以确保两个不同非天然氨基酸编码子系统的互不干扰。此原则适用于需要多重标签或功能修饰的蛋白质工程场景，但受限于ncAA结构相似性及宿主系统兼容性的约束。
items.selection_reason:
本文推荐基于遗传密码扩展（GCE）的双编码与标记（DEAL）技术，因其在实现蛋白质位点特异性修饰方面具有显著优势。通过构建两个相互正交的编码子系统，GCE能够有效避免非天然氨基酸（ncAA）在目标蛋白中的非预期掺入，从而提高实验的精确性和可靠性。该方法不仅适用于体内研究，还能通过优化编码子系统的正交性来降低背景噪声，提升标记效率。此外，GCE技术通过精细调控分子识别步骤（如ncAA-aaRS、aaRS-tRNA及tRNA anticodon-codon识别），能够实现对不同ncAA的高特异性编码，为多组分系统提供更灵活的应用场景。与传统流水线工作相比，GCE方法在设计和实施过程中更加注重分子层面的正交性控制，而非单纯依赖期刊评价或全球首次的宣称。因此，该技术在蛋白质工程、生物传感器开发及跨物种应用中展现出独特价值。

items.application_prospects: 本文探讨了遗传密码扩展（GCE）在双编码与标记（DEAL）中的应用前景，强调其在生物系统中实现精准修饰的潜力。通过合成两种互不干扰的非天然氨基酸（ncAA），GCE能够有效避免结构和功能的破坏。该技术适用于蛋白质工程、动态监测及跨分子相互作用研究。然而，实现DEAL需确保编码子系统的高度正交性，尤其是在处理多个ncAA时，需克服亚基间的交叉反应问题。尽管存在挑战，但通过优化编码系统与tRNA的互作，GCE仍能提供高效率的标记方法。其在生物传感、材料科学及环境监测中的应用前景广阔，但需进一步验证其在复杂体系中的稳定性与可扩展性。
items.future_directions: 未来可检验的问题包括：如何通过优化GCE-based DEAL的orthogonality来提高编码效率和减少背景编码？此外，探索新的ncAA-aaRS配对以实现更广泛的互不干扰的编码系统也是关键方向。这些研究可通过实验验证，并进一步推动DEAL技术在生物系统中的应用。

fields.en:
Site-specific dual encoding and tagging through genetic code expansion is an important tool in chemical biology. This technology enables the specific incorporation of non-natural amino acids (ncAA) into proteins, and precise control through the dual encoding and tagging process (DEAL). In the DEAL process, two mutually orthogonal decoding systems are required to separately encode two different ncAA, which requires sufficient orthogonality between each ncAA-encoding system. This orthogonality is mainly reflected in three molecular recognition steps: ncAA-aaRS, aaRS-tRNA, and tRNA anti-codon-codon recognition. In these steps, it is necessary to ensure that the foreign ncAA-encoding system has sufficient orthogonality with the host system to avoid contamination of natural amino acids or unintended encoding. Furthermore, in the DEAL process, the orthogonality requirements for each ncAA-aaRS are higher, because if the selected aaRS has some activity towards certain natural amino acids, it may lead to background encoding even in the absence of ncAA. However, when there is sufficient relative orthogonality, effective encoding efficiency can be achieved even with lower absolute orthogonality. Therefore, when designing DEAL experiments, it is necessary to carefully evaluate the compatibility and orthogonality between ncAA-aaRS, and verify their relative orthogonality through experiments to ensure system stability and reliability. Furthermore, the orthogonality of aaRS-tRNA is also crucial, because if there is an overlap in identity factors between the two systems, it may lead to unintended encoding and decoding errors. Therefore, in practical applications, it is necessary to select ncAA-encoding systems with sufficient orthogonality and verify their compatibility and orthogonality through experiments to ensure system stability and reliability.

In the DEAL process, in addition to the orthogonality requirements for ncAA-aaRS and aaRS-tRNA, other factors such as permissivity (multispecificity) should also be considered. These factors may affect the mutual orthogonety between the two subsystems and may lead to coding errors or unexpected cross-reactions. Therefore, in practical applications, it is necessary to select ncAA-encoding subsystems with sufficient orthogonety and verify their compatibility and orthogonety experimentally to ensure the stability and reliability of the system.

In summary, the DEAL technology has broad application prospects in protein engineering and the design of biosensing platforms. The DEAL method achieved through gene code expansion provides a general and efficient strategy for protein labeling and manipulation, offering new tools and methods for studying protein interactions, dynamic monitoring, and the development of biosensors.

综上所述，DEAL技术在蛋白质工程和生物传感平台设计方面具有广泛的应用前景。通过基因密码扩展实现的DEAL方法能够提供一种通用且高效的蛋白质标记和操控策略，为研究蛋白质相互作用、动态监测以及生物传感器开发提供了新的工具和方法。

paragraphs.en: Site-specific dual encoding and tagging through genetic code expansion is an important tool in chemical biology. This technology enables the specific incorporation of non-natural amino acids (ncAA) into proteins, and precise control through the dual encoding and tagging process (DEAL). In the DEAL process, two mutually orthogonal decoding systems are required to separately encode two different ncAA, which requires sufficient orthogonality between each ncAA-encoding system. This orthogonality is mainly reflected in three molecular recognition steps: ncAA-aaRS, aaRS-tRNA, and tRNA anti-codon-codon recognition. In these steps, it is necessary to ensure that the foreign ncAA-encoding system has sufficient orthogonality with the host system to avoid contamination of natural amino acids or unintended encoding. Furthermore, in the DEAL process, the orthogonality requirements for each ncAA-aaRS are higher, because if the selected aaRS has some activity towards certain natural amino acids, it may lead to background encoding even in the absence of ncAA. However, when there is sufficient relative orthogonality, effective encoding efficiency can be achieved even with lower absolute orthogonality. Therefore, when designing DEAL experiments, it is necessary to carefully evaluate the compatibility and orthogonality between ncAA-aaRS, and verify their relative orthogonality through experiments to ensure system stability and reliability. Furthermore, the orthogonality of aaRS-tRNA is also crucial, because if there is an overlap in identity factors between the two systems, it may lead to unintended encoding and decoding errors. Therefore, in practical applications, it is necessary to select ncAA-encoding systems with sufficient orthogonality and verify their compatibility and orthogonality through experiments to ensure system stability and reliability.

Therefore, in practical applications, it is necessary to select ncAA-encoding subsystems with sufficient orthogonety and verify their compatibility and orthogonety experimentally to ensure the stability and reliability of the system.

paragraphs.en: In summary, the DEAL technology has broad application prospects in protein engineering and the design of biosensing platforms. The DEAL method achieved through gene code expansion provides a general and efficient strategy for protein labeling and manipulation, offering new tools and methods for studying protein interactions, dynamic monitoring, and the development of biosensors.

fields.en: The author proposes a hypothesis for achieving dual encoding and labeling (DEAL) through genetic code expansion (GCE) by summarizing existing literature. First, the author points out that selective modification of proteins in biological systems requires two steps: 1) biochemical encoding of two different bioorthogonal reaction groups; 2) selective labeling of these groups. Next, the author analyzes existing studies to summarize the basic principles of GCE-based DEAL and compatible encoding systems, and explores its potential applications. To ensure the accuracy of DEAL, the author emphasizes the importance of maintaining the orthogonality of the encoding subsystems, particularly when simultaneously encoding two different non-natural amino acids (ncAA), where higher orthogonality is needed to avoid cross-contamination. Additionally, the author notes that relative orthogonality is more important than absolute orthogonality in practice, as even if there is some insufficiency in absolute orthogonality, effective DEAL experiments can still be achieved as long as relative orthogonality is sufficient. Finally, the author analyzes existing studies to propose how to select and verify compatible encoding subsystems to ensure their orthogonality, and emphasizes the need for empirical testing of these subsystems in practical applications.
fields.zh: 作者通过总结现有文献，提出利用遗传密码扩展（GCE）实现双编码和标记（DEAL）的假说。首先，作者指出在生物系统中选择性修饰蛋白质需要两个步骤：1) 生化编码两种不同的生物正交反应基团；2) 选择性标记这些基团。接着，作者通过分析已有研究，总结了GCE-based DEAL的基本原理和兼容的编码系统，并探讨了其潜在应用。为确保DEAL的准确性，作者强调了保持编码子系统的正交性的重要性，特别是在同时编码两种不同非天然氨基酸（ncAA）时，需要更高的正交性以避免交叉污染。此外，作者指出在实际操作中，相对正交性比绝对正交性更重要，因为即使存在一定的绝对正交性不足，只要相对正交性足够，仍可实现有效的DEAL实验。最后，作者通过分析已有研究，提出如何选择和验证兼容的编码子系统以确保其正交性，并强调了在实际应用中需要对这些子系统进行实证检验。

fields.en: My conclusion is that in the DEAL experimental design, relative fidelity should be prioritized over absolute fidelity to ensure mutual non-interference between two different non-natural amino acid coding systems. This principle applies to protein engineering scenarios requiring multiple tags or functional modifications, but is constrained by the similarity of ncAA structures and host system compatibility.
fields.zh: 我的归纳是，DEAL实验设计中需优先考虑相对保真度而非绝对保真度，以确保两个不同非天然氨基酸编码子系统的互不干扰。此原则适用于需要多重标签或功能修饰的蛋白质工程场景，但受限于ncAA结构相似性及宿主系统兼容性的约束。

fields.label_en: Why selected and what is innovative
fields.label_zh: 推荐理由与创新点（详细）
fields.en:
This paper recommends the double encoding and labeling (DEAL) technology based on genetic code expansion (GCE), due to its significant advantages in achieving site-specific modification of proteins. By constructing two mutually orthogonal encoding subsystems, GCE can effectively avoid unintended incorporation of non-natural amino acids (ncAA) into target proteins, thereby improving the accuracy and reliability of experiments. This method is not only applicable for in vivo studies but can also reduce background noise by optimizing the orthogonality of encoding subsystems, thus enhancing labeling efficiency. Furthermore, GCE technology can achieve high specificity encoding of different ncAA through precise regulation of molecular recognition steps (such as ncAA-aaRS, aaRS-tRNA, and tRNA anticodon-codon recognition), providing more flexible application scenarios for multi-component systems. Compared to traditional pipeline work, the GCE method places greater emphasis on orthogonal control at the molecular level during design and implementation, rather than solely relying on journal evaluation or claims of global first. Therefore, this technology demonstrates unique value in protein engineering, biosensor development, and cross-species applications.

本文推荐基于遗传密码扩展（GCE）的双编码与标记（DEAL）技术，因其在实现蛋白质位点特异性修饰方面具有显著优势。通过构建两个相互正交的编码子系统，GCE能够有效避免非天然氨基酸（ncAA）在目标蛋白中的非预期掺入，从而提高实验的精确性和可靠性。该方法不仅适用于体内研究，还能通过优化编码子系统的正交性来降低背景噪声，提升标记效率。此外，GCE技术通过精细调控分子识别步骤（如ncAA-aaRS、aaRS-tRNA及tRNA anticodon-codon识别），能够实现对不同ncAA的高特异性编码，为多组分系统提供更灵活的应用场景。与传统流水线工作相比，GCE方法在设计和实施过程中更加注重分子层面的正交性控制，而非单纯依赖期刊评价或全球首次的宣称。因此，该技术在蛋白质工程、生物传感器开发及跨物种应用中展现出独特价值。

fields.en: This paper explores the prospects of genetic code expansion (GCE) in double encoding and labeling (DEAL), emphasizing its potential for precise modification in biological systems. By synthesizing two non-interfering non-natural amino acids (ncAA), GCE can effectively avoid structural and functional damage. This technology is applicable to protein engineering, dynamic monitoring, and studies of intermolecular interactions. However, achieving DEAL requires ensuring high orthogonality of the encoding subsystem, especially when handling multiple ncAA, necessitating overcoming cross-reactions between subunits. Despite challenges, GCE can still provide an efficient labeling method through optimization of the encoding system and interaction with tRNA. Its application prospects in biosensing, materials science, and environmental monitoring are broad, but further validation is needed to confirm its stability and scalability in complex systems.
fields.zh: 本文探讨了遗传密码扩展（GCE）在双编码与标记（DEAL）中的应用前景，强调其在生物系统中实现精准修饰的潜力。通过合成两种互不干扰的非天然氨基酸（ncAA），GCE能够有效避免结构和功能的破坏。该技术适用于蛋白质工程、动态监测及跨分子相互作用研究。然而，实现DEAL需确保编码子系统的高度正交性，尤其是在处理多个ncAA时，需克服亚基间的交叉反应问题。尽管存在挑战，但通过优化编码系统与tRNA的互作，GCE仍能提供高效率的标记方法。其在生物传感、材料科学及环境监测中的应用前景广阔，但需进一步验证其在复杂体系中的稳定性与可扩展性。

fields.en: Future testable questions include: How can the efficiency of encoding be improved and background encoding reduced by optimizing the orthogonality of GCE-based DEAL? Additionally, exploring new ncAA-aaRS pairs to achieve a more extensive non-interfering encoding system is also a key direction. These studies can be verified through experiments and further promote the application of DEAL technology in biological systems.

decisions.focus: Identifying the cellular targets of natural products using chemical proteomics approaches

This review provides a comprehensive overview of chemical proteomics approaches for identifying the cellular targets of natural products, focusing on bioorthogonal ligation chemistry and its application in probe design and validation. The text highlights the use of CuAAC as a key method for labeling and identifying protein binding partners of NPs, while also discussing alternative strategies such as photoaffinity labelling and activity-based protein profiling. The review emphasizes the importance of probe design, validation, and the challenges associated with identifying targets of non-covalent interactions.

化学蛋白质组学方法用于鉴定天然产物的细胞靶标。该综述讨论了利用化学探针识别天然产物在活体系统中与蛋白结合伙伴的相互作用。化学蛋白质组学方法通过将感兴趣的小分子功能化，添加标签以允许下游分析，并可能添加稳定分子与蛋白结合伙伴相互作用的处理。生物正交连接反应如铜催化的叠氮-炔烃环加成（CuAAC）被广泛使用，因其在生理条件下具有高选择性和高效性。然而，这种反应在固定细胞或裂解液中进行时可能会导致蛋白质聚集和沉淀，影响后续应用。此外，探针的标签需要经过清洗以避免干扰后续分析。对于某些特定情况，如分泌蛋白的标记，直接标记可能更有效。同时，利用内在化学反应性，如活性位点的亲核基团，可以开发出基于活动的蛋白质谱（ABPP）方法，用于识别天然产物与酶类的相互作用。此外，光交联技术也被用来识别非反应性的天然产物与蛋白结合伙伴的相互作用。综上所述，化学蛋白质组学方法在鉴定天然产物靶标方面具有重要价值，但其应用仍面临诸多挑战。

该方法的关键设计在于探针的设计和验证，通过生物正交连接反应如CuAAC实现小分子与目标蛋白的稳定结合，并利用标签进行后续分析。实验结果表明，这种方法能够有效识别天然产物与蛋白质的相互作用，但在实际应用中需要考虑探针的清洗步骤以及可能的干扰因素。此外，活性位点的亲核基团可以用于开发基于活动的蛋白质谱方法，以识别天然产物与特定酶类的相互作用。

综上所述，化学蛋白质组学方法在鉴定天然产物靶标方面具有重要价值，但其应用仍面临诸多挑战。该方法能够有效识别天然产物与蛋白质的相互作用，但在实际应用中需要考虑探针的清洗步骤以及可能的干扰因素。此外，活性位点的亲核基团可以用于开发基于活动的蛋白质谱方法，以识别天然产物与特定酶类的相互作用。
items.research_logic: 作者通过设计探针并逐步验证其与天然产物的相互作用来提出假说。首先，利用化学蛋白质组学方法，将探针功能化以稳定分子与靶蛋白的结合（p4）。接着，采用生物正交偶联反应如CuAAC，使探针能够被标记并用于后续分析（p4）。此方法具有高选择性和效率，但需注意毒性问题（p4）。随后，作者探讨了内在化学反应性在探针设计中的应用，通过ABPP策略识别靶蛋白（p6）。同时，使用光交联技术如PAL来识别非反应性天然产物的结合伙伴（p11）。最后，在探针验证阶段，通过生物活性实验直接比较探针与天然产物的效果，确保其保留相同的作用机制（p15）。综述分析通过组织和比较不同方法的优缺点，强调了探针设计、验证及生物正交偶联反应的重要性，以确保结果的准确性和可靠性。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，化学蛋白质组学在天然产物靶标鉴定中需平衡探针设计与验证的准确性。通过生物正交点击化学和光亲和标签技术，可有效识别蛋白结合伙伴，但需注意探针对目标蛋白的干扰及反应特异性。该方法适用于多种生物系统，尤其在活细胞环境中，但其应用受限于探针的稳定性和反应条件。
items.selection_reason: 本文推荐使用化学蛋白质组学方法识别天然产物的细胞靶标，因其能有效克服传统流水线工作的局限性。该方法通过设计探针，利用生物正交点击化学实现探针与目标蛋白的特异性结合，并通过后续分析确定其相互作用。文中提到的CuAAC反应具有高选择性和稳定性，适用于活细胞中的探针标记，且能减少对小分子结构的干扰，从而保留其生理特性。此外，该方法能够识别非共价结合的目标蛋白，如通过光亲和标签技术实现的PAL策略，进一步拓展了靶标鉴定的范围。文中强调，探针设计需考虑位置优化以避免生物活性扰动，并通过结构-活性关系信息指导探针修饰。综上所述，化学蛋白质组学方法在天然产物靶标识别中具有显著优势，其原理和应用均基于实际实验数据，符合科学规范。
items.application_prospects: 本文探讨了化学蛋白质组学在天然产物靶标识别中的应用前景。通过设计探针并利用生物正交偶联化学，可有效鉴定天然产物与蛋白的相互作用。该方法具有高灵敏度和特异性，适用于复杂细胞环境。然而，探针设计需考虑结构扰动及生物活性影响，且部分反应可能破坏目标蛋白或引起非特异性结合。在实际应用中，需优化探针标签以减少对细胞功能的影响，并确保实验条件的稳定性。该技术在药物开发、基础研究及疾病机制探索中有重要价值，但其实施依赖于精确的探针设计与验证流程。
items.future_directions: 本文探讨了化学蛋白质组学在识别天然产物细胞靶标中的应用，指出未来可检验的问题包括：如何优化生物正交连接反应以减少毒性并提高活细胞中探针的稳定性；以及开发更高效的标签策略以提升蛋白鉴定效率。此外，进一步研究不同探针对非共价结合靶标的适用性也是重要方向。

fields.en:
Chemical proteomics methods are used to identify cellular targets of natural products. This review discusses the use of chemical probes to identify interactions between natural products and protein partners in living systems. Chemical proteomics methods involve functionalizing the interested small molecules, adding tags to allow downstream analysis, and may also include processing to stabilize molecular interactions with protein partners. Bioorthogonal ligation reactions such as copper-catalyzed azide-alkyne cycloaddition (CuAAC) are widely used because they exhibit high selectivity and efficiency under physiological conditions. However, this reaction can lead to protein aggregation and precipitation when carried out in fixed cells or lysates, affecting subsequent applications. Additionally, the tags on probes need to be cleaned to avoid interfering with subsequent analysis. For certain specific cases, such as labeling secreted proteins, direct tagging may be more effective. At the same time, utilizing intrinsic chemical reactivity, such as nucleophilic groups at active sites, can develop activity-based proteomic (ABPP) methods for identifying interactions between natural products and enzymes. Furthermore, photo-crosslinking techniques have also been used to identify interactions between non-reactive natural products and protein partners. In conclusion, chemical proteomics methods hold significant value in identifying targets of natural products, but their application still faces many challenges.

The key design of this method lies in the design and validation of probes, achieving stable binding between small molecules and target proteins through bioorthogonal click reactions such as CuAAC, and utilizing tags for subsequent analysis. Experimental results show that this method can effectively identify interactions between natural products and proteins, but in practical applications, considerations must be made regarding probe cleaning steps and potential interfering factors. Additionally, nucleophilic groups at the active site can be used to develop activity-based protein profiling methods to identify interactions between natural products and specific enzyme classes.

In summary, chemical proteomics methods have significant value in identifying natural product targets, but their application still faces many challenges. The method can effectively identify interactions between natural products and proteins, but in practical applications, considerations must be made regarding the cleaning steps of probes and potential interfering factors. Additionally, nucleophilic groups at active sites can be used to develop activity-based proteomic methods for identifying interactions between natural products and specific enzyme classes.

paragraphs.en: Chemical proteomics methods are used to identify cellular targets of natural products. This review discusses the use of chemical probes to identify interactions between natural products and protein partners in living systems. Chemical proteomics methods involve functionalizing the interested small molecules, adding tags to allow downstream analysis, and may also include processing to stabilize molecular interactions with protein partners. Bioorthogonal ligation reactions such as copper-catalyzed azide-alkyne cycloaddition (CuAAC) are widely used because they exhibit high selectivity and efficiency under physiological conditions. However, this reaction can lead to protein aggregation and precipitation when carried out in fixed cells or lysates, affecting subsequent applications. Additionally, the tags on probes need to be cleaned to avoid interfering with subsequent analysis. For certain specific cases, such as labeling secreted proteins, direct tagging may be more effective. At the same time, utilizing intrinsic chemical reactivity, such as nucleophilic groups at active sites, can develop activity-based proteomic (ABPP) methods for identifying interactions between natural products and enzymes. Furthermore, photo-crosslinking techniques have also been used to identify interactions between non-reactive natural products and protein partners. In conclusion, chemical proteomics methods hold significant value in identifying targets of natural products, but their application still faces many challenges.
paragraphs.zh: 化学蛋白质组学方法用于鉴定天然产物的细胞靶标。该综述讨论了利用化学探针识别天然产物在活体系统中与蛋白结合伙伴的相互作用。化学蛋白质组学方法通过将感兴趣的小分子功能化，添加标签以允许下游分析，并可能添加稳定分子与蛋白结合伙伴相互作用的处理。生物正交连接反应如铜催化的叠氮-炔烃环加成（CuAAC）被广泛使用，因其在生理条件下具有高选择性和高效性。然而，这种反应在固定细胞或裂解液中进行时可能会导致蛋白质聚集和沉淀，影响后续应用。此外，探针的标签需要经过清洗以避免干扰后续分析。对于某些特定情况，如分泌蛋白的标记，直接标记可能更有效。同时，利用内在化学反应性，如活性位点的亲核基团，可以开发出基于活动的蛋白质谱（ABPP）方法，用于识别天然产物与酶类的相互作用。此外，光交联技术也被用来识别非反应性的天然产物与蛋白结合伙伴的相互作用。综上所述，化学蛋白质组学方法在鉴定天然产物靶标方面具有重要价值，但其应用仍面临诸多挑战。

Experimental results show that this method can effectively identify interactions between natural products and proteins, but in practical applications, considerations must be made regarding probe cleaning steps and potential interfering factors. Additionally, nucleophilic groups at the active site can be used to develop activity-based protein profiling methods to identify interactions between natural products and specific enzyme classes.

fields.en: The author proposes a hypothesis by designing probes and gradually verifying their interactions with natural products. First, using chemical proteomics methods, the probe is functionalized to stabilize the interaction between molecules and target proteins (p4). Next, bioorthogonal coupling reactions such as CuAAC are employed to enable the probe to be labeled and used for subsequent analysis (p4). This method exhibits high selectivity and efficiency, but toxicity issues should be noted (p4). Subsequently, the author explores the application of intrinsic chemical reactivity in probe design, using the ABPP strategy to identify target proteins (p6). At the same time, light cross-linking techniques such as PAL are used to identify binding partners of non-reactive natural products (p11). Finally, during the probe validation stage, biological activity experiments directly compare the effects of the probe and natural products to ensure that they retain the same mechanism of action (p15). The review analysis organizes and compares the advantages and disadvantages of different methods, emphasizing the importance of probe design, validation, and bioorthogonal coupling reactions to ensure the accuracy and reliability of results.
fields.zh: 作者通过设计探针并逐步验证其与天然产物的相互作用来提出假说。首先，利用化学蛋白质组学方法，将探针功能化以稳定分子与靶蛋白的结合（p4）。接着，采用生物正交偶联反应如CuAAC，使探针能够被标记并用于后续分析（p4）。此方法具有高选择性和效率，但需注意毒性问题（p4）。随后，作者探讨了内在化学反应性在探针设计中的应用，通过ABPP策略识别靶蛋白（p6）。同时，使用光交联技术如PAL来识别非反应性天然产物的结合伙伴（p11）。最后，在探针验证阶段，通过生物活性实验直接比较探针与天然产物的效果，确保其保留相同的作用机制（p15）。综述分析通过组织和比较不同方法的优缺点，强调了探针设计、验证及生物正交偶联反应的重要性，以确保结果的准确性和可靠性。

fields.en: My conclusion is that chemical proteomics needs to balance the accuracy of probe design and validation in the identification of natural product targets. Through bioorthogonal click chemistry and photoaffinity labeling techniques, protein binding partners can be effectively identified, but attention should be paid to the interference of probes with target proteins and reaction specificity. This method is applicable to various biological systems, particularly in live cell environments, but its application is limited by the stability of the probe and reaction conditions.
fields.zh: 我的归纳是，化学蛋白质组学在天然产物靶标鉴定中需平衡探针设计与验证的准确性。通过生物正交点击化学和光亲和标签技术，可有效识别蛋白结合伙伴，但需注意探针对目标蛋白的干扰及反应特异性。该方法适用于多种生物系统，尤其在活细胞环境中，但其应用受限于探针的稳定性和反应条件。

fields.label_en: Why selected and what is innovative
fields.label_zh: 推荐理由与创新点（详细）
fields.en: This paper recommends the use of chemical proteomics methods to identify cellular targets of natural products, as they can effectively overcome the limitations of traditional pipeline approaches. The method involves designing probes that specifically bind to target proteins through bioorthogonal click chemistry, and subsequent analysis is used to determine their interactions. The CuAAC reaction mentioned in the text has high selectivity and stability, making it suitable for probe labeling in live cells and reducing interference with small molecular structures, thereby preserving their physiological properties. Furthermore, this method can identify non-covalently bound target proteins, such as those achieved through the PAL strategy using photoaffinity labels, further expanding the range of target identification. The text emphasizes that probe design should consider positional optimization to avoid perturbation of biological activity, and structural-activity relationship information should guide probe modification. In conclusion, chemical proteomics methods have significant advantages in identifying targets of natural products, with their principles and applications based on actual experimental data, conforming to scientific standards.
fields.zh: 本文推荐使用化学蛋白质组学方法识别天然产物的细胞靶标，因其能有效克服传统流水线工作的局限性。该方法通过设计探针，利用生物正交点击化学实现探针与目标蛋白的特异性结合，并通过后续分析确定其相互作用。文中提到的CuAAC反应具有高选择性和稳定性，适用于活细胞中的探针标记，且能减少对小分子结构的干扰，从而保留其生理特性。此外，该方法能够识别非共价结合的目标蛋白，如通过光亲和标签技术实现的PAL策略，进一步拓展了靶标鉴定的范围。文中强调，探针设计需考虑位置优化以避免生物活性扰动，并通过结构-活性关系信息指导探针修饰。综上所述，化学蛋白质组学方法在天然产物靶标识别中具有显著优势，其原理和应用均基于实际实验数据，符合科学规范。

fields.en: This paper explores the prospects of chemical proteomics in target identification for natural products. By designing probes and utilizing bioorthogonal coupling chemistry, natural products can be effectively identified for their interactions with proteins. This method offers high sensitivity and specificity, making it suitable for complex cellular environments. However, probe design must consider structural perturbations and biological activity effects, as some reactions may damage the target protein or cause non-specific binding. In practical applications, probes should be optimized to minimize impact on cellular functions and ensure experimental conditions are stable. This technology holds significant value in drug development, basic research, and exploration of disease mechanisms, but its implementation depends on precise probe design and validation processes.
fields.zh: 本文探讨了化学蛋白质组学在天然产物靶标识别中的应用前景。通过设计探针并利用生物正交偶联化学，可有效鉴定天然产物与蛋白的相互作用。该方法具有高灵敏度和特异性，适用于复杂细胞环境。然而，探针设计需考虑结构扰动及生物活性影响，且部分反应可能破坏目标蛋白或引起非特异性结合。在实际应用中，需优化探针标签以减少对细胞功能的影响，并确保实验条件的稳定性。该技术在药物开发、基础研究及疾病机制探索中有重要价值，但其实施依赖于精确的探针设计与验证流程。

fields.en: This paper explores the application of chemical proteomics in identifying cellular targets of natural products, highlighting future testable questions including: how to optimize bioorthogonal ligation reactions to reduce toxicity and enhance the stability of probes in live cells; and the development of more efficient labeling strategies to improve protein identification efficiency. Additionally, further research into the applicability of different probes for non-covalent target interactions is an important direction.
fields.zh: 本文探讨了化学蛋白质组学在识别天然产物细胞靶标中的应用，指出未来可检验的问题包括：如何优化生物正交连接反应以减少毒性并提高活细胞中探针的稳定性；以及开发更高效的标签策略以提升蛋白鉴定效率。此外，进一步研究不同探针对非共价结合靶标的适用性也是重要方向。

decisions.focus: Nanoparticle‐mediated drug delivery to lung endothelium for therapeutic intervention in PARDS

The study presents a novel nanoparticle-based drug delivery system (LEDD) that effectively targets lung endothelial cells for the delivery of a small-molecule compound, TanFe[F], which prevents FOXF1 protein degradation and enhances its expression in lung endothelial cells. This targeted delivery approach shows promise in improving survival in a PARDS mouse model, demonstrating the potential of nanoparticle-mediated drug delivery to specific cell types in the lungs. The work is supported by both in vitro and in vivo experiments showing increased FOXF1 levels and improved vascular repair.

classification_audit.abstract: ABSTRACT Drug delivery precisely to the pulmonary vasculature represents a formidable challenge. Pediatric Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (PARDS) is an urgent public health concern accounting for high mortality and long‐term morbidity due to severe damage to lung endothelial cells (ECs). Advanced target‐specific therapeutic interventions to protect lung vasculature in PARDS are in dire need. FOXF1 protein is a critical mediator of lung angiogenesis and vascular repair after injury. However, whether FOXF1 is a useful pharmacological target for PARDS is unknown. Herein, we developed a universal nanoparticle‐based Lung Endothelial Drug Delivery (LEDD) system to deliver hydrophobic small‐molecule compounds specifically to lung ECs but not to other cells or organs. Based on single‐cell RNA sequencing, FOXF1 expression was decreased in lung ECs in the mouse PARDS model. We used LEDD nanoparticles to restore FOXF1 by delivering a novel FOXF1‐activating compound, TanFe[F], which prevents FOXF1 protein degradation. LEDD‐TanFe[F] treatment increased FOXF1 protein and its activity in lung ECs in vitro and in vivo. LEDD‐TanFe[F] treatment was non‐toxic, well‐tolerated, and improved mice survival in the PARDS model. LEDD‐TanFe[F] reduced endothelial permeability, improved vascular repair, and alveolarization in injured neonatal lungs. LEDD‐supported drug delivery precisely to lung ECs is a promising therapeutic approach in PARDS. Keywords: endothelial cells, FOXF1 transcription factor, nanoparticle drug delivery, neonatal angiogenesis and alveolarization, neonatal lung injury

肺泡内皮细胞（ECs）在急性呼吸窘迫综合征（ARDS）中扮演关键角色，其功能障碍与血管通透性异常和非心源性肺水肿密切相关。本研究开发了一种通用的纳米粒子系统——肺内皮药物递送（LEDD）系统，旨在将疏水性小分子化合物精准递送至肺部内皮细胞，而不影响其他细胞或器官。通过单细胞RNA测序分析发现，在小鼠ARDS模型中，肺泡内皮细胞中FOXF1及其靶基因表达显著下降。研究团队利用LEDD纳米粒子递送新型FOXF1激活化合物TanFe[F]，该化合物可防止FOXF1蛋白降解，从而在体内外均提高其水平和活性。LEDD-TanFe[F]治疗被证明是非毒性的，并能改善小鼠生存率，减少内皮通透性，促进血管修复和肺泡化。此外，该系统在体内有效递送药物至肺部内皮细胞，为ARDS提供了一种有前景的治疗方法。

LEDD系统基于聚β-氨基酯（PBAE）纳米粒子，其疏水骨架末端连接亲水性的聚乙二醇（PEG）尾，可通过静脉途径实现对肺部内皮细胞的通用药物递送。研究团队通过单细胞RNA测序分析发现，在LPS损伤模型中，FOXF1及其靶基因在内皮细胞亚群中的表达显著下降。TanFe[F]可有效提高FOXF1蛋白水平，并且在体内外均显示出良好的生物相容性和安全性。

实验结果表明，LEDD-TanFe[F]治疗能够显著改善小鼠生存率，减少肺部损伤并促进血管修复和肺泡化。该系统不仅具有高特异性，而且具备良好的生物相容性，为ARDS的治疗提供了新的思路和方法。
items.research_logic: 作者提出假说：FOXF1是PARDS中保护肺血管的关键靶点，通过开发LEDD系统实现精准药物递送。验证过程包括单细胞RNA测序显示LPS损伤降低FOXF1表达，TanFe[F]可提升其蛋白水平。排除替代解释通过纳米粒子递送特异性靶向肺内皮细胞，避免其他组织摄取。综述分析通过比较不同载体的递送效率和毒性，确认LEDD系统在体内和体外均有效提高FOXF1活性并改善存活率。每一步验证均基于实验数据，确保结论可靠性。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，基于单细胞RNA测序和纳米粒子药物递送技术，开发了一种针对肺内皮细胞的通用药物输送系统，能够有效恢复FOXF1蛋白水平，从而改善肺血管修复和肺泡化。该实验设计的核心在于利用特定纳米载体实现靶向递送，避免其他细胞或器官的非目标摄取，适用于需要精准靶向治疗的疾病模型。此方法在PARDS中显示出良好的疗效和安全性，但其适用性受限于纳米载体对目标细胞的特异性及药物的物理化学性质。
items.selection_reason: 本研究开发的LEDD系统通过纳米颗粒实现精准将药物递送至肺内皮细胞，有效恢复FOXF1蛋白水平，改善PARDS模型中肺血管损伤。该系统利用PBAE纳米颗粒，具有良好的生物相容性和低毒性，能特异性靶向肺内皮细胞，避免其他细胞或器官的非目标摄取。通过单细胞RNA测序发现，LPS损伤导致肺内皮细胞中FOXF1及靶基因表达下降，而LEDD-TanFe[F]治疗可显著提升FOXF1蛋白水平和活性，改善血管修复与肺泡化。该系统在体内实验中表现出良好的耐受性和治疗效果，提高PARDS模型小鼠存活率，且无明显毒性反应。LEDD系统通过特异性靶向内皮细胞实现精准药物递送，突破传统流水线工作模式，提供新的治疗策略。
items.application_prospects: 本文开发的LEDD系统通过纳米颗粒实现精准将药物递送至肺内皮细胞，用于治疗PARDS。该系统利用PBAE纳米颗粒在体内有效递送TanFe[F]，提高FOXF1蛋白水平，改善肺内皮功能和血管修复。实验表明，LEDD-TanFe[F]治疗可显著提升小鼠生存率，减少肺泡化程度，且无明显毒性。该技术在肺部疾病治疗中具有应用前景，但需进一步验证其临床转化条件及安全性。
items.future_directions: 本文开发的LEDD系统通过纳米颗粒实现精准将TanFe[F]递送至肺内皮细胞，有效恢复FOXF1蛋白水平并改善PARDS模型中肺血管损伤。未来可进一步研究LEDD系统在其他肺部疾病中的应用潜力，并探索其在不同动物模型中的疗效一致性。此外，需验证LEDD系统在长期治疗中的安全性及对其他器官的潜在影响。

fields.en:
Alveolar endothelial cells (ECs) play a critical role in acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS), with their dysfunction closely related to abnormal vascular permeability and non-cardiogenic pulmonary edema. This study developed a general nanoparticle system - lung endothelial drug delivery (LEDD) system, aimed at precisely delivering hydrophobic small molecular compounds to alveolar endothelial cells without affecting other cells or organs. Through single-cell RNA sequencing analysis, it was found that in mouse ARDS models, the expression of FOXF1 and its target genes in alveolar endothelial cells significantly decreased. The research team used LEDD nanoparticles to deliver a novel FOXF1-activating compound TanFe[F], which can prevent the degradation of the FOXF1 protein, thereby increasing its level and activity both in vivo and in vitro. The LEDD-TanFe[F] treatment was proven to be non-toxic and could improve mouse survival rates, reduce endothelial permeability, promote vascular repair, and alveolarization. In addition, this system effectively delivers drugs to pulmonary endothelial cells in vivo, providing a promising treatment for ARDS.

The LEDD system is based on poly(beta-amino ester) (PBAE) nanoparticles, with hydrophobic skeletons connected to hydrophilic polyethylene glycol (PEG) tails, allowing for general drug delivery to pulmonary endothelial cells via intravenous administration. The research team found through single-cell RNA sequencing analysis that in LPS injury models, the expression of FOXF1 and its target genes in endothelial cell subpopulations significantly decreased. TanFe[F] can effectively increase the level of FOXF1 protein and shows good biocompatibility and safety both in vivo and in vitro.

The experimental results showed that LEDD-TanFe[F] treatment could significantly improve mouse survival rates, reduce lung damage, and promote vascular repair and alveolarization. This system not only has high specificity but also good biocompatibility, providing new ideas and methods for the treatment of ARDS.

fields.en: The authors proposed a hypothesis: FOXF1 is a key target in PARDS for protecting pulmonary vascular endothelial cells, achieved through the development of the LEDD system for precise drug delivery. The validation process included single-cell RNA sequencing showing that LPS injury reduces FOXF1 expression, while TanFe[F] increases its protein level. Alternative explanations were ruled out by using nanoparticles for specific targeting of pulmonary endothelial cells, avoiding uptake in other tissues. A review analysis compared the delivery efficiency and toxicity of different carriers, confirming that the LEDD system effectively enhances FOXF1 activity and improves survival rates both in vivo and in vitro. Each step of validation was based on experimental data to ensure the reliability of the conclusions.

paragraphs.en: The authors proposed a hypothesis: FOXF1 is a key target in PARDS for protecting pulmonary vascular endothelial cells, achieved through the development of the LEDD system for precise drug delivery. The validation process included single-cell RNA sequencing showing that LPS injury reduces FOXF1 expression, while TanFe[F] increases its protein level. Alternative explanations were ruled out by using nanoparticles for specific targeting of pulmonary endothelial cells, avoiding uptake in other tissues. A review analysis compared the delivery efficiency and toxicity of different carriers, confirming that the LEDD system effectively enhances FOXF1 activity and improves survival rates both in vivo and in vitro. Each step of validation was based on experimental data to ensure the reliability of the conclusions.

fields.en: My conclusion is that, based on single-cell RNA sequencing and nanoparticle drug delivery technology, a universal drug delivery system targeting pulmonary endothelial cells has been developed, which can effectively restore FOXF1 protein levels, thereby improving lung vascular repair and alveolarization. The core of this experimental design lies in utilizing specific nanocarriers for targeted delivery, avoiding non-target uptake by other cells or organs, making it suitable for disease models requiring precise targeting. This method has shown good efficacy and safety in PARDS, but its applicability is limited by the specificity of nanocarriers toward target cells and the physicochemical properties of the drug.

fields.label_en: Why selected and what is innovative
fields.label_zh: 推荐理由与创新点（详细）
fields.en: The LEDD system developed in this study precisely delivers drugs to pulmonary endothelial cells through nanoparticles, effectively restoring the level of FOXF1 protein and improving vascular damage in the PARDS model. The system utilizes PBAE nanoparticles, which exhibit good biocompatibility and low toxicity, allowing specific targeting of pulmonary endothelial cells and avoiding non-target uptake by other cells or organs. Single-cell RNA sequencing revealed that LPS injury led to a decrease in FOXF1 and target gene expression in pulmonary endothelial cells, while LEDD-TanFe[F] treatment significantly increased the level and activity of FOXF1 protein, improving vascular repair and alveolarization. The system demonstrated good tolerance and therapeutic effects in in vivo experiments, increasing the survival rate of mice in the PARDS model without significant toxic reactions. The LEDD system achieves precise drug delivery by specifically targeting endothelial cells, breaking away from traditional pipeline work models, and providing a new treatment strategy.

fields.en: The LEDD system developed in this study precisely delivers drugs to pulmonary endothelial cells using nanoparticles for the treatment of PARDS. The system utilizes PBAE nanoparticles to effectively deliver TanFe[F] in vivo, increasing the level of the FOXF1 protein, improving pulmonary endothelial function, and enhancing vascular repair. Experimental results show that LEDD-TanFe[F] treatment significantly improves mouse survival rates, reduces alveolarization, and exhibits no significant toxicity. This technology has potential applications in the treatment of lung diseases, but further validation is needed to confirm its clinical translation and safety.

decisions.focus: Performance evaluation of atom-mapping models on diverse chemical spaces

The study presents an updated evaluation of RXNMapper-v2, focusing on improving atom-to-atom mapping (AAM) accuracy through a refined validation set and enhanced model selection. The work addresses the limitations of previous AAM models by introducing a reaction graph isomorphism-based comparison framework that avoids false negatives from inconsistent formats and symmetry-equivalent mappings. The updated models outperform both the original RXNMapper and LocalMapper across multiple benchmarks, demonstrating improved performance in atom-mapping tasks. However, challenges such as persistent rearrangements remain, highlighting areas for future improvement.

classification_audit.abstract: Atom-to-atom mapping (AAM) assigns reactant atoms to product atoms and is fundamental for reaction classification, template extraction, and synthesis planning. RXNMapper derives AAM from the attention weights of a transformer model trained by masked language modeling on unmapped reaction SMILES. However, its original model selection relied on USPTO-50K, a validation set later shown to contain erroneous mappings. Here we revisit RXNMapper using a curated validation set of 4′533 reactions from the dataset Pistachio. We retrained ALBERT-based RXNMapper models on USPTO-full and Pistachio and selected the best head, layer, and checkpoint on this new validation set. To improve the comparison of AAM algorithms, we developed an evaluation framework that removes ambiguous reference reactions and compares predictions based on reaction graph isomorphism rather than direct string matching, avoiding false negatives from inconsistent formats and symmetry-equivalent mappings. Across the golden dataset, Pistachio, and an internal AstraZeneca medicinal chemistry benchmark, the updated models outperform the original RXNMapper and LocalMapper, while rearrangements remain persistent challenges.

items.action: 原子到原子映射（AAM）是化学信息学中的基本操作，它描述了反应过程中原子的重新分布。AAM的准确性对下游任务如反应搜索、反应分类、计算机辅助合成规划以及模板自由应用（如反应中心标记、反应分词和反应表示学习用于性质预测）都有重要影响。RXNMapper通过训练基于Transformer模型的掩码语言模型，从未映射的反应SMILES中提取AAM，但其原始模型选择依赖于USPTO-50K验证集，该集后来被发现包含错误的映射。本文重新审视RXNMapper，使用Pistachio数据集中的4′533个反应作为验证集，并在USPTO-full和Pistachio上重新训练ALBERT-based RXNMapper模型，选择最佳头、层和检查点。为提高AAM算法的比较，开发了基于反应图同构而非直接字符串匹配的评估框架，避免因格式不一致和对称等价映射导致的假阴性。在黄金数据集、Pistachio和内部阿斯利康药物化学基准上，更新后的模型优于原始RXNMapper和LocalMapper，但重排仍是一个挑战。
items.research_logic: 作者提出假说通过重新审视RXNMapper方法，使用Pistachio数据集进行模型选择和验证。首先建立基于反应图同构的评估框架以避免误判，随后在USPTO-full和Pistachio上重新训练ALBERT-based RXNMapper模型，并在Pistachio验证集上选择最佳头、层和检查点配置。为提高AAM算法比较的准确性，开发了基于反应图同构而非字符串匹配的评估框架，以避免因格式不一致或对称等价映射导致的假阴性。通过对比黄金数据集、Pistachio测试集和内部AstraZeneca数据集，发现更新后的RXNMapper模型在多个数据集上均优于原模型和LocalMapper。为确保可重复性，提供了训练脚本、模型选择流程、更新的检查点和评估框架。综述分析通过比较不同反应类别的错误率，指出未来应重点改进常见且易错的反应类型，并探讨了机械挑战性的原子映射案例。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，RXNMapper-v2通过改进的验证集和评价框架，在原子映射任务中表现出更优性能。该模型在选择最佳头、层和检查点时，采用反应图同构性比较而非直接字符串匹配，有效避免了因格式不一致或对称等价映射导致的误判。此机制可迁移至其他需要处理化学空间广泛性的任务中，但需注意数据集的代表性与格式一致性问题。
items.selection_reason: RXNMapper-v2通过改进的验证集和评估框架，显著提升了原子映射的准确性。该模型基于ALBERT架构重新训练，并在更广泛的化学空间中进行优化，有效解决了传统方法中存在的错误映射问题。通过使用Pistachio数据集进行模型选择，确保了模型配置的最佳性。同时，改进的评估方法采用反应图同构比对而非直接字符串匹配，避免了因格式不一致导致的误判。在多个基准测试中，更新后的RXNMapper模型均优于原始版本和LocalMapper，特别是在处理复杂反应类型时表现出色。该研究强调了模型选择与训练数据质量对性能的影响，并指出未来应针对常见且易错的反应类别进行优化。
items.application_prospects: 本文更新了RXNMapper模型，通过改进的验证集和训练方法提升了原子映射的准确性。新模型在多个化学空间中表现优于原有模型，但重组反应仍为挑战。其应用前景在于合成、催化及材料领域，需确保数据质量和算法鲁棒性。
items.future_directions: 未来研究可聚焦于机械上具有挑战性的原子映射案例，如重排反应和Mitsunobu酯合成，以改进模型对复杂反应类型的处理能力。此外，应进一步探索不同化学空间中模型性能的差异，并优化反应类别的错误率。这些方向有助于提升原子映射算法在实际应用中的可靠性与准确性。
