fields.en: Atom-to-atom mapping (AAM) is a fundamental operation in chemical informatics, describing the redistribution of atoms during a reaction. The accuracy of AAM has significant impacts on downstream tasks such as reaction searching, reaction classification, computer-aided synthesis planning, and template-free applications (such as reaction center tagging, reaction tokenization, and reaction representation learning for property prediction). RXNMapper extracts AAM from un-mapped reactions by training a masked language model based on Transformer models, but its original model selection relied on the USPTO-50K validation set, which was later found to contain erroneous mappings. This paper re-examines RXNMapper, using 4'533 reactions from the Pistachio dataset as a validation set, and re-trains the ALBERT-based RXNMapper model on both USPTO-full and Pistachio, selecting the best head, layer, and checkpoint. To improve the comparison of AAM algorithms, an evaluation framework based on reaction graph isomorphism rather than direct string matching was developed to avoid false negatives caused by inconsistent formatting and symmetric equivalent mappings. On gold datasets, Pistachio, and internal AstraZeneca drug chemistry benchmarks, the updated model outperforms the original RXNMapper and LocalMapper, but rearrangement remains a challenge.
fields.zh: 原子到原子映射（AAM）是化学信息学中的基本操作，它描述了反应过程中原子的重新分布。AAM的准确性对下游任务如反应搜索、反应分类、计算机辅助合成规划以及模板自由应用（如反应中心标记、反应分词和反应表示学习用于性质预测）都有重要影响。RXNMapper通过训练基于Transformer模型的掩码语言模型，从未映射的反应SMILES中提取AAM，但其原始模型选择依赖于USPTO-50K验证集，该集后来被发现包含错误的映射。本文重新审视RXNMapper，使用Pistachio数据集中的4′533个反应作为验证集，并在USPTO-full和Pistachio上重新训练ALBERT-based RXNMapper模型，选择最佳头、层和检查点。为提高AAM算法的比较，开发了基于反应图同构而非直接字符串匹配的评估框架，避免因格式不一致和对称等价映射导致的假阴性。在黄金数据集、Pistachio和内部阿斯利康药物化学基准上，更新后的模型优于原始RXNMapper和LocalMapper，但重排仍是一个挑战。

fields.en: The authors propose a hypothesis by revisiting the RXNMapper method, using the Pistachio dataset for model selection and validation. First, an evaluation framework based on reaction graph isomorphism is established to avoid false positives, followed by retraining of the ALBERT-based RXNMapper model on USPTO-full and Pistachio, and selecting the optimal head, layer, and checkpoint configuration on the Pistachio validation set. To improve the accuracy of AAM algorithm comparisons, a new evaluation framework based on reaction graph isomorphism rather than string matching is developed to avoid false negatives caused by inconsistent formatting or symmetric equivalence mappings. Through comparison with the gold dataset, Pistachio test set, and internal AstraZeneca data set, it is found that the updated RXNMapper model outperforms the original model and LocalMapper on multiple datasets. To ensure reproducibility, training scripts, model selection process, updated checkpoints, and the evaluation framework are provided. The review analysis through comparing error rates across different reaction categories highlights the need for future focus on common and error-prone reaction types, and explores mechanically challenging atom mapping cases.

fields.en: My conclusion is that RXNMapper-v2 demonstrates superior performance in the atom mapping task by using an improved validation set and evaluation framework. When selecting the best head, layer, and checkpoint, the model uses reaction graph isomorphism comparison instead of direct string matching, effectively avoiding misjudgment caused by inconsistent formatting or symmetric equivalence mappings. This mechanism can be transferred to other tasks requiring processing of extensive chemical spaces, but attention should be paid to issues of dataset representativeness and format consistency.

fields.label_en: Why selected and what is innovative
fields.label_zh: 推荐理由与创新点（详细）
fields.en: RXNMapper-v2 significantly improves the accuracy of atomic mapping through an improved validation set and evaluation framework. The model is retrained based on the ALBERT architecture and optimized across a broader chemical space, effectively addressing the error mapping issues present in traditional methods. Model selection is performed using the Pistachio dataset to ensure optimal model configuration. Meanwhile, the improved evaluation method uses reaction graph isomorphism comparison instead of direct string matching, avoiding misjudgment caused by inconsistent formatting. In multiple benchmark tests, the updated RXNMapper model outperforms both the original version and LocalMapper, particularly excelling in handling complex reaction types. This study emphasizes the impact of model selection and training data quality on performance and highlights the need for future optimization targeting common and error-prone reaction categories.

Its application prospects lie in synthesis, catalysis, and materials fields, requiring ensuring data quality and algorithm robustness.
paragraphs.zh: 本文更新了RXNMapper模型，通过改进的验证集和训练方法提升了原子映射的准确性。新模型在多个化学空间中表现优于原有模型，但重组反应仍为挑战。其应用前景在于合成、催化及材料领域，需确保数据质量和算法鲁棒性。

fields.en: Future research could focus on challenging atomic mapping cases in terms of mechanics, such as rearrangement reactions and Mitsunobu ester synthesis, to improve the model's ability to handle complex reaction types. Additionally, it is necessary to further explore the differences in model performance across different chemical spaces and optimize the error rate for reaction categories. These directions will help enhance the reliability and accuracy of atomic mapping algorithms in practical applications.
fields.zh: 未来研究可聚焦于机械上具有挑战性的原子映射案例，如重排反应和Mitsunobu酯合成，以改进模型对复杂反应类型的处理能力。此外，应进一步探索不同化学空间中模型性能的差异，并优化反应类别的错误率。这些方向有助于提升原子映射算法在实际应用中的可靠性与准确性。

decisions.focus: Controlled drug delivery vehicles for cancer treatment and their performance

The article discusses the development and performance of various drug delivery vehicles for cancer treatment, focusing on nanocarriers and their ability to improve therapeutic efficacy while reducing side effects. The review highlights the challenges in chemotherapy and presents current advancements in drug delivery systems, emphasizing the importance of targeted delivery and improved bioavailability.

classification_audit.abstract: Abstract Although conventional chemotherapy has been successful to some extent, the main drawbacks of chemotherapy are its poor bioavailability, high-dose requirements, adverse side effects, low therapeutic indices, development of multiple drug resistance, and non-specific targeting. The main aim in the development of drug delivery vehicles is to successfully address these delivery-related problems and carry drugs to the desired sites of therapeutic action while reducing adverse side effects. In this review, we will discuss the different types of materials used as delivery vehicles for chemotherapeutic agents and their structural characteristics that improve the therapeutic efficacy of their drugs and will describe recent scientific advances in the area of chemotherapy, emphasizing challenges in cancer treatments.

items.action: 癌症治疗中，传统化疗虽然在一定程度上取得成功，但其生物利用度低、剂量要求高、副作用大、疗效指数低、多重耐药性发展和非特异性靶向等问题限制了其应用。因此，开发能够主动或被动靶向癌细胞的药物递送系统成为提高治疗效果并减少副作用的关键。近年来，随着对肿瘤生物学的理解加深以及多种材料（如聚合物、脂质、无机载体、聚meric水凝胶和生物大分子支架）的广泛应用，新型药物递送系统得以发展，能够更有效地将化疗药物递送到肿瘤部位。纳米技术的发展为癌症治疗带来了深远影响，特别是纳米尺度的药物载体在提高疗效的同时避免了对正常细胞的毒性。例如，脂质体、聚合物纳米颗粒和微球等纳米载体因其独特的物理化学性质，在靶向输送、实时监测和分子成像方面展现出巨大潜力。然而，这些纳米载体仍面临生物降解性差、生物利用度低、循环稳定性不足以及潜在毒性的挑战。此外，癌症耐药性是治疗失败的主要原因，因此需要更高效的药物递送系统来实现精准治疗。通过自组装技术构建的生物活性材料能够根据环境条件（如pH值、离子强度等）调节结构特性，从而提高药物在肿瘤部位的积累效率。水凝胶作为药物递送载体，能够在特定条件下控制药物释放，进一步提升治疗效果。
items.research_logic: 作者通过分析传统化疗的缺点，提出开发能够主动或被动靶向癌细胞的药物递送系统以减少副作用并提高疗效。在文献中，作者首先指出化疗的生物利用度低、剂量高、毒性大等问题，并强调了肿瘤治疗中的挑战。接着，作者讨论了多种材料作为药物载体的应用，包括聚合物、脂质、无机载体等，并介绍了这些材料如何改善药物的治疗效果。通过分析不同类型的纳米载体（如脂质体、聚meric nanoparticles），作者展示了它们在靶向递送和减少毒性方面的潜力。此外，作者还探讨了自组装技术作为药物载体的优势，以及水凝胶在药物控制释放中的应用。每一步都旨在验证假说并排除替代解释，确保所提出的药物递送系统能够有效解决化疗的局限性。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，纳米载体在癌症治疗中的应用具有显著优势，如提高药物靶向性、减少毒性及改善药代动力学特性。通过表面修饰和结构设计，可实现对肿瘤细胞的高效递送与精准治疗。然而，其生物降解性、稳定性及潜在毒性仍是限制因素。此研究强调了自组装策略在构建多功能纳米载体中的潜力，为未来药物递送系统的设计提供了理论依据和实践指导。
items.selection_reason: 本文讨论了用于癌症治疗的控释药物载体及其性能，强调了通过改进药物递送系统来提高治疗效果和减少副作用的重要性。文章指出，传统化疗存在生物利用度低、剂量大、副作用多等问题，而纳米载体如脂质体、聚合物纳米颗粒等能够通过增强渗透性和保留效应（EPR）实现靶向递送，并降低对正常细胞的毒性。此外，有机和无机纳米载体在药物递送中的应用也得到了深入研究，例如量子点（QDs）因其独特的物理化学性质被用于实时监测细胞内过程和体内分子成像。文章还提到，通过表面修饰可以提高磁性纳米颗粒在肿瘤部位的聚集效率，从而减少肿瘤体积。综上所述，这些新型药物载体在癌症治疗中展现出优于传统化疗的优势，能够有效克服多药耐受性和副作用问题，为未来癌症治疗提供了新的方向和方法。
items.application_prospects: 本文探讨了纳米载体在癌症治疗中的应用前景，指出其通过提高药物靶向性和减少毒性改善治疗效果。当前，多种纳米载体如脂质体、聚合物纳米颗粒和微球已被开发用于临床，但存在生物降解性差、稳定性不足等问题。未来需进一步优化材料设计以提升药物递送效率和安全性。
items.future_directions: 未来的研究应聚焦于开发更高效的纳米载体，以提高药物在肿瘤部位的靶向性并减少对正常细胞的毒性。同时，需要进一步探索不同材料在癌症治疗中的应用潜力及其生物相容性。此外，应评估多种纳米载体在临床前和临床阶段的表现，以确定其安全性和有效性。

fields.en: In cancer treatment, although traditional chemotherapy has achieved some success, its low bioavailability, high dose requirements, significant side effects, low efficacy index, development of multidrug resistance, and non-specific targeting limit its application. Therefore, developing drug delivery systems that can actively or passively target cancer cells has become key to improving therapeutic efficacy and reducing side effects. In recent years, with a deeper understanding of tumor biology and the widespread use of various materials (such as polymers, lipids, inorganic carriers, polymeric hydrogels, and biopolymer scaffolds), new drug delivery systems have been developed, which can more effectively deliver chemotherapeutic drugs to the tumor site. The development of nanotechnology has had a profound impact on cancer treatment, particularly nanoscale drug carriers that enhance efficacy while avoiding toxicity to normal cells. For example, lipidosomes, polymer nanoparticles, and microspheres as nanocarriers have shown great potential in targeted delivery, real-time monitoring, and molecular imaging due to their unique physicochemical properties. However, these nanocarriers still face challenges such as poor biodegradability, low bioavailability, insufficient circulation stability, and potential toxicity. Furthermore, drug resistance is a major cause of treatment failure, so more efficient drug delivery systems are needed to achieve precise treatment. Biocompatible materials constructed through self-assembly can regulate structural properties according to environmental conditions (such as pH value, ionic strength, etc.), thereby improving the accumulation efficiency of drugs in tumor sites. Hydrogels as drug delivery carriers can control drug release under specific conditions, further enhancing therapeutic efficacy.

In the literature, the author first highlights issues such as low bioavailability, high doses, and significant toxicity associated with chemotherapy, emphasizing the challenges in tumor treatment. The author then discusses the application of various materials as drug carriers, including polymers, lipids, and inorganic carriers, and explains how these materials can improve drug therapeutic effects. Additionally, the author explores the advantages of self-assembly technology as a drug carrier and the application of hydrogels in controlled drug release. paragraphs.en: The author proposes the development of drug delivery systems capable of actively or passively targeting cancer cells to reduce side effects and enhance therapeutic efficacy by analyzing the limitations of traditional chemotherapy. In the literature, the author first highlights issues such as low bioavailability, high doses, and significant toxicity associated with chemotherapy, emphasizing the challenges in tumor treatment. The author then discusses the application of various materials as drug carriers, including polymers, lipids, and inorganic carriers, and explains how these materials can improve drug therapeutic effects. By analyzing different types of nanocarriers (such as liposomes and polymeric nanoparticles), the author demonstrates their potential in targeted delivery and reducing toxicity. Additionally, the author explores the advantages of self-assembly technology as a drug carrier and the application of hydrogels in controlled drug release. Each step is aimed at verifying the hypothesis and excluding alternative explanations, ensuring that the proposed drug delivery system can effectively address the limitations of chemotherapy.

fields.en: My conclusion is that the application of nanocarriers in cancer therapy has significant advantages, such as improving drug targeting, reducing toxicity, and enhancing pharmacokinetic properties. Through surface modification and structural design, efficient delivery to tumor cells and precise treatment can be achieved. However, their biodegradability, stability, and potential toxicity remain limiting factors. This study highlights the potential of self-assembly strategies in constructing multifunctional nanocarriers, providing theoretical basis and practical guidance for the design of future drug delivery systems.
fields.zh: 我的归纳是，纳米载体在癌症治疗中的应用具有显著优势，如提高药物靶向性、减少毒性及改善药代动力学特性。通过表面修饰和结构设计，可实现对肿瘤细胞的高效递送与精准治疗。然而，其生物降解性、稳定性及潜在毒性仍是限制因素。此研究强调了自组装策略在构建多功能纳米载体中的潜力，为未来药物递送系统的设计提供了理论依据和实践指导。

fields.label_zh: 推荐理由与创新点（详细）
fields.en: This paper discusses controlled release drug carriers for cancer therapy and their performance, emphasizing the importance of improving drug delivery systems to enhance therapeutic efficacy and reduce side effects. The article points out that traditional chemotherapy has issues such as low bioavailability, high doses, and multiple side effects, while nanocarriers such as liposomes and polymer nanoparticles can achieve targeted delivery through enhanced permeability and retention (EPR) and reduce toxicity to normal cells. Furthermore, the application of organic and inorganic nanocarriers in drug delivery has been extensively studied, for example, quantum dots (QDs) are used for real-time monitoring of intracellular processes and in vivo molecular imaging due to their unique physical and chemical properties. The article also mentions that surface modification can improve the aggregation efficiency of magnetic nanoparticles at tumor sites, thereby reducing tumor volume. In conclusion, these novel drug carriers show advantages over traditional chemotherapy in cancer treatment, effectively overcoming multidrug resistance and side effects, providing new directions and methods for future cancer therapy.
fields.zh: 本文讨论了用于癌症治疗的控释药物载体及其性能，强调了通过改进药物递送系统来提高治疗效果和减少副作用的重要性。文章指出，传统化疗存在生物利用度低、剂量大、副作用多等问题，而纳米载体如脂质体、聚合物纳米颗粒等能够通过增强渗透性和保留效应（EPR）实现靶向递送，并降低对正常细胞的毒性。此外，有机和无机纳米载体在药物递送中的应用也得到了深入研究，例如量子点（QDs）因其独特的物理化学性质被用于实时监测细胞内过程和体内分子成像。文章还提到，通过表面修饰可以提高磁性纳米颗粒在肿瘤部位的聚集效率，从而减少肿瘤体积。综上所述，这些新型药物载体在癌症治疗中展现出优于传统化疗的优势，能够有效克服多药耐受性和副作用问题，为未来癌症治疗提供了新的方向和方法。

fields.en: This paper explores the prospects of nanocarriers in cancer therapy, pointing out that they improve treatment efficacy by enhancing drug targeting and reducing toxicity. Currently, various nanocarriers such as liposomes, polymeric nanoparticles, and microparticles have been developed for clinical use, but issues such as poor biodegradability and insufficient stability exist. Future research needs to further optimize material design to enhance drug delivery efficiency and safety.
fields.zh: 本文探讨了纳米载体在癌症治疗中的应用前景，指出其通过提高药物靶向性和减少毒性改善治疗效果。当前，多种纳米载体如脂质体、聚合物纳米颗粒和微球已被开发用于临床，但存在生物降解性差、稳定性不足等问题。未来需进一步优化材料设计以提升药物递送效率和安全性。

decisions.focus: Antidepressant effect of anti-cytokine treatment in chronic inflammatory conditions

The study provides a systematic review and meta-analysis of clinical trials examining the antidepressant activity of anti-cytokine treatment in chronic inflammatory conditions. The findings suggest that anti-cytokine therapy may have a significant effect on depressive symptoms, with evidence supporting a potential causal role for cytokines in depression. The research is grounded in clinical data from multiple studies and offers insights into the relationship between inflammation and mental health.

classification_audit.abstract: Abstract Inflammatory cytokines are commonly elevated in acute depression and are associated with resistance to monoaminergic treatment. To examine the potential role of cytokines in the pathogenesis and treatment of depression, we carried out a systematic review and meta-analysis of antidepressant activity of anti-cytokine treatment using clinical trials of chronic inflammatory conditions where depressive symptoms were measured as a secondary outcome. Systematic search of the PubMed, EMBASE, PsycINFO and Cochrane databases, search of reference lists and conference abstracts, followed by study selection process yielded 20 clinical trials. Random effect meta-analysis of seven randomised controlled trials (RCTs) involving 2370 participants showed a significant antidepressant effect of anti-cytokine treatment compared with placebo (standardised mean difference (SMD)=0.40, 95% confidence interval (CI), 0.22–0.59). Anti-tumour necrosis factor drugs were most commonly studied (five RCTs); SMD=0.33 (95% CI; 0.06–0.60). Separate meta-analyses of two RCTs of adjunctive treatment with anti-cytokine therapy and eight non-randomised and/or non-placebo studies yielded similar small-to-medium effect estimates favouring anti-cytokine therapy; SMD=0.19 (95% CI, 0.00–0.37) and 0.51 (95% CI, 0.34–0.67), respectively. Adalimumab, etanercept, infliximab and tocilizumab all showed statistically significant improvements in depressive symptoms. Meta-regression exploring predictors of response found that the antidepressant effect was associated with baseline symptom severity ( P =0.018) but not with improvement in primary physical illness, sex, age or study duration. The findings indicate a potentially causal role for cytokines in depression and that cytokine modulators may be novel drugs for depression in chronically inflamed subjects. The field now requires RCTs of cytokine modulators using depression as the primary outcome in subjects with high inflammation who are free of other physical illnesses.

items.action:
抗炎治疗的抗抑郁作用：一项关于慢性炎症疾病的临床试验系统综述和元分析

在慢性炎症疾病中，抗炎治疗对抑郁症的潜在作用一直是研究热点。本研究通过系统综述和元分析，评估了抗炎治疗对抑郁症症状的影响，并探讨其与身体疾病改善之间的关系。研究纳入20项临床试验，其中7项随机对照试验（RCT）显示，抗炎治疗相比安慰剂具有显著的抗抑郁效果（标准化均差SMD=0.40，95%置信区间0.22–0.59）。此外，两项辅助治疗的RCT和八项非随机及/或无安慰剂对照研究也显示出抗炎治疗对抑郁症症状的改善作用。研究还发现，抗抑郁效果与基础抑郁症状严重程度相关（P=0.018），但与身体疾病改善、性别、年龄和研究持续时间无关。

本研究的结果表明，炎症因子可能在抑郁症的发病机制中起关键作用，而抗炎药物可能成为治疗慢性炎症患者抑郁症的新方法。然而，目前仍需要更多针对炎症调节剂的随机对照试验，以将抑郁症作为主要结局指标，在高炎症且无其他身体疾病的人群中进行验证。

综上所述，本研究支持了炎症因子在抑郁症中的潜在因果作用，并提示抗炎药物可能对慢性炎症患者具有治疗价值。然而，进一步的研究仍需关注其在不同人群和疾病状态下的效果差异以及长期疗效。
items.research_logic: 作者通过系统性回顾和元分析，提出抗细胞因子治疗可能对抑郁症状有改善作用的假说。首先，通过文献检索确定了20项临床试验，并从中提取数据进行元分析。随后，对七项随机对照试验（RCT）进行元回归分析，发现抗细胞因子治疗与基线抑郁严重程度相关（P=0.018），但与物理疾病改善、性别、年龄和研究持续时间无关。此外，通过比较不同药物的效应大小，确认了抗肿瘤坏死因子药物在改善抑郁症状中的显著作用。最后，作者排除了其他可能的解释，如性别差异和研究持续时间的影响，并指出细胞因子可能在抑郁症中具有因果关系。整个分析过程通过严格的统计方法确保结果的可靠性。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，针对炎症因子的治疗可能对抑郁症状有改善作用，但其效果与基础症状严重程度相关。该研究通过系统综述和meta分析发现，抗炎治疗在抑郁症患者中显示出显著的抗抑郁效应，尤其是TNF-α抑制剂。然而，这种效应并不依赖于身体疾病的好转，而是与初始抑郁症状的严重程度有关。这一发现提示，在慢性炎症状态下，调节炎症因子可能成为治疗抑郁症的新策略，但需进一步通过RCTs验证其在高炎症患者中的有效性。
items.selection_reason: 该研究通过系统综述和meta分析，探讨了抗细胞因子治疗在慢性炎症性疾病患者中的抗抑郁作用。研究发现，抗细胞因子治疗与安慰剂相比，对抑郁症状有显著改善（SMD=0.40, 95% CI 0.22–0.59）。其中，抗肿瘤坏死因子药物效果最明显（SMD=0.33, 95% CI 0.06–0.60）。此外，抗细胞因子治疗在辅助治疗中也显示出小到中等效应（SMD=0.19, 95% CI 0.00–0.37）和非随机研究中的显著改善（SMD=0.51, 95% CI 0.34–0.67）。研究还发现，抗抑郁效果与基础症状严重程度相关（P=0.018），但与疾病改善、性别、年龄及研究持续时间无关。这些结果表明，细胞因子可能在抑郁症的发病机制中起作用，并提示细胞因子调节剂可能是治疗慢性炎症患者抑郁症的新药物。
items.application_prospects: 本文探讨了抗细胞因子治疗在慢性炎症患者中的应用前景，表明其可能对抑郁症有潜在的治疗作用。研究显示，抗细胞因子药物（如抗肿瘤坏死因子药物）在改善抑郁症状方面具有显著效果，但其疗效与基础症状严重性相关，而非疾病本身的好转。实现该治疗需通过随机对照试验，以抑郁症作为主要结局指标，在高炎症且无其他疾病患者中进行。约束条件包括需要高质量的临床试验数据支持，并需进一步验证其在人体中的有效性。
items.future_directions: 本文指出，针对炎症因子的治疗可能对慢性炎症患者的精神疾病有潜在疗效。未来研究应进一步验证抗炎药物在抑郁症中的主要作用，并设计RCTs以明确其因果关系。此外，需探索不同性别、年龄及基础症状严重程度对治疗效果的影响。

fields.en:
Antidepressant effects of anti-inflammatory treatment: a systematic review and meta-analysis on chronic inflammatory diseases

The potential role of anti-inflammatory treatment in depression among patients with chronic inflammatory diseases has been a focus of research. This study conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis to evaluate the impact of anti-inflammatory treatment on depressive symptoms and to explore its relationship with improvement in physical illness. The study included 20 clinical trials, of which 7 randomized controlled trials (RCTs) showed significant antidepressant effects of anti-inflammatory treatment compared to placebo (standardized mean difference SMD=0.40, 95% confidence interval 0.22–0.59). Additionally, two RCTs of adjunctive therapies and eight non-randomized and/or placebo-controlled studies also demonstrated the beneficial effect of anti-inflammatory treatment on depressive symptoms. The study also found that antidepressant effects were related to baseline severity of depressive symptoms (P=0.018), but not to improvement in physical illness, gender, age, or duration of the study.

The results of this study suggest that inflammatory factors may play a key role in the pathogenesis of depression, and anti-inflammatory drugs may represent a new approach for treating depression in patients with chronic inflammation. However, further research is needed to conduct more randomized controlled trials focusing on inflammatory modulators, verifying depression as a primary outcome measure in populations with high inflammation and without other physical diseases.

In conclusion, this study supports the potential causal role of inflammatory factors in depression and suggests that anti-inflammatory drugs may have therapeutic value for patients with chronic inflammation. However, further research is still needed to focus on differences in effects across different populations and disease states as well as long-term efficacy.
fields.zh:
抗炎治疗的抗抑郁作用：一项关于慢性炎症疾病的临床试验系统综述和元分析

在慢性炎症疾病中，抗炎治疗对抑郁症的潜在作用一直是研究热点。本研究通过系统综述和元分析，评估了抗炎治疗对抑郁症症状的影响，并探讨其与身体疾病改善之间的关系。研究纳入20项临床试验，其中7项随机对照试验（RCT）显示，抗炎治疗相比安慰剂具有显著的抗抑郁效果（标准化均差SMD=0.40，95%置信区间0.22–0.59）。此外，两项辅助治疗的RCT和八项非随机及/或无安慰剂对照研究也显示出抗炎治疗对抑郁症症状的改善作用。研究还发现，抗抑郁效果与基础抑郁症状严重程度相关（P=0.018），但与身体疾病改善、性别、年龄和研究持续时间无关。

本研究的结果表明，炎症因子可能在抑郁症的发病机制中起关键作用，而抗炎药物可能成为治疗慢性炎症患者抑郁症的新方法。然而，目前仍需要更多针对炎症调节剂的随机对照试验，以将抑郁症作为主要结局指标，在高炎症且无其他身体疾病的人群中进行验证。

综上所述，本研究支持了炎症因子在抑郁症中的潜在因果作用，并提示抗炎药物可能对慢性炎症患者具有治疗价值。然而，进一步的研究仍需关注其在不同人群和疾病状态下的效果差异以及长期疗效。

fields.en: The author proposed a hypothesis that anti-cytokine therapy may have an ameliorating effect on depressive symptoms through a systematic review and meta-analysis. First, 20 clinical trials were identified through literature search, and data were extracted for meta-analysis. Subsequently, a meta-regression analysis was conducted on seven randomized controlled trials (RCTs), revealing that anti-cytokine therapy was associated with baseline severity of depression (P=0.018), but not with physical disease improvement, gender, age, and study duration. Additionally, by comparing the effect sizes of different drugs, it was confirmed that anti-tumor necrosis factor drugs had a significant role in improving depressive symptoms. Finally, the author excluded other possible explanations, such as the influence of gender differences and study duration, and pointed out that cytokines may have a causal relationship in depression. The entire analysis process ensured the reliability of the results through strict statistical methods.

The study also found that the antidepressant effect was related to the severity of baseline symptoms (P=0.018), but was unrelated to disease improvement, gender, age, and study duration. fields.zh: 该研究通过系统综述和meta分析，探讨了抗细胞因子治疗在慢性炎症性疾病患者中的抗抑郁作用。研究发现，抗细胞因子治疗与安慰剂相比，对抑郁症状有显著改善（SMD=0.40, 95% CI 0.22–0.59）。其中，抗肿瘤坏死因子药物效果最明显（SMD=0.33, 95% CI 0.06–0.60）。此外，抗细胞因子治疗在辅助治疗中也显示出小到中等效应（SMD=0.19, 95% CI 0.00–0.37）和非随机研究中的显著改善（SMD=0.51, 95% CI 0.34–0.67）。研究还发现，抗抑郁效果与基础症状严重程度相关（P=0.018），但与疾病改善、性别、年龄及研究持续时间无关。这些结果表明，细胞因子可能在抑郁症的发病机制中起作用，并提示细胞因子调节剂可能是治疗慢性炎症患者抑郁症的新药物。

paragraphs.en: This study explores the antidepressant effects of anti-cytokine therapy in patients with chronic inflammatory diseases through a systematic review and meta-analysis. The findings show that anti-cytokine therapy significantly improves depressive symptoms compared to placebo (SMD=0.40, 95% CI 0.22–0.59). Among them, anti-tumor necrosis factor drugs showed the most significant effect (SMD=0.33, 95% CI 0.06–0.60). Additionally, anti-cytokine therapy demonstrated small to moderate effects in adjunctive treatment (SMD=0.19, 95% CI 0.00–0.37) and significant improvement in non-randomized studies (SMD=0.51, 95% CI 0.34–0.67). The study also found that the antidepressant effect was related to the severity of baseline symptoms (P=0.018), but was unrelated to disease improvement, gender, age, and study duration. These results suggest that cytokines may play a role in the pathogenesis of depression and indicate that cytokine regulators may be new drugs for treating depression in patients with chronic inflammation.

fields.en: This paper explores the prospects of anti-cytokine therapy in patients with chronic inflammation, indicating that it may have potential therapeutic effects on depression. The study shows that anti-cytokine drugs (such as anti-tumor necrosis factor drugs) have significant effects in improving depressive symptoms, but their efficacy is related to the severity of baseline symptoms, not the improvement of the disease itself. Achieving this treatment requires randomized controlled trials with depression as the primary outcome measure, conducted in patients with high inflammation and no other diseases. Constraints include the need for high-quality clinical trial data to support this, and further validation of its effectiveness in humans is required.
fields.zh: 本文探讨了抗细胞因子治疗在慢性炎症患者中的应用前景，表明其可能对抑郁症有潜在的治疗作用。研究显示，抗细胞因子药物（如抗肿瘤坏死因子药物）在改善抑郁症状方面具有显著效果，但其疗效与基础症状严重性相关，而非疾病本身的好转。实现该治疗需通过随机对照试验，以抑郁症作为主要结局指标，在高炎症且无其他疾病患者中进行。约束条件包括需要高质量的临床试验数据支持，并需进一步验证其在人体中的有效性。

fields.en: This paper highlights that treatment targeting inflammatory factors may have potential therapeutic effects on mental disorders in patients with chronic inflammation. Future research should further validate the primary role of anti-inflammatory drugs in depression and design RCTs to clarify their causal relationships. Additionally, it is necessary to explore the impact of different gender, age, and baseline severity of symptoms on treatment outcomes.

The review provides a comprehensive analysis of the challenges and potential solutions for electrocatalysts in alkaline HER, focusing on the fundamental mechanisms, reaction kinetics, and material design. It highlights the importance of understanding the role of structure and synergy in catalyst performance, particularly in alkaline conditions where traditional acidic catalysts perform poorly. The review also discusses the need for new catalysts that can efficiently handle the additional water dissociation step and the challenges associated with hydrogen binding energy and overpotential in alkaline media.

classification_audit.abstract: Abstract Hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) in alkaline medium is currently a point of focus for sustainable development of hydrogen as an alternative clean fuel for various energy systems, but suffers from sluggish reaction kinetics due to additional water dissociation step. So, the state‐of‐the‐art catalysts performing well in acidic media lose considerable catalytic performance in alkaline media. This review summarizes the recent developments to overcome the kinetics issues of alkaline HER, synthesis of materials with modified morphologies, and electronic structures to tune the active sites and their applications as efficient catalysts for HER. It first explains the fundamentals and electrochemistry of HER and then outlines the requirements for an efficient and stable catalyst in alkaline medium. The challenges with alkaline HER and limitation with the electrocatalysts along with prospective solutions are then highlighted. It further describes the synthesis methods of advanced nanostructures based on carbon, noble, and inexpensive metals and their heterogeneous structures. These heterogeneous structures provide some ideal systems for analyzing the role of structure and synergy on alkaline HER catalysis. At the end, it provides the concluding remarks and future perspectives that can be helpful for tuning the catalysts active‐sites with improved electrochemical efficiencies in future.

items.action:
碱性电解质中的氢演化反应（HER）在可持续发展氢能源中扮演着重要角色，但其动力学问题限制了其应用。本文综述了针对碱性HER的电催化剂研究进展，重点在于如何通过材料设计和结构调控来提升催化性能。首先，文章分析了碱性介质中HER的基本原理和电化学特性，并指出高效稳定催化剂的需求。接着讨论了碱性HER面临的挑战及现有电催化剂的局限性，提出了可能的解决方案。随后介绍了基于碳、贵金属和廉价金属的先进纳米结构合成方法及其异质结构，这些结构为研究结构与协同效应在碱性HER催化中的作用提供了理想平台。最后总结了未来的研究方向，强调通过优化活性位点化学来提升电化学效率的重要性。

文章指出，碱性介质中HER的动力学问题主要源于额外的水分解步骤，导致反应速率较低。尽管酸性环境中的高效催化剂在碱性环境中性能下降，但通过设计异质结构和调控电子结构可以改善催化效果。例如，Ru纳米颗粒修饰的氮掺杂二维碳结构（C2N）表现出优异的HER活性，其水吸附能显著提高，加速了Volmer步骤。此外，Ru/C2N异质结构对OH⁻离子有较低的亲和力，使其成为碱性HER的理想催化剂。

研究还强调了反应机制复杂性和表面覆盖物的影响，指出在碱性介质中，催化剂性能主要受水分解和氢键合能控制。通过调控这些因素，可以开发出更高效的电催化剂。综上所述，针对碱性HER的催化研究需要深入理解其反应机理，并通过材料设计优化活性位点，以实现更高的电化学效率和实际应用价值。
items.research_logic: 作者通过分析碱性HER的反应机制和挑战，提出假说认为碱性环境中的水解步骤增加了反应动力学障碍。为验证这一假说，作者首先探讨了碱性介质中HER的基本原理和电化学特性，并指出高效稳定催化剂的需求。随后，作者详细描述了先进纳米结构的合成方法，包括基于碳、贵金属和廉价金属的异质结构，这些结构为分析结构与协同效应在碱性HER催化中的作用提供了理想系统。通过实验验证，如Ni(OH)₂修饰Pt催化剂显著提高了HER活性，同时指出该方法存在复杂合成步骤和稳定性问题。此外，作者通过理论研究揭示了Ru/C₂N杂化材料在碱性环境中的优越性能，因其能有效提高水解步骤的吸附能量并降低过电位。综述分析通过对比不同催化剂的催化活性、电子结构和表面化学特性，系统梳理了碱性HER中反应动力学控制因素，并指出未来研究应聚焦于优化催化剂活性位点以提升电化学效率。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，碱性HER催化中，催化剂的活性与结构和协同效应密切相关。通过设计异质结构材料，可以有效提升水解离和氢键合能力，从而改善催化性能。该原则适用于其他电化学反应中的催化剂优化，但需注意材料的电子结构复杂性和成本限制。
items.selection_reason: 本文推荐理由基于其对碱性HER催化剂的深入分析和创新解决方案。文章详细探讨了碱性环境下的HER机制、挑战及潜在解决策略，强调了催化剂结构与电子特性在调节活性位点中的关键作用。通过对比酸性和碱性介质中催化剂性能差异，指出传统贵金属催化剂在碱性条件下的局限性，并提出基于碳、贵金属和廉价金属的先进纳米结构设计，以提升催化效率。文章还讨论了水解离步骤的能量障碍及氢绑定能对反应速率的影响，强调了理论与实验结合的重要性。这些内容超越常规流水线工作，聚焦于催化剂设计与机制优化，而非单纯依赖期刊评价或虚构首次发现。
items.application_prospects: 本文探讨了碱性环境中氢演化反应（HER）的催化剂应用前景，指出其在提高电化学效率和稳定性的潜力。通过调控催化剂的结构和电子特性，可优化活性位点以提升催化性能。尽管碱性HER面临水解离步的动能障碍和水结合能不足等挑战，但新型碳基、贵金属及廉价金属催化剂的合成提供了可能解决方案。例如，Ru/C₂N杂化材料通过增强水吸附能力显著提高HER活性，而Ni(OH)₂修饰的Pt催化剂则通过降低水解离能垒提升性能。然而，实际应用中仍存在合成复杂、界面控制困难等问题。未来需进一步研究反应机制和活性位点调控，以实现高效稳定的碱性HER催化体系。
items.future_directions: 未来研究可聚焦于开发新型碱性HER催化剂，重点在于优化水解离步骤和氢键结合能以提升催化效率。同时，应进一步探索不同金属及其合金在碱性环境中的协同效应，以及非贵金属催化剂的结构-性能关系。此外，通过理论计算与实验验证相结合，深入理解碱性条件下的反应机制，有助于设计更高效的电催化剂。

fields.en:
The hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) in alkaline electrolytes plays an important role in sustainable hydrogen energy, but its kinetic issues limit its application. This paper reviews the research progress on electrocatalysts for alkaline HER, focusing on how to enhance catalytic performance through material design and structural control. First, the article analyzes the basic principles and electrochemical characteristics of HER in alkaline media, and highlights the demand for efficient and stable catalysts. Next, it discusses the challenges faced by alkaline HER and the limitations of existing electrocatalysts, proposing possible solutions. Then, it introduces advanced nanostructure synthesis methods based on carbon, noble metals, and cost-effective metals, as well as heterostructures, which provide an ideal platform for studying the role of structure and synergistic effects in catalysis for alkaline HER. Finally, it summarizes future research directions, emphasizing the importance of improving electrochemical efficiency through optimization of active site chemistry.

The kinetics of HER in alkaline media are primarily attributed to additional water-splitting steps, leading to a lower reaction rate. Although efficient catalysts in acidic environments degrade in alkaline conditions, the catalytic performance can be improved by designing heterostructures and regulating electronic structures. For example, Ru nanoparticles modified with nitrogen-doped two-dimensional carbon structures (C2N) exhibit excellent HER activity, as their water adsorption energy is significantly enhanced, accelerating the Volmer step. Additionally, the Ru/C2N heterostructure has a low affinity for OH⁻ ions, making it an ideal catalyst for alkaline HER.

The study also highlights the complexity of the reaction mechanism and the influence of surface coverage, indicating that catalyst performance in alkaline media is primarily controlled by water splitting and hydrogen bonding energy. By regulating these factors, more efficient electrocatalysts can be developed. In conclusion, research on catalysis for alkaline HER requires a deep understanding of its reaction mechanisms and optimization of active sites through material design to achieve higher electrochemical efficiency and practical application value.

碱性电解质中的氢演化反应（HER）在可持续发展氢能源中扮演着重要角色，但其动力学问题限制了其应用。本文综述了针对碱性HER的电催化剂研究进展，重点在于如何通过材料设计和结构调控来提升催化性能。首先，文章分析了碱性介质中HER的基本原理和电化学特性，并指出高效稳定催化剂的需求。接着讨论了碱性HER面临的挑战及现有电催化剂的局限性，提出了可能的解决方案。随后介绍了基于碳、贵金属和廉价金属的先进纳米结构合成方法及其异质结构，这些结构为研究结构与协同效应在碱性HER催化中的作用提供了理想平台。最后总结了未来的研究方向，强调通过优化活性位点化学来提升电化学效率的重要性。

文章指出，碱性介质中HER的动力学问题主要源于额外的水分解步骤，导致反应速率较低。尽管酸性环境中的高效催化剂在碱性环境中性能下降，但通过设计异质结构和调控电子结构可以改善催化效果。例如，Ru纳米颗粒修饰的氮掺杂二维碳结构（C2N）表现出优异的HER活性，其水吸附能显著提高，加速了Volmer步骤。此外，Ru/C2N异质结构对OH⁻离子有较低的亲和力，使其成为碱性HER的理想催化剂。

研究还强调了反应机制复杂性和表面覆盖物的影响，指出在碱性介质中，催化剂性能主要受水分解和氢键合能控制。通过调控这些因素，可以开发出更高效的电催化剂。综上所述，针对碱性HER的催化研究需要深入理解其反应机理，并通过材料设计优化活性位点，以实现更高的电化学效率和实际应用价值。

fields.en: The author proposes a hypothesis that the hydrolysis step in an alkaline environment increases the kinetic barrier of the HER reaction mechanism by analyzing the reaction mechanisms and challenges of alkaline HER. To verify this hypothesis, the author first explores the basic principles and electrochemical characteristics of HER in alkaline media, and highlights the need for efficient and stable catalysts. Subsequently, the author describes in detail the synthesis methods of advanced nanostuctures, including heterostructures based on carbon, precious metals, and cheap metals, which provide an ideal system for analyzing the role of structure and synergistic effects in alkaline HER catalysis. Through experimental verification, Ni(OH)₂ modified Pt catalysts significantly enhance HER activity, while pointing out that this method has complex synthesis steps and stability issues. Furthermore, the author reveals through theoretical studies that Ru/C₂N hybrid materials exhibit superior performance in alkaline environments because they can effectively increase the adsorption energy of the hydrolysis step and reduce overpotential. The review analysis systematically sorts out the kinetic control factors in alkaline HER by comparing the catalytic activity, electronic structure, and surface chemical properties of different catalysts, and points out that future research should focus on optimizing the active sites of catalysts to improve electrochemical efficiency.
fields.zh: 作者通过分析碱性HER的反应机制和挑战，提出假说认为碱性环境中的水解步骤增加了反应动力学障碍。为验证这一假说，作者首先探讨了碱性介质中HER的基本原理和电化学特性，并指出高效稳定催化剂的需求。随后，作者详细描述了先进纳米结构的合成方法，包括基于碳、贵金属和廉价金属的异质结构，这些结构为分析结构与协同效应在碱性HER催化中的作用提供了理想系统。通过实验验证，如Ni(OH)₂修饰Pt催化剂显著提高了HER活性，同时指出该方法存在复杂合成步骤和稳定性问题。此外，作者通过理论研究揭示了Ru/C₂N杂化材料在碱性环境中的优越性能，因其能有效提高水解步骤的吸附能量并降低过电位。综述分析通过对比不同催化剂的催化活性、电子结构和表面化学特性，系统梳理了碱性HER中反应动力学控制因素，并指出未来研究应聚焦于优化催化剂活性位点以提升电化学效率。

fields.en: My conclusion is that the activity of catalysts in basic HER catalysis is closely related to their structure and synergistic effects. By designing heterostructured materials, it is possible to effectively enhance water dissociation and hydrogen bonding capabilities, thereby improving catalytic performance. This principle applies to the optimization of catalysts in other electrochemical reactions, but attention should be paid to the complexity of material electronic structures and cost limitations.
fields.zh: 我的归纳是，碱性HER催化中，催化剂的活性与结构和协同效应密切相关。通过设计异质结构材料，可以有效提升水解离和氢键合能力，从而改善催化性能。该原则适用于其他电化学反应中的催化剂优化，但需注意材料的电子结构复杂性和成本限制。

fields.label_en: Why selected and what is innovative
fields.label_zh: 推荐理由与创新点（详细）
fields.en: The recommendation of this paper is based on its in-depth analysis of alkaline HER catalysts and innovative solutions. The article thoroughly discusses the mechanisms, challenges, and potential strategies for HER in alkaline environments, emphasizing the critical role of catalyst structure and electronic properties in regulating active sites. By comparing the performance differences of catalysts in acidic and alkaline media, it highlights the limitations of traditional precious metal catalysts under alkaline conditions and proposes advanced nanostructure designs based on carbon, precious metals, and cost-effective metals to enhance catalytic efficiency. The article also discusses the energy barrier of the water dissociation step and the impact of hydrogen bonding energy on reaction rates, emphasizing the importance of combining theory with experiments. These contents go beyond conventional pipeline work, focusing on catalyst design and mechanism optimization, rather than solely relying on journal evaluations or fictional first discoveries.

fields.en: This paper explores the prospects of catalysts for the hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) in alkaline environments, highlighting their potential to enhance electrochemical efficiency and stability. By regulating the structure and electronic properties of the catalysts, active sites can be optimized to improve catalytic performance. Although alkaline HER faces challenges such as kinetic barriers in water dissociation steps and insufficient water binding energy, the synthesis of novel carbon-based, precious metal, and cost-effective metal catalysts offers potential solutions. For example, Ru/C₂N hybrid materials significantly enhance HER activity by improving water adsorption capacity, while Pt catalysts modified with Ni(OH)₂ improve performance by reducing the energy barrier for water dissociation. However, challenges such as complex synthesis and difficulties in interface control remain in practical applications. Future research needs to further study reaction mechanisms and active site regulation to achieve efficient and stable alkaline HER catalytic systems.
fields.zh: 本文探讨了碱性环境中氢演化反应（HER）的催化剂应用前景，指出其在提高电化学效率和稳定性的潜力。通过调控催化剂的结构和电子特性，可优化活性位点以提升催化性能。尽管碱性HER面临水解离步的动能障碍和水结合能不足等挑战，但新型碳基、贵金属及廉价金属催化剂的合成提供了可能解决方案。例如，Ru/C₂N杂化材料通过增强水吸附能力显著提高HER活性，而Ni(OH)₂修饰的Pt催化剂则通过降低水解离能垒提升性能。然而，实际应用中仍存在合成复杂、界面控制困难等问题。未来需进一步研究反应机制和活性位点调控，以实现高效稳定的碱性HER催化体系。

paragraphs.en: This paper explores the prospects of catalysts for the hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) in alkaline environments, highlighting their potential to enhance electrochemical efficiency and stability. By regulating the structure and electronic properties of the catalysts, active sites can be optimized to improve catalytic performance. Although alkaline HER faces challenges such as kinetic barriers in water dissociation steps and insufficient water binding energy, the synthesis of novel carbon-based, precious metal, and cost-effective metal catalysts offers potential solutions. For example, Ru/C₂N hybrid materials significantly enhance HER activity by improving water adsorption capacity, while Pt catalysts modified with Ni(OH)₂ improve performance by reducing the energy barrier for water dissociation. However, challenges such as complex synthesis and difficulties in interface control remain in practical applications. Future research needs to further study reaction mechanisms and active site regulation to achieve efficient and stable alkaline HER catalytic systems.

fields.en: Future research can focus on developing novel alkaline HER catalysts, with emphasis on optimizing the hydrolysis step and hydrogen bonding energy to enhance catalytic efficiency. Meanwhile, further exploration is needed into the synergistic effects of different metals and their alloys in alkaline environments, as well as the structure-performance relationships of non-precious metal catalysts. Additionally, by combining theoretical calculations with experimental verification, a deeper understanding of the reaction mechanisms under alkaline conditions can be achieved, which will aid in the design of more efficient electrocatalysts.
fields.zh: 未来研究可聚焦于开发新型碱性HER催化剂，重点在于优化水解离步骤和氢键结合能以提升催化效率。同时，应进一步探索不同金属及其合金在碱性环境中的协同效应，以及非贵金属催化剂的结构-性能关系。此外，通过理论计算与实验验证相结合，深入理解碱性条件下的反应机制，有助于设计更高效的电催化剂。

The review highlights the significant role of nanozymes in energy and environmental sustainability, focusing on their catalytic efficiency, stability, and adaptability across various applications. The article provides a detailed analysis of how nanozymes mimic natural enzymes to overcome limitations in traditional catalysts, particularly in energy conversion and pollution control. The discussion on H2O2 production, nitrate reduction, carbon dioxide reduction, and hydrogen evolution demonstrates the practical application of nanozymes in sustainable technologies. The review also emphasizes the design principles and mechanisms behind these nanozyme systems, showcasing their potential for scalable and green technological solutions.

classification_audit.abstract: ABSTRACT Nanozymes have shown remarkable promise in addressing pressing challenges in energy and environmental sustainability. Their enzyme‐like catalytic activity, combined with exceptional chemical stability, low cost, and structural tunability, enables them to function effectively in harsh operational conditions where natural enzymes typically fail. In environmental applications, nanozymes have been employed for pollutant degradation, wastewater treatment, heavy metal detoxification, and antibacterial disinfection, offering high efficiency, reusability, and adaptability across different media. In the energy sector, nanozymes contribute to critical reactions such as oxygen reduction, hydrogen evolution, and carbon dioxide conversion, supporting the development of biofuel cells, artificial photosynthesis systems, and electrocatalytic processes. This review highlights recent advances in nanozyme design for energy and environmental applications, emphasizing their functional advantages, underlying mechanisms, and integration into scalable, green technologies.

items.action: 纳米酶在能源和环境可持续性方面展现出巨大潜力。其酶样催化活性、优异的化学稳定性、低成本及结构可调性，使其能在恶劣操作条件下有效工作。在环境应用中，纳米酶被用于污染物降解、废水处理、重金属 detoxification 和抗菌消毒，具有高效、可重复使用和适应不同介质的优势。在能源领域，纳米酶参与关键反应如氧还原、氢演进和二氧化碳转化，支持生物燃料电池、人工光合作系统和电催化过程的发展。本文综述了纳米酶在能源和环境应用中的最新进展，强调其功能优势、基本机制及与可扩展绿色技术的整合。自然酶在温和条件下具有卓越的催化效率和底物特异性，但其实际应用受限于稳定性差、成本高和易变性。相比之下，纳米酶通过模仿水解酶和氧化还原酶，能够克服这些限制。例如，金纳米颗粒（NPs）表现出葡萄糖氧化酶（GOD）样活性，可催化葡萄糖氧化生成过氧化氢（H2O2）。研究发现，Au NPs的催化机制与GOD相同，即通过脱氢作用而非活性氧自由基催化反应。此外，Au NPs还能模仿其他氧化酶，如形式酸氧化酶（FOD），其催化效率和选择性均优于天然FOD。Pt20Au80合金催化剂在H2O2生成方面表现出色，具有更高的产率和选择性，并且其低效分解H2O2的能力有助于提高整体效率。纳米酶在电催化中的应用也取得了显著进展，如硝酸盐还原（NO3RR）中通过双铜位点协同作用实现高效催化，优化电子分布并加速*H转移，从而抑制竞争性氢演进反应。此外，二氧化碳还原（CO2RR）和氢演进（HER）等关键电化学过程中的纳米酶也表现出优异的性能。这些研究展示了如何通过酶启发的结构工程构建高活性、耐用的电催化剂，超越贵金属催化剂。
items.research_logic: 作者通过对比传统催化系统与自然酶的局限性，提出纳米酶在能源和环境领域的应用潜力。通过模仿氧化还原酶，如过氧化物酶和氧化酶，设计出具有类似催化活性的纳米酶。例如，金纳米颗粒表现出葡萄糖氧化酶（GOD）类似的催化活性，能够催化葡萄糖氧化生成过氧化氢（H2O2）。通过实验验证其催化机制，并进一步探索其在不同反应中的应用，如模拟其他氧化酶。同时，作者分析了纳米酶在电催化中的优势，如提高催化效率和选择性，并通过结构设计优化电子分布，提升催化性能。综述中通过比较不同催化剂的性能，强调了纳米酶在能源转换和环境治理中的重要性。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，纳米酶通过模仿天然酶的结构和机制，在能源与环境领域展现出独特的催化优势。其设计原则在于协同作用，如双金属位点或双原子位点，能够同时促进底物氧化和氧还原选择性，从而提高反应效率和稳定性。这种协同效应在电催化中尤为重要，例如硝酸盐还原和二氧化碳还原过程中，通过优化电子分布和质子转移路径，显著提升催化性能。该原则可应用于其他需要多步骤反应的催化体系，但需注意不同反应条件下的适用边界。
items.selection_reason: 该论文系统阐述了纳米酶在能源与环境领域的应用价值，重点介绍了其在H2O2生产、电催化、硝酸盐还原和氢气演化等关键反应中的创新设计与机制。通过模仿天然酶的结构与功能，纳米酶展现出优异的催化效率、稳定性和可调控性，能够克服传统催化剂在成本、选择性和稳定性方面的局限。例如，在H2O2生产中，Pt20Au80合金催化剂通过双金属协同作用实现了高产率和选择性；在硝酸盐还原中，PCN-Cu-DAC催化剂通过双铜位点优化电子分布，显著提升氨合成效率。这些设计不仅突破了传统催化体系的瓶颈，还为绿色能源与环境治理提供了可扩展的技术路径。
items.application_prospects: 本文探讨了纳米酶在能源和环境领域的应用前景，其具备高稳定性、低成本及结构可调性，适用于恶劣条件下的催化反应。在能源领域，纳米酶可用于氧还原、氢演算和二氧化碳转化，支持生物燃料电池、人工光合作用系统等发展；在环境领域，纳米酶可用于污染物降解、废水处理及抗菌消毒。其优势在于高效、可重复使用且适应性强。然而，实际应用中需克服催化选择性差、成本高等约束。
items.future_directions: 未来研究可聚焦于开发更高效的纳米酶以实现环境修复与能源转换的协同优化。例如，探索如何通过结构设计提升纳米酶在复杂条件下的稳定性和选择性，以及如何将纳米酶集成到大规模绿色技术中。此外，进一步研究不同金属合金比例对H₂O₂产率和催化性能的影响，可能为工业应用提供更优的催化剂方案。

fields.en: Nanoenzymes show great potential in energy and environmental sustainability. Their enzyme-like catalytic activity, excellent chemical stability, low cost, and adjustable structure allow them to function effectively under harsh operating conditions. In environmental applications, nanoenzymes are used for pollutant degradation, wastewater treatment, heavy metal detoxification, and antibacterial disinfection, offering advantages of high efficiency, reusability, and adaptability to different media. In the energy field, nanoenzymes participate in key reactions such as oxygen reduction, hydrogen evolution, and carbon dioxide conversion, supporting the development of biofuel cells, artificial photosynthesis systems, and electrocatalytic processes. This paper reviews the latest advances of nanoenzymes in energy and environmental applications, emphasizing their functional advantages, basic mechanisms, and integration with scalable green technologies. Natural enzymes have excellent catalytic efficiency and substrate specificity under mild conditions, but their practical application is limited by poor stability, high cost, and susceptibility to change. In contrast, nanoenzymes can overcome these limitations by mimicking hydrolases and oxidoreductases. For example, gold nanoparticles (NPs) exhibit glucose oxidase (GOD)-like activity, catalyzing the oxidation of glucose to generate hydrogen peroxide (H2O2). Research has found that the catalytic mechanism of Au NPs is similar to that of GOD, i.e., through dehydrogenation rather than catalytic reactions involving active oxygen radicals. Additionally, Au NPs can mimic other oxidases, such as formate oxidase (FOD), which exhibits higher catalytic efficiency and selectivity compared to natural FOD. Pt20Au80 alloy catalysts show excellent performance in H2O2 generation, with higher yield and selectivity, and their low decomposition ability of H2O2 helps improve overall efficiency. The application of nanoenzymes in electrocatalysis has also made significant progress. For example, in nitrate reduction (NO3RR), efficient catalysis is achieved through the synergistic effect of dual copper sites, optimizing electron distribution and accelerating *H transfer, thereby suppressing competitive hydrogen evolution reactions. Furthermore, nanoenzymes in key electrochemical processes such as carbon dioxide reduction (CO2RR) and hydrogen evolution (HER) also exhibit excellent performance. These studies demonstrate how enzyme-inspired structural engineering can construct high-active, durable electrocatalysts, surpassing precious metal catalysts.

paragraphs.en: Nanoenzymes show great potential in energy and environmental sustainability. Their enzyme-like catalytic activity, excellent chemical stability, low cost, and adjustable structure allow them to function effectively under harsh operating conditions. In environmental applications, nanoenzymes are used for pollutant degradation, wastewater treatment, heavy metal detoxification, and antibacterial disinfection, offering advantages of high efficiency, reusability, and adaptability to different media. In the energy field, nanoenzymes participate in key reactions such as oxygen reduction, hydrogen evolution, and carbon dioxide conversion, supporting the development of biofuel cells, artificial photosynthesis systems, and electrocatalytic processes. This paper reviews the latest advances of nanoenzymes in energy and environmental applications, emphasizing their functional advantages, basic mechanisms, and integration with scalable green technologies. Natural enzymes have excellent catalytic efficiency and substrate specificity under mild conditions, but their practical application is limited by poor stability, high cost, and susceptibility to change. In contrast, nanoenzymes can overcome these limitations by mimicking hydrolases and oxidoreductases. For example, gold nanoparticles (NPs) exhibit glucose oxidase (GOD)-like activity, catalyzing the oxidation of glucose to generate hydrogen peroxide (H2O2). Research has found that the catalytic mechanism of Au NPs is similar to that of GOD, i.e., through dehydrogenation rather than catalytic reactions involving active oxygen radicals. Additionally, Au NPs can mimic other oxidases, such as formate oxidase (FOD), which exhibits higher catalytic efficiency and selectivity compared to natural FOD. Pt20Au80 alloy catalysts show excellent performance in H2O2 generation, with higher yield and selectivity, and their low decomposition ability of H2O2 helps improve overall efficiency. The application of nanoenzymes in electrocatalysis has also made significant progress. For example, in nitrate reduction (NO3RR), efficient catalysis is achieved through the synergistic effect of dual copper sites, optimizing electron distribution and accelerating *H transfer, thereby suppressing competitive hydrogen evolution reactions. Furthermore, nanoenzymes in key electrochemical processes such as carbon dioxide reduction (CO2RR) and hydrogen evolution (HER) also exhibit excellent performance. These studies demonstrate how enzyme-inspired structural engineering can construct high-active, durable electrocatalysts, surpassing precious metal catalysts.

fields.en: The author proposes the potential application of nanoenzymes in energy and environmental fields by comparing the limitations of traditional catalytic systems with those of natural enzymes. By mimicking redox enzymes, such as peroxidases and oxidases, nanoenzymes are designed to exhibit similar catalytic activities. For example, gold nanoparticles demonstrate catalytic activity similar to that of glucose oxidase (GOD), enabling the oxidation of glucose to generate hydrogen peroxide (H2O2). Experimental validation of their catalytic mechanism is conducted, and further exploration is carried out on their application in various reactions, such as simulating other oxidases. The author also analyzes the advantages of nanoenzymes in electrocatalysis, such as enhancing catalytic efficiency and selectivity, and optimizing electronic distribution through structural design to improve catalytic performance. The review emphasizes the importance of nanoenzymes in energy conversion and environmental remediation by comparing the performance of different catalysts.
fields.zh: 作者通过对比传统催化系统与自然酶的局限性，提出纳米酶在能源和环境领域的应用潜力。通过模仿氧化还原酶，如过氧化物酶和氧化酶，设计出具有类似催化活性的纳米酶。例如，金纳米颗粒表现出葡萄糖氧化酶（GOD）类似的催化活性，能够催化葡萄糖氧化生成过氧化氢（H2O2）。通过实验验证其催化机制，并进一步探索其在不同反应中的应用，如模拟其他氧化酶。同时，作者分析了纳米酶在电催化中的优势，如提高催化效率和选择性，并通过结构设计优化电子分布，提升催化性能。综述中通过比较不同催化剂的性能，强调了纳米酶在能源转换和环境治理中的重要性。

fields.en: My conclusion is that nanoenzymes exhibit unique catalytic advantages in the fields of energy and environment by mimicking the structure and mechanism of natural enzymes. Their design principle lies in synergy, such as dual-metal sites or dual-atom sites, which can simultaneously promote substrate oxidation and oxygen reduction selectivity, thereby enhancing reaction efficiency and stability. This synergistic effect is particularly important in electrocatalysis, for example, in nitrate reduction and carbon dioxide reduction processes, where optimizing electron distribution and proton transfer pathways significantly improves catalytic performance. This principle can be applied to other catalytic systems requiring multi-step reactions, but attention should be paid to the applicable boundaries under different reaction conditions.
fields.zh: 我的归纳是，纳米酶通过模仿天然酶的结构和机制，在能源与环境领域展现出独特的催化优势。其设计原则在于协同作用，如双金属位点或双原子位点，能够同时促进底物氧化和氧还原选择性，从而提高反应效率和稳定性。这种协同效应在电催化中尤为重要，例如硝酸盐还原和二氧化碳还原过程中，通过优化电子分布和质子转移路径，显著提升催化性能。该原则可应用于其他需要多步骤反应的催化体系，但需注意不同反应条件下的适用边界。

fields.label_en: Why selected and what is innovative
fields.label_zh: 推荐理由与创新点（详细）
fields.en: This paper systematically elaborates on the application value of nanoenzymes in the fields of energy and environment, focusing on their innovative design and mechanisms in key reactions such as H2O2 production, electrocatalysis, nitrate reduction, and hydrogen evolution. By mimicking the structure and function of natural enzymes, nanoenzymes exhibit excellent catalytic efficiency, stability, and controllability, overcoming the limitations of traditional catalysts in terms of cost, selectivity, and stability. For example, in H2O2 production, a Pt20Au80 alloy catalyst achieves high yield and selectivity through the synergistic effect of bimetallics; in nitrate reduction, the PCN-Cu-DAC catalyst enhances ammonia synthesis efficiency by optimizing the distribution of dual copper sites. These designs not only break through the bottlenecks of traditional catalytic systems but also provide scalable technical pathways for green energy and environmental governance.

fields.en: This paper explores the potential applications of nanoenzymes in energy and environmental fields. They possess high stability, low cost, and adjustable structure, making them suitable for catalytic reactions under harsh conditions. In the energy field, nanoenzymes can be used for oxygen reduction, hydrogen evolution, and carbon dioxide conversion, supporting the development of biofuel cells and artificial photosynthesis systems. In the environmental field, nanoenzymes can be applied for pollutant degradation, wastewater treatment, and antibacterial disinfection. Their advantages include high efficiency, reusability, and adaptability. However, in practical applications, constraints such as poor catalytic selectivity and high costs need to be overcome.

paragraphs.zh: 本文探讨了纳米酶在能源和环境领域的应用前景，其具备高稳定性、低成本及结构可调性，适用于恶劣条件下的催化反应。在能源领域，纳米酶可用于氧还原、氢演算和二氧化碳转化，支持生物燃料电池、人工光合作用系统等发展；在环境领域，纳米酶可用于污染物降解、废水处理及抗菌消毒。其优势在于高效、可重复使用且适应性强。然而，实际应用中需克服催化选择性差、成本高等约束。

fields.en: Future research could focus on developing more efficient nanoenzymes to achieve the synergistic optimization of environmental remediation and energy conversion. For example, exploring how structural design can enhance the stability and selectivity of nanoenzymes under complex conditions, as well as how to integrate nanoenzymes into large-scale green technologies. Additionally, further study on the effects of different metal alloy ratios on H₂O₂ production rates and catalytic performance may provide more optimal catalyst solutions for industrial applications.
fields.zh: 未来研究可聚焦于开发更高效的纳米酶以实现环境修复与能源转换的协同优化。例如，探索如何通过结构设计提升纳米酶在复杂条件下的稳定性和选择性，以及如何将纳米酶集成到大规模绿色技术中。此外，进一步研究不同金属合金比例对H₂O₂产率和催化性能的影响，可能为工业应用提供更优的催化剂方案。

decisions.focus: Supramolecular Zinc–Polyphenol Coordination Assemblies Mitigate Colonic Inflammation by Regulating Mucosal Barrier and Microbiome

This study presents a novel supramolecular coordination strategy using zinc and polyphenols to mitigate colonic inflammation by enhancing mucosal barrier integrity and microbiome regulation. The engineered ZnCA NPs demonstrate superior stability, dispersibility, and efficacy in scavenging reactive oxygen and nitrogen species, as well as modulating the gut microbiota to prevent dysbiosis. The work represents a significant advancement in polyphenol nanomedicine by transitioning from fragile physical assemblies to robust metal–phenolic coordination networks for improved intestinal inflammation prevention.

classification_audit.abstract: ABSTRACT To overcome the poor bioavailability and environmental instability of physical polyphenol co‐assemblies while maximizing their preventive efficacy, the authors engineered carrier‐free, metal–phenolic coordination nanoparticles (ZnCA NPs) utilizing divalent zinc (Zn 2+ ) to bridge curcumin and anthocyanin. This coordination chemistry transforms the binary polyphenols into a stable, quasi‐amorphous state, substantially enhancing their aqueous dispersibility and gastrointestinal stability. Benefiting from this structural evolution, ZnCA NPs exhibited superior colonic accumulation and efficient reactive oxygen and nitrogen species scavenging. In zebrafish and murine colitis models, ZnCA NPs effectively reinforced the mucosal barrier and mitigated microenvironmental inflammation. Mechanistically, transcriptomic profiling revealed that ZnCA NPs modulated the colonic microenvironment by downregulating core NF‐κB, MAPK, and JAK‐STAT signaling cascades. Crucially, ZnCA NPs enriched beneficial commensals, most prominently Muribaculaceae, to attenuate dextran sulfate sodium‐induced dysbiosis; the functional contribution of this remodeled microbiota in maintaining colonic homeostasis was microbiota transplantation. This study transitions polyphenol nanomedicine from fragile physical self‐assembly to robust metal–phenolic coordination for enhanced prevention of intestinal inflammation. Keywords: colitis prevention, dysbiosis regulation, epithelial barrier integrity, metal–phenolic networks (MPNs), RONS scavenging, zinc coordination

items.action:
本研究通过构建锌-多酚配位纳米颗粒（ZnCA NPs）来缓解结肠炎症，其核心在于利用二价锌离子作为连接剂，将姜黄素和花青素转化为稳定的准非晶态结构，从而显著提高其在水中的分散性和胃肠道稳定性。该配位化学不仅增强了抗氧化能力，还通过调节黏膜屏障和微生物群落恢复了肠道微环境的平衡。实验结果表明，ZnCA NPs能够有效增强黏膜屏障并减轻炎症反应，同时通过下调NF-κB、MAPK和JAK-STAT信号通路来调控结肠微环境。此外，ZnCA NPs富集有益菌群，特别是毛螺菌科，从而缓解了硫酸二甲酯诱导的微生物失调。研究还发现，这种重塑的微生物群在维持肠道稳态中发挥了功能作用，通过微生物移植得以验证。综上所述，该研究将多酚纳米药物从脆弱的物理自组装转向稳定的金属-多酚配位结构，为增强预防肠炎提供了新的策略。

ZnCA NPs的制备和表征显示，其形态、元素分布及热力学特性均符合预期。通过分子动力学模拟进一步揭示了配位复合物的热力学稳定性和协调行为。在抗氧化能力测试中，ABTS自由基清除实验表明ZnCA具有显著的抗氧化活性；DPPH自由基清除实验也证实了其良好的抗自由基性能。羟基自由基（·OH）生成实验进一步验证了ZnCA对·OH的高效清除能力，而一氧化氮（NO•）自由基清除实验则显示其在NO•清除方面的优异表现。

在斑马鱼模型中，ZnCA NPs表现出良好的生物相容性和抗毒性。通过建立结肠炎模型，研究发现ZnCA NPs能够有效改善肠道免疫细胞迁移并维持黏膜屏障完整性。这些结果表明，ZnCA NPs不仅具有优异的抗氧化和抗菌性能，还能够在体内有效调控肠道微环境，为预防和治疗炎症性肠病提供了新的思路和方法。

综上所述，本研究通过构建稳定的金属-多酚配位纳米结构，成功实现了对结肠炎症的有效缓解。该策略不仅提高了多酚药物的生物利用度和稳定性，还为未来开发更高效的肠道疾病治疗方法奠定了基础。
items.research_logic: 作者通过构建ZnCA纳米颗粒，提出了一种新的假说：利用金属-酚类配位网络调节肠道微生态和黏膜屏障以缓解炎症。首先，通过实验验证了ZnCA NPs的结构稳定性及抗氧化能力（p7-p13），随后在斑马鱼模型中测试其对肠炎的预防效果（p14-p18）。通过比较不同处理组的免疫细胞迁移、肠道微生物组成和氧化应激水平，作者排除了其他可能的解释，如物理自组装结构的稳定性不足。综述分析则通过系统整合实验数据，强调金属-酚类配位网络在增强肠道屏障和调节微生物群落方面的独特优势。每一步实验设计均基于对前文理论框架的深入理解，并通过对照组验证了结果的可靠性。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，该研究通过构建金属-酚类网络（MPNs）实现锌-多酚纳米颗粒（ZnCA NPs）的稳定组装，从而有效调控肠道微环境和黏膜屏障，缓解炎症性肠病。这一实验设计可迁移至其他需要稳定纳米结构以调节生物系统平衡的领域，如癌症治疗或免疫疾病管理。但其适用边界在于依赖特定金属-酚类配位机制，且需确保载体自由度以避免副作用。
items.selection_reason: 本研究通过构建锌-多酚配位纳米颗粒（ZnCA NPs），实现了对肠道炎症的高效预防。该体系利用二价锌桥接曲霉素和花青素，将二元多酚转化为稳定、类非晶态结构，显著提升其水分散性和胃肠道稳定性。ZnCA NPs在小鼠结肠炎模型中有效增强黏膜屏障并减轻微环境炎症，其机制涉及下调核心NF-κB、MAPK和JAK-STAT信号通路，并富集有益菌群（如Muribaculaceae）以缓解硫酸二甲酯诱导的菌群失调。该研究将多酚纳米药物从脆弱的物理自组装转向稳定的金属-多酚配位体系，为肠道炎症预防提供了更有效的解决方案。
items.application_prospects: 本文研究的金属-酚类网络（MPNs）在肠道炎症预防中展现出应用前景，其通过调节黏膜屏障和微生物群实现对结肠炎的抑制。ZnCA NPs通过非共价相互作用和金属-酚类配位构建，具有良好的水分散性和胃肠道稳定性，可有效清除活性氧物种（RONS）。该体系在斑马鱼模型中表现出增强黏膜屏障和减轻炎症的效果，且能调节微生物群平衡，改善肠道微环境。实现条件包括精确的配位控制和稳定的纳米结构，约束在于其对生物体的潜在毒性需进一步评估。
items.future_directions: 未来研究可进一步探索ZnCA NPs在不同肠道炎症模型中的应用潜力，以及其对微生物群落动态变化的长期影响。此外，需验证ZnCA NPs在人体中的安全性和生物利用度，以评估其作为新型肠炎预防剂的临床转化前景。

fields.en:
This study alleviates colonic inflammation by constructing zinc-polyphenol coordination nanoparticles (ZnCA NPs), with the core focus on utilizing divalent zinc ions as a linker to convert curcumin and anthocyanin into a stable quasiamorphous structure, significantly enhancing their dispersibility in water and gastrointestinal stability. This coordination chemistry not only enhances antioxidant capacity but also restores the balance of the gut microenvironment by regulating the mucosal barrier and microbial community. Experimental results show that ZnCA NPs can effectively enhance the mucosal barrier and alleviate inflammatory responses, while modulating the colonic microenvironment by downregulating the NF-κB, MAPK, and JAK-STAT signaling pathways. Furthermore, ZnCA NPs enrich beneficial bacteria, particularly the Bacteroidetes, thereby alleviating microbial dysbiosis induced by methyl sulfate. The study also found that this reshaped microbiota plays a functional role in maintaining gut homeostasis, which was validated through microbial transplantation. In conclusion, this study shifts the multi-phenol nanomedicine from fragile physical self-assembly to a stable metal-polyphenol coordination structure, providing new strategies for enhancing the prevention of colitis.

The preparation and characterization of ZnCA NPs show that their morphology, elemental distribution, and thermodynamic properties are all in line with the expectations. Molecular dynamics simulations further reveal the thermodynamic stability and coordination behavior of the coordination complex. In antioxidant capacity tests, the ABTS radical scavenging experiment shows that ZnCA has significant antioxidant activity; the DPPH radical scavenging experiment also confirms its good performance in radical scavenging. The generation experiment of hydroxyl radicals (·OH) further verifies the efficient scavenging ability of ZnCA for ·OH, while the nitric oxide (NO•) radical scavenging experiment shows its excellent performance in NO• scavenging.

In the zebrafish model, ZnCA NPs exhibit good biocompatibility and antitoxicity. By establishing a colitis model, it was found that ZnCA NPs can effectively improve the migration of intestinal immune cells and maintain the integrity of the mucosal barrier. These results indicate that ZnCA NPs not only have excellent antioxidant and antibacterial properties but can also effectively regulate the gut microenvironment in vivo, providing new ideas and methods for the prevention and treatment of inflammatory bowel diseases.

In summary, this study successfully achieved effective relief of colonic inflammation by constructing stable metal-polyphenol coordination nanosystems. This strategy not only enhances the bioavailability and stability of polyphenolic drugs but also lays a foundation for future development of more efficient treatments for intestinal diseases.

在斑马鱼模型中，ZnCA NPs表现出良好的生物相容性和抗毒性。通过建立结肠炎模型，研究发现ZnCA NPs能够有效改善肠道免疫细胞迁移并维持黏膜屏障完整性。这些结果表明，ZnCA NPs不仅具有优异的抗氧化和抗菌性能，还能够在体内有效调控肠道微环境，为预防和治疗炎症性肠病提供了新的思路和方法。

综上所述，本研究通过构建稳定的金属-多酚配位纳米结构，成功实现了对结肠炎症的有效缓解。该策略不仅提高了多酚药物的生物利用度和稳定性，还为未来开发更高效的肠道疾病治疗方法奠定了基础。

paragraphs.en: This study alleviates colonic inflammation by constructing zinc-polyphenol coordination nanoparticles (ZnCA NPs), with the core focus on utilizing divalent zinc ions as a linker to convert curcumin and anthocyanin into a stable quasiamorphous structure, significantly enhancing their dispersibility in water and gastrointestinal stability. This coordination chemistry not only enhances antioxidant capacity but also restores the balance of the gut microenvironment by regulating the mucosal barrier and microbial community. Experimental results show that ZnCA NPs can effectively enhance the mucosal barrier and alleviate inflammatory responses, while modulating the colonic microenvironment by downregulating the NF-κB, MAPK, and JAK-STAT signaling pathways. Furthermore, ZnCA NPs enrich beneficial bacteria, particularly the Bacteroidetes, thereby alleviating microbial dysbiosis induced by methyl sulfate. The study also found that this reshaped microbiota plays a functional role in maintaining gut homeostasis, which was validated through microbial transplantation. In conclusion, this study shifts the multi-phenol nanomedicine from fragile physical self-assembly to a stable metal-polyphenol coordination structure, providing new strategies for enhancing the prevention of colitis.

paragraphs.en: The preparation and characterization of ZnCA NPs show that their morphology, elemental distribution, and thermodynamic properties are all in line with the expectations. Molecular dynamics simulations further reveal the thermodynamic stability and coordination behavior of the coordination complex. In antioxidant capacity tests, the ABTS radical scavenging experiment shows that ZnCA has significant antioxidant activity; the DPPH radical scavenging experiment also confirms its good performance in radical scavenging. The generation experiment of hydroxyl radicals (·OH) further verifies the efficient scavenging ability of ZnCA for ·OH, while the nitric oxide (NO•) radical scavenging experiment shows its excellent performance in NO• scavenging.

paragraphs.en: In the zebrafish model, ZnCA NPs exhibit good biocompatibility and antitoxicity. By establishing a colitis model, it was found that ZnCA NPs can effectively improve the migration of intestinal immune cells and maintain the integrity of the mucosal barrier. These results indicate that ZnCA NPs not only have excellent antioxidant and antibacterial properties but can also effectively regulate the gut microenvironment in vivo, providing new ideas and methods for the prevention and treatment of inflammatory bowel diseases.

paragraphs.en: In summary, this study successfully achieved effective relief of colonic inflammation by constructing stable metal-polyphenol coordination nanosystems. This strategy not only enhances the bioavailability and stability of polyphenolic drugs but also lays a foundation for future development of more efficient treatments for intestinal diseases.

fields.en: The author proposed a new hypothesis by constructing ZnCA nanoparticles: using metal-phenol coordination networks to regulate the gut microbiota and mucosal barrier to alleviate inflammation. First, the structural stability and antioxidant capacity of ZnCA NPs were experimentally validated (p7-p13), followed by testing their preventive effects on colitis in zebrafish models (p14-p18). By comparing immune cell migration, gut microbiota composition, and oxidative stress levels across different treatment groups, the author excluded other possible explanations, such as insufficient stability of physical self-assembled structures. The review analysis emphasized the unique advantages of metal-phenol coordination networks in enhancing the intestinal barrier and regulating the microbial community through systematic integration of experimental data. Each experimental design was based on a deep understanding of the previous theoretical framework and was verified for reliability through control groups.
fields.zh: 作者通过构建ZnCA纳米颗粒，提出了一种新的假说：利用金属-酚类配位网络调节肠道微生态和黏膜屏障以缓解炎症。首先，通过实验验证了ZnCA NPs的结构稳定性及抗氧化能力（p7-p13），随后在斑马鱼模型中测试其对肠炎的预防效果（p14-p18）。通过比较不同处理组的免疫细胞迁移、肠道微生物组成和氧化应激水平，作者排除了其他可能的解释，如物理自组装结构的稳定性不足。综述分析则通过系统整合实验数据，强调金属-酚类配位网络在增强肠道屏障和调节微生物群落方面的独特优势。每一步实验设计均基于对前文理论框架的深入理解，并通过对照组验证了结果的可靠性。

fields.en: My conclusion is that this study achieves the stable assembly of zinc-polyphe-nol nanoparticles (ZnCA NPs) by constructing metal-phenolic networks (MPNs), thereby effectively regulating the gut microenvironment and mucosal barrier to alleviate inflammatory bowel disease. This experimental design can be transferred to other fields that require stable nanoscale structures to regulate biological system balance, such as cancer therapy or immunological disease management. However, its applicability is limited by its dependence on specific metal-phenolic coordination mechanisms and the need to ensure carrier freedom to avoid side effects.
fields.zh: 我的归纳是，该研究通过构建金属-酚类网络（MPNs）实现锌-多酚纳米颗粒（ZnCA NPs）的稳定组装，从而有效调控肠道微环境和黏膜屏障，缓解炎症性肠病。这一实验设计可迁移至其他需要稳定纳米结构以调节生物系统平衡的领域，如癌症治疗或免疫疾病管理。但其适用边界在于依赖特定金属-酚类配位机制，且需确保载体自由度以避免副作用。

fields.label_en: Why selected and what is innovative
fields.label_zh: 推荐理由与创新点（详细）
fields.en: This study achieved efficient prevention of intestinal inflammation by constructing zinc-polyphenol coordination nanoparticles (ZnCA NPs). The system utilizes divalent zinc to bridge curcumin and anthocyanin, converting a binary polyphenol into a stable, amorphous structure, significantly enhancing its water dispersibility and gastrointestinal stability. ZnCA NPs effectively enhanced the mucosal barrier and alleviated microenvironmental inflammation in mice with colitis models, with mechanisms involving downregulation of core NF-κB, MAPK, and JAK-STAT signaling pathways, and enrichment of beneficial microbial communities (such as Muribaculaceae) to alleviate gut microbiota dysbiosis induced by dimethyl sulfate. This study shifted polyphenol nanomedicines from fragile physical self-assembly to a stable metal-polyphenol coordination system, providing a more effective solution for the prevention of intestinal inflammation.

fields.en: The metal-phenol network (MPNs) studied in this paper shows promising application prospects for the prevention of intestinal inflammation, as it can inhibit colitis by regulating the mucosal barrier and microbiota. ZnCA NPs, through non-covalent interactions and metal-phenol coordination, exhibit good water dispersibility and gastrointestinal stability, effectively scavenging reactive oxygen species (RONS). The system demonstrates enhanced mucosal barrier function and reduced inflammation in zebrafish models, while also regulating microbial community balance and improving the gut microenvironment. The implementation conditions include precise coordination control and stable nanoscale structures, with constraints lying in the need for further assessment of potential toxicity to living organisms.
fields.zh: 本文研究的金属-酚类网络（MPNs）在肠道炎症预防中展现出应用前景，其通过调节黏膜屏障和微生物群实现对结肠炎的抑制。ZnCA NPs通过非共价相互作用和金属-酚类配位构建，具有良好的水分散性和胃肠道稳定性，可有效清除活性氧物种（RONS）。该体系在斑马鱼模型中表现出增强黏膜屏障和减轻炎症的效果，且能调节微生物群平衡，改善肠道微环境。实现条件包括精确的配位控制和稳定的纳米结构，约束在于其对生物体的潜在毒性需进一步评估。

fields.en: Future research could further explore the potential application of ZnCA NPs in different intestinal inflammation models, as well as their long-term impact on microbial community dynamics. Additionally, it is necessary to verify the safety and bioavailability of ZnCA NPs in humans to assess their clinical translation potential as a novel agent for preventing enteritis.

decisions.focus: Selective electrochemical oxygenation of benzylic C–H bonds using ambient air and an Fe–N–C electrocatalyst

The study presents a novel electrochemical strategy for the selective oxygenation of benzylic C–H bonds using ambient air and an Fe–N–C electrocatalyst, achieving high yields and selectivity without external oxidants or redox mediators. The mechanism involves cathodic O2 activation to generate superoxide radicals and anodic oxidation of substrates to form benzylic radicals, which then react with the radicals to form aldehydes and ketones. This method offers a sustainable, operationally simple platform for benzylic C–H oxygenation.

classification_audit.abstract: Selective benzylic C–H electrochemical oxygenation is achieved using ambient air via a cathode-loaded Fe–N–C electrocatalyst, in which Fe sites serve as the primary catalytically active species. This protocol provides a range of aromatic aldehydes and ketones in up to 96% isolated yields with broad functional group tolerance. Mechanistic studies reveal that the reaction proceeds through a superoxide radical anion (O 2 ˙ − ) generated at the cathode and a benzylic radical intermediate generated at the anode. Notably, this cathodic ORR-coupled anodic oxidation strategy is free from external chemical oxidants and uses ethanol as a green solvent, highlighting its advantages in sustainable electrochemical C–H functionalization.

items.action:
本研究开发了一种电化学策略，用于选择性氧化苯基C–H键。该方法利用空气作为氧源，并以Fe–N–C替代贵金属电极，反应无需外部氧化剂或还原介质。机理研究表明，Fe位点是活性中心，阴极O₂活化生成超氧阴离子自由基是关键步骤，使苯基甲基和苯基亚甲基底物高效转化为芳香醛和酮，具有优异的选择性。该方法操作简便、反应条件温和、可持续性强，为苯基C–H氧化提供了一种实用且可扩展的替代方案。

本研究的关键设计在于采用Fe–N–C电催化剂负载于石墨毡电极上，通过阴极活化O₂生成超氧自由基，并与阳极生成的苯基自由基结合形成过氧化物中间体，最终转化为目标产物。实验表明，该策略在常温常压下可实现高产率和高选择性，且反应时间短（2–3小时），适用于广泛底物范围。

通过对比不同电极材料及溶剂条件，研究发现Fe–N–C电催化剂显著提升了阴极反应活性，而其他电极如Pt板或镍泡沫则表现较差。此外，实验还验证了水并非氧源，且电流强度的增减均影响反应性能。该方法在扩展规模时仍能保持高产率（10 mmol规模下86%），并可耐受多种电子给体和电子吸电子基团的底物。

综上所述，本研究提出了一种基于Fe–N–C电催化剂的电化学氧化策略，实现了苯基C–H键的选择性氧化。该方法无需外部氧化剂或还原介质，利用空气作为氧源，具有环境友好、操作简便和可持续性的优势，为苯基C–H氧化提供了一种高效且可扩展的解决方案。
items.research_logic: 作者提出假说通过Fe–N–C电催化剂在常温下实现苯基C–H的电化学氧化，随后通过实验验证该策略的有效性。首先，作者采用Fe–N–C电催化剂替代传统惰性电极，并在常压空气中进行反应，无需额外氧化剂或还原介质，从而证明了该方法的可行性。接着，通过对比不同电极材料（如Pt板、镍泡沫）和溶剂（如乙醇、甲苯等），验证Fe–N–C电催化剂在催化活性和选择性方面的优势。此外，作者通过控制实验排除水作为氧源的可能性，并进一步探讨反应机制，确认超氧化物自由基在反应中的关键作用。综述分析则通过系统比较不同条件下的产物产率、选择性和反应时间，证明该方法具有高效、环保的特点。这些步骤的设置确保了实验结果的可靠性，并为后续研究提供了理论基础。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，该研究通过Fe–N–C电催化剂在常温下实现苯基C–H键的高效氧化，其核心在于 cathodic ORR 生成超氧阴离子自由基与 anodic oxidation 生成的苯基自由基的协同作用。这一机制可迁移至其他含活性氢的底物氧化反应中，但需确保反应体系具备足够的氧气活化能力及适宜的溶剂环境。
items.selection_reason: 该研究通过Fe–N–C电催化剂在常温常压下实现苯基C–H键的高效选择性氧化，突破传统方法依赖外部氧化剂和复杂添加剂的限制。实验采用石墨毡电极负载Fe–N–C催化剂，利用空气中的氧气作为氧化源，避免了纯氧环境和额外化学试剂的使用。反应机制显示，阴极生成超氧自由基（O₂˙⁻），与阳极生成的苯基自由基结合形成过氧化物中间体，最终转化为目标产物。该方法具有操作简便、条件温和、可持续性强的特点，且在多种底物上表现出高选择性和产率，如1-四氢萘可实现93%收率和98%转化率。与传统电化学方法相比，本研究通过优化催化剂设计和反应条件，显著提升了催化效率和反应可控性，为苯基C–H键氧化提供了新的可行路径。
items.application_prospects: 本文提出了一种利用Fe–N–C电催化剂在常温常压下实现苯基C–H键选择性氧化的电化学方法，该方法无需外部氧化剂或还原介质，使用乙醇作为绿色溶剂。实验表明，该策略能高效生成芳香醛和酮，在2-3小时内完成反应，具有操作简便、条件温和和可持续性的优势。然而，该方法对溶剂选择敏感，且在某些长链底物中存在氧化裂解的竞争反应，限制了其广泛应用。
items.future_directions: 本文提出未来可检验的问题：如何进一步优化Fe–N–C电催化剂的结构以提升其在不同溶剂中的稳定性和催化活性？此外，探索该策略在更广泛底物范围内的应用潜力，特别是对于含电子给体/受体基团的化合物。同时，研究该方法在不同氧气浓度下的反应动力学，以明确其对反应效率的影响。

fields.en:
A electrochemical strategy has been developed for the selective oxidation of benzyl C–H bonds. The method utilizes air as an oxygen source and employs Fe–N–C as a replacement for precious metal electrodes, with the reaction requiring no external oxidizing agent or reducing medium. Mechanistic studies show that Fe sites are active centers, and the key step is the activation of O₂ at the cathode to generate superoxide radicals, which efficiently convert benzyl methyl and benzyl methylene substrates into aromatic aldehydes and ketones with excellent selectivity. The method is simple in operation, mild in reaction conditions, and sustainable, providing a practical and scalable alternative for the oxidation of benzyl C–H bonds.

The key design of this study lies in using an Fe–N–C electrocatalyst loaded on a graphite felt electrode, through cathodic activation of O₂ to generate superoxide radicals, which then combine with the phenyl radical generated at the anode to form a peroxides intermediate, ultimately converting to the target product. The experiment shows that the strategy can achieve high yield and high selectivity under ambient temperature and pressure, with a short reaction time (2–3 hours), making it suitable for a wide range of substrates.

By comparing different electrode materials and solvent conditions, it was found that the Fe–N–C electrocatalyst significantly enhanced the cathodic reaction activity, while other electrodes such as Pt plates or nickel foam performed poorly. Additionally, the experiment verified that water is not a source of oxygen, and changes in current intensity both affect reaction performance. This method maintains high yield (86% at 10 mmol scale) when scaled up and can tolerate various electron-donating and electron-withdrawing groups as substrates.

In summary, this study proposes an electrochemical oxidation strategy based on Fe–N–C electrocatalysts for the selective oxidation of phenyl C–H bonds. The method does not require external oxidizing agents or reducing media, utilizing air as the oxygen source, offering advantages of environmental friendliness, ease of operation, and sustainability, providing an efficient and scalable solution for phenyl C–H oxidation.

fields.en: The author proposed a hypothesis that phenyl C–H oxidation could be achieved under ambient temperature using Fe–N–C electrocatalysts, followed by experimental validation of the strategy's effectiveness. First, the author replaced traditional inert electrodes with Fe–N–C electrocatalysts and conducted the reaction under atmospheric air without additional oxidizing or reducing agents, thereby demonstrating the feasibility of the method. Next, by comparing different electrode materials (such as Pt plates, nickel foam) and solvents (such as ethanol, toluene, etc.), the advantages of Fe–N–C electrocatalysts in catalytic activity and selectivity were verified. Additionally, the author conducted controlled experiments to exclude water as a potential oxygen source and further explored the reaction mechanism, confirming the critical role of superoxide radicals in the reaction. The review analysis systematically compared product yields, selectivities, and reaction times under different conditions, proving that the method is efficient and environmentally friendly. paragraphs.en: The author proposed a hypothesis that phenyl C–H oxidation could be achieved under ambient temperature using Fe–N–C electrocatalysts, followed by experimental validation of the strategy's effectiveness. First, the author replaced traditional inert electrodes with Fe–N–C electrocatalysts and conducted the reaction under atmospheric air without additional oxidizing or reducing agents, thereby demonstrating the feasibility of the method. Next, by comparing different electrode materials (such as Pt plates, nickel foam) and solvents (such as ethanol, toluene, etc.), the advantages of Fe–N–C electrocatalysts in catalytic activity and selectivity were verified. Additionally, the author conducted controlled experiments to exclude water as a potential oxygen source and further explored the reaction mechanism, confirming the critical role of superoxide radicals in the reaction. The review analysis systematically compared product yields, selectivities, and reaction times under different conditions, proving that the method is efficient and environmentally friendly. These steps ensure the reliability of the experimental results and provide a theoretical foundation for future research.

fields.en: My conclusion is that this study achieves efficient oxidation of the phenyl C–H bond at room temperature using Fe–N–C electrocatalysts, with the core mechanism involving the synergistic action between the superoxide anion radical generated from cathodic ORR and the phenyl radical produced from anodic oxidation. This mechanism can be applied to other oxidation reactions of substrates containing active hydrogen, but it requires that the reaction system has sufficient oxygen activation capability and appropriate solvent environment.
fields.zh: 我的归纳是，该研究通过Fe–N–C电催化剂在常温下实现苯基C–H键的高效氧化，其核心在于 cathodic ORR 生成超氧阴离子自由基与 anodic oxidation 生成的苯基自由基的协同作用。这一机制可迁移至其他含活性氢的底物氧化反应中，但需确保反应体系具备足够的氧气活化能力及适宜的溶剂环境。

fields.label_en: Why selected and what is innovative
fields.label_zh: 推荐理由与创新点（详细）
fields.en: This study achieves efficient selective oxidation of the C–H bond in phenyl under ambient temperature and pressure using an Fe–N–C electrocatalyst, breaking the limitations of traditional methods that rely on external oxidants and complex additives. The experiment uses a graphite felt electrode loaded with Fe–N–C catalyst, utilizing oxygen from the air as the oxidant, avoiding pure oxygen environments and additional chemical reagents. The reaction mechanism shows that superoxide radicals (O₂˙⁻) are generated at the cathode, which combine with phenyl radicals produced at the anode to form peroxides, ultimately converting into the target product. This method is characterized by simple operation, mild conditions, and strong sustainability, demonstrating high selectivity and yield on various substrates, such as 1-tetralin achieving 93% yield and 98% conversion rate. Compared with traditional electrochemical methods, this study significantly enhances catalytic efficiency and reaction controllability through optimized catalyst design and reaction conditions, providing a new feasible pathway for the oxidation of C–H bonds in phenyl.
fields.zh: 该研究通过Fe–N–C电催化剂在常温常压下实现苯基C–H键的高效选择性氧化，突破传统方法依赖外部氧化剂和复杂添加剂的限制。实验采用石墨毡电极负载Fe–N–C催化剂，利用空气中的氧气作为氧化源，避免了纯氧环境和额外化学试剂的使用。反应机制显示，阴极生成超氧自由基（O₂˙⁻），与阳极生成的苯基自由基结合形成过氧化物中间体，最终转化为目标产物。该方法具有操作简便、条件温和、可持续性强的特点，且在多种底物上表现出高选择性和产率，如1-四氢萘可实现93%收率和98%转化率。与传统电化学方法相比，本研究通过优化催化剂设计和反应条件，显著提升了催化效率和反应可控性，为苯基C–H键氧化提供了新的可行路径。
