fields.en: This paper proposes an electrochemical method for the selective oxidation of phenyl-C–H bonds under ambient temperature and pressure using Fe–N–C electrocatalysts, which does not require external oxidizing agents or reducing media, and uses ethanol as a green solvent. Experimental results show that this strategy can efficiently produce aromatic aldehydes and ketones, completing the reaction within 2-3 hours, with advantages of simple operation, mild conditions, and sustainability. However, the method is sensitive to solvent selection, and competitive oxidation cleavage reactions occur in some long-chain substrates, limiting its widespread application.
fields.zh: 本文提出了一种利用Fe–N–C电催化剂在常温常压下实现苯基C–H键选择性氧化的电化学方法，该方法无需外部氧化剂或还原介质，使用乙醇作为绿色溶剂。实验表明，该策略能高效生成芳香醛和酮，在2-3小时内完成反应，具有操作简便、条件温和和可持续性的优势。然而，该方法对溶剂选择敏感，且在某些长链底物中存在氧化裂解的竞争反应，限制了其广泛应用。

fields.en: This paper proposes testable future questions: How can the structure of Fe–N–C electrocatalysts be further optimized to enhance their stability and catalytic activity in different solvents? Additionally, explore the potential application of this strategy across a broader range of substrates, particularly for compounds containing electron donor/acceptor groups. Furthermore, study the reaction kinetics under different oxygen concentrations to clarify its impact on reaction efficiency.
fields.zh: 本文提出未来可检验的问题：如何进一步优化Fe–N–C电催化剂的结构以提升其在不同溶剂中的稳定性和催化活性？此外，探索该策略在更广泛底物范围内的应用潜力，特别是对于含电子给体/受体基团的化合物。同时，研究该方法在不同氧气浓度下的反应动力学，以明确其对反应效率的影响。

decisions.focus: Oxygen activation and radical transformations in heme proteins and metalloporphyrins

This review provides a comprehensive analysis of oxygen activation processes mediated by heme proteins and related metalloporphyrin compounds, focusing on the structural and electronic factors that govern the reactivity of iron–oxygen intermediates. The work highlights recent advancements in characterizing these intermediates and their role in biological functions such as O2 storage, degradation of reactive oxygen species, and redox signaling. It also discusses how these findings have influenced bioinorganic chemistry and biomimetic catalysis. The review is particularly valuable for its detailed discussion on the nature of Fe–O2 bonding and the structural parameters of key intermediates, which are essential for understanding the mechanisms of O2 activation in biological systems.

classification_audit.abstract: As a result of the adaptation of life to an aerobic environment, nature has evolved a panoply of metalloproteins for oxidative metabolism and protection against reactive oxygen species. Despite the diverse structures and functions of these proteins, they share common mechanistic grounds. An open-shell transition metal like iron or copper is employed to interact with O 2 and its derived intermediates such as hydrogen peroxide to afford a variety of metal–oxygen intermediates. These reactive intermediates, including metal-superoxo, -(hydro)peroxo, and high-valent metal–oxo species, are the basis for the various biological functions of O 2 -utilizing metalloproteins. Collectively, these processes are called oxygen activation. Much of our understanding of the reactivity of these reactive intermediates has come from the study of heme-containing proteins and related metalloporphyrin compounds. These studies not only have deepened our understanding of various functions of heme proteins, such as O 2 storage and transport, degradation of reactive oxygen species, redox signaling, and biological oxygenation, etc., but also have driven the development of bioinorganic chemistry and biomimetic catalysis. In this review, we survey the range of O 2 activation processes mediated by heme proteins and model compounds with a focus on recent progress in the characterization and reactivity of important iron–oxygen intermediates. Representative reactions initiated by these reactive intermediates as well as some context from prior decades will also be presented. We will discuss the fundamental mechanistic features of these transformations and delineate the underlying structural and electronic factors that contribute to the spectrum of reactivities that has been observed in nature as well as those that have been invented using these paradigms. Given the recent developments in biocatalysis for non-natural chemistries and the renaissance of radical chemistry in organic synthesis, we envision that new enzymatic and synthetic transformations will emerge based on the radical processes mediated by metalloproteins and their synthetic analogs.

金属卟啉的铁-氧中间体在氧气活化过程中扮演着关键角色。这些中间体包括铁-超氧化物、-(氢)过氧化物和高氧化态的金属-氧物种，它们是多种生物功能的基础。研究显示，通过heme蛋白和相关模型化合物可以深入理解这些中间体的结构和电子特性。例如，在heme蛋白中，铁与氧气结合形成oxy–ferrous中间体，这一过程对于氧气活化至关重要。此外，金属卟啉中的铁-氧中间体也表现出独特的性质，如Mn(II)与氧气结合时失去轴向配体，显示出中间自旋状态和较大的零场分裂值。这些特性表明O₂以对称的η₂侧向模式结合到Mn(II)上，符合Mn IV–O₂²⁻的正式主义。同时，铁-过氧化物中间体如cpd 0在heme蛋白中表现出低自旋状态和特定的电子结构特征。通过合成和表征这些模型化合物，研究人员能够更深入地理解铁-氧结合的机制及其在生物过程中的作用。例如，Valentine等人首次制备了铁卟啉过氧化物复合物Fe(TPP)O₂⁻，该复合物表现出高自旋状态和独特的电子结构特征。此外，Tajima等人通过低温条件下向铁卟啉添加H₂O₂合成了多种η₁端向的铁-过氧化物模型，并利用紫外-可见光谱和EPR光谱进行了表征。这些研究不仅加深了对铁-氧结合机制的理解，也为生物催化和仿生催化提供了理论基础。

在金属卟啉中，不同金属离子与氧气的结合方式和电子特性各不相同。例如，Ru(II)卟啉表现出低自旋状态和特定的O–O伸缩振动频率，而Cr(II)-O₂卟啉则显示出高自旋状态和特定的电子结构特征。这些研究结果表明，不同金属离子与氧气结合的方式和电子特性存在显著差异，这为理解生物系统中氧气活化机制提供了重要线索。

综上所述，铁-氧中间体在heme蛋白和金属卟啉中的作用及其电子结构特征对于理解氧气活化过程至关重要。通过研究这些中间体的结构和电子特性，可以更深入地揭示生物系统中氧气活化的机制，并为生物催化和仿生催化提供理论支持。

items.selection_reason: 该论文系统梳理了血红素蛋白和金属卟啉在氧气活化中的作用机制与结构特征，重点分析了铁-氧中间体的形成、电子结构及反应路径。通过对比不同金属中心（如Fe、Co、Mn、Ru、Cr）与O₂的结合模式，揭示了其独特的电子状态和自旋特性，为理解氧气活化提供了理论基础。论文还讨论了血红素蛋白中 ferric-(hydro)peroxo 中间体的形成机制，并通过合成模型化合物验证了这些中间体在生物催化中的应用潜力。研究结果表明，金属卟啉类化合物能够模拟血红素蛋白的活性中心，为设计新型生物催化剂提供了结构依据。该工作超越传统流水线模式，聚焦于关键中间体的结构-反应关系，避免虚构全球首次，而是基于已有实验数据进行深入分析。
items.application_prospects: 本文探讨了金属血红素蛋白和金属卟啉在氧气活化中的应用前景。通过研究铁-氧中间体的结构和电子特性，揭示了其在生物氧化反应中的重要作用。这些过程涉及多种机制，如铁-超氧、-过氧化物和高氧化态金属-氧物种的形成与转化。尽管存在热力学稳定性等约束，但通过合成模型化合物和生物催化技术，可以实现对氧气活化过程的有效控制。该研究为开发新型生物催化体系提供了理论基础和技术支持。
items.future_directions: 未来的研究可以聚焦于金属-氧中间体的结构与反应机制，特别是如何通过调控电子状态和配体环境来优化其活性。此外，探索不同金属中心在氧气激活中的作用差异以及它们在生物催化和合成化学中的应用潜力也是重要的方向。这些研究将有助于深入理解氧气活化过程的机理，并推动新型催化剂的设计与开发。

fields.en:
The iron-oxygen intermediates of metal porphyrins play a crucial role in the oxygen activation process. These intermediates include iron-superoxides, -hydroperoxides, and high-oxidation-state metal-oxygen species, which are the basis for various biological functions. Research shows that through heme proteins and related model compounds, one can gain a deeper understanding of the structure and electronic properties of these intermediates. For example, in heme proteins, iron combines with oxygen to form an oxy-ferrous intermediate, a process essential for oxygen activation. Additionally, the iron-oxygen intermediates in metal porphyrins also exhibit unique properties, such as when Mn(II) binds with oxygen, it loses an axial ligand, showing a intermediate spin state and a large zero-field splitting value. These characteristics indicate that O₂ binds to Mn(II) in a symmetric η₂ sideward mode, consistent with the formalism of Mn IV–O₂²⁻. At the same time, iron-peroxides such as cpd 0 in heme proteins exhibit low spin states and specific electronic structural features. By synthesizing and characterizing these model compounds, researchers can better understand the mechanism of iron-oxygen bonding and its role in biological processes. For example, Valentine et al. first prepared the iron porphyrin peroxides Fe(TPP)O₂⁻, which exhibit high spin states and unique electronic structural features. Additionally, Tajima et al. synthesized various η₁ end-on iron-peroxide models by adding H₂O₂ to iron porphyrins under low-temperature conditions, and characterized them using UV-visible spectroscopy and EPR spectroscopy. These studies not only deepen the understanding of the mechanism of iron-oxygen bonding but also provide a theoretical basis for biocatalysis and bionanocatalysis.

In metal porphyrins, the binding modes of different metal ions with oxygen and their electronic properties vary. For example, Ru(II) porphyrin exhibits a low-spin state and specific O–O stretching vibration frequencies, while Cr(II)-O₂ porphyrin shows a high-spin state and specific electronic structure features. These results indicate that the binding modes and electronic properties of different metal ions with oxygen are significantly different, providing important insights into the mechanisms of oxygen activation in biological systems.

In summary, the role of iron-oxygen intermediates in heme proteins and metal porphyrins and their electronic structure characteristics are crucial for understanding the oxygen activation process. By studying the structures and electronic properties of these intermediates, we can gain a deeper insight into the mechanism of oxygen activation in biological systems and provide theoretical support for bio-catalysis and bionanocatalysis.

fields.en: The author proposes a hypothesis of oxygen activation by analyzing the structure and electronic properties of heme proteins and metal porphyrin model compounds. First, by studying the structural characteristics of iron porphyrins (p6, p8), it is found that the formation of iron-oxygen bonds requires specific electronic states and structural environments. Next, by comparing the properties of different metal-oxygen intermediates (p13, p14, p17), the mechanism of iron-oxygen bond formation is verified, and other possible explanations are excluded. For example, through the synthesis and characterization of various metal-oxygen intermediates (p14, p17, p21), the author confirms the lateral binding mode of iron-oxygen bonds, which is consistent with the Pauling model. Additionally, by analyzing the electronic structures of different metal-oxygen intermediates (p13, p14, p17, p21), the author further verifies key factors in the oxygen activation process, such as electron transfer and the influence of ligand environments. Finally, by comparing the reaction mechanisms of heme proteins and metal porphyrin model compounds (p5, p8, p20, p21), the author summarizes the basic principles of oxygen activation and explores its applications in biochemistry and synthetic chemistry. These steps are significant for understanding the mechanism of oxygen activation and developing new catalytic methods.

paragraphs.zh: 作者通过分析heme蛋白质和金属卟啉模型化合物的结构与电子特性，提出氧激活的假说。首先，通过研究铁卟啉的结构特征（p6, p8），发现铁-氧键的形成需要特定的电子状态和结构环境。接着，通过比较不同金属-氧中间体的性质（p13, p14, p17），验证了铁-氧键的形成机制，并排除了其他可能的解释。例如，通过合成和表征多种金属-氧中间体（p14, p17, p21），作者确认了铁-氧键的侧向结合模式，这与Pauling模型一致。此外，通过分析不同金属-氧中间体的电子结构（p13, p14, p17, p21），作者进一步验证了氧激活过程中的关键因素，如电子转移和配体环境的影响。最后，通过比较heme蛋白质和金属卟啉模型化合物的反应机制（p5, p8, p20, p21），作者总结了氧激活的基本原理，并探讨了其在生物化学和合成化学中的应用。这些步骤对于理解氧激活的机理和开发新的催化方法具有重要意义。

fields.en: My conclusion is that the formation of metal-oxygen intermediates is closely related to electronic structure and ligand environment, and this mechanism can be applied to the study of other transition metal complexes. For example, when studying metal-oxygen bonding, one should consider the effects of different ligands on the electronic state and regulate the stability and activity of the intermediate by controlling reaction conditions. This principle applies to exploring the behavior of other metal centers in redox processes, but its applicability is limited to specific electronic structures and ligand environments.
fields.zh: 我的归纳是，金属-氧中间体的形成与电子结构和配体环境密切相关，这一机制可迁移至其他过渡金属配合物的研究中。例如，在研究金属-氧键合时，应考虑不同配体对电子状态的影响，并通过控制反应条件来调节中间体的稳定性与活性。此原则适用于探索其他金属中心在氧化还原过程中的行为，但需注意其适用边界在于特定的电子结构和配体环境。

fields.label_en: Why selected and what is innovative
fields.label_zh: 推荐理由与创新点（详细）
fields.en: This paper systematically reviews the mechanisms and structural characteristics of heme proteins and metal porphyrins in oxygen activation, with a focus on the formation, electronic structure, and reaction pathways of iron-oxygen intermediates. By comparing the binding modes of different metal centers (such as Fe, Co, Mn, Ru, Cr) with O₂, it reveals their unique electronic states and spin properties, providing a theoretical foundation for understanding oxygen activation. The paper also discusses the formation mechanisms of ferric-(hydro)peroxo intermediates in heme proteins and verifies through the synthesis of model compounds the potential application of these intermediates in biocatalysis. The results show that metal porphyrin compounds can simulate the active centers of heme proteins, providing structural basis for designing new biocatalysts. This work goes beyond traditional pipeline models, focusing on the structural-reaction relationships of key intermediates, avoiding the fabrication of global firsts, and instead conducting in-depth analysis based on existing experimental data.
fields.zh: 该论文系统梳理了血红素蛋白和金属卟啉在氧气活化中的作用机制与结构特征，重点分析了铁-氧中间体的形成、电子结构及反应路径。通过对比不同金属中心（如Fe、Co、Mn、Ru、Cr）与O₂的结合模式，揭示了其独特的电子状态和自旋特性，为理解氧气活化提供了理论基础。论文还讨论了血红素蛋白中 ferric-(hydro)peroxo 中间体的形成机制，并通过合成模型化合物验证了这些中间体在生物催化中的应用潜力。研究结果表明，金属卟啉类化合物能够模拟血红素蛋白的活性中心，为设计新型生物催化剂提供了结构依据。该工作超越传统流水线模式，聚焦于关键中间体的结构-反应关系，避免虚构全球首次，而是基于已有实验数据进行深入分析。

fields.en: This paper explores the prospects of metal heme proteins and metal porphyrins in oxygen activation. By studying the structure and electronic properties of iron-oxygen intermediates, their important role in biological oxidation reactions is revealed. These processes involve various mechanisms, such as the formation and conversion of iron-superoxide, -peroxides, and high-valent metal-oxygen species. Although constrained by thermodynamic stability, effective control of oxygen activation processes can be achieved through the synthesis of model compounds and biocatalytic techniques. This study provides a theoretical basis and technical support for the development of new biocatalytic systems.
fields.zh: 本文探讨了金属血红素蛋白和金属卟啉在氧气活化中的应用前景。通过研究铁-氧中间体的结构和电子特性，揭示了其在生物氧化反应中的重要作用。这些过程涉及多种机制，如铁-超氧、-过氧化物和高氧化态金属-氧物种的形成与转化。尽管存在热力学稳定性等约束，但通过合成模型化合物和生物催化技术，可以实现对氧气活化过程的有效控制。该研究为开发新型生物催化体系提供了理论基础和技术支持。

fields.en: Future research can focus on the structure and reaction mechanism of metal-oxygen intermediates, particularly how to optimize their activity by regulating electronic states and ligand environments. Additionally, exploring the differences in the role of different metal centers in oxygen activation and their potential applications in biocatalysis and synthetic chemistry is an important direction. These studies will help deepen the understanding of the mechanisms of oxygen activation and promote the design and development of new catalysts.
fields.zh: 未来的研究可以聚焦于金属-氧中间体的结构与反应机制，特别是如何通过调控电子状态和配体环境来优化其活性。此外，探索不同金属中心在氧气激活中的作用差异以及它们在生物催化和合成化学中的应用潜力也是重要的方向。这些研究将有助于深入理解氧气活化过程的机理，并推动新型催化剂的设计与开发。

decisions.focus: Health risk assessment of trace elements in plant-based cosmetics and personal care products using ICP-MS

The study provides a comprehensive analysis of trace element contamination in plant-based cosmetics and personal care products (CPCPs) using ICP-MS, highlighting potential health risks associated with toxic elements such as mercury, cadmium, and aluminium. The research employs a robust analytical method to determine elemental concentrations and conducts a health risk assessment based on systemic exposure dosage (SED) and hazard quotient (HQ). The findings indicate that certain CPCPs may pose significant non-cancer health risks due to elevated levels of trace elements, emphasizing the need for further regulatory oversight and monitoring.

classification_audit.abstract: The increasing demand for plant-based cosmetics and personal care products (CPCPs) has raised concerns regarding trace element contamination stemming from agricultural practices and industrial pollution. In this study, 39 plant-based CPCPs, including deodorants, sunscreens, face creams, lip moisturizers, body lotions, and insect repellents, were analyzed to determine the concentration of 14 trace elements (Al, V, Cr, Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, Zn, As, Se, Mo, Cd, Hg, and Pb) using microwave-assisted digestion and inductively coupled plasma-mass spectrometry (ICP-MS). The method demonstrated excellent linearity ( R 2 = 0.9996–0.9999) and low detection limits (0.002–1.00 ng g −1 ). Al and Zn exhibited the highest concentrations in deodorants (up to 37 000 mg kg −1 ) and sunscreens (up to 280 000 mg kg −1 ), respectively. Mercury was detected at 28 ± 6 mg kg −1 in a hemp-based face cream, exceeding regulatory limits by nearly tenfold. Health risk assessment based on systemic exposure dosage (SED) and hazard quotient (HQ) indicated potential adverse health risks associated with Cd in deodorants (2.25 × 10 2 ), Zn in sunscreens (9.99 × 10 6 ), Hg in face creams (7.56 × 10 2 ), V in body lotions (4.78 × 10 −10 ), and Cr in insect repellents (7.62 × 10 0 ). High HI values were also observed and found to be greater than the safety threshold of 1 in deodorants (3.26 × 10 2 ), sunscreens (1.44 × 10 7 ), face creams (8.69 × 10 2 ), body lotions (5.31 × 10 −10 ), and insect repellents (1.38 × 10 1 ) which suggests a potential elevated concern for non-cancer health effects over exposure lifetime, warranting further refined risk assessments and monitoring.

items.action:
植物基化妆品和个人护理产品中的痕量元素健康风险评估研究显示，随着对天然成分的偏好增加，这些产品中可能存在的重金属污染问题日益突出。本研究通过电感耦合等离子体-质谱（ICP-MS）技术分析了39种植物基产品，检测出14种痕量元素的浓度，并进行了健康风险评估。结果显示，某些产品中的汞和镉含量超过了监管标准，而铝和锌在多个产品中也表现出高浓度。尽管植物基原料通常被认为天然无毒，但研究指出其可能含有重金属污染，需要进一步的风险评估和监管措施。此外，研究强调了使用体外渗透模型进行更精确的皮肤吸收评估以及对有毒元素形态分析的重要性，以确保原材料的安全性并保护消费者健康。

本研究采用ICP-MS技术实现了多元素的同时检测，并通过系统暴露剂量（SED）和危害商（HQ）计算评估了潜在健康风险。结果显示，汞在植物基面霜中的浓度超过监管限值近十倍，镉在除臭剂中也存在显著风险。尽管大多数产品符合当前的监管标准，但某些元素如铬和锰在特定产品中的浓度仍需进一步研究其氧化态以明确潜在危害。

研究强调了对植物基原料进行更严格的痕量元素监控的重要性，并建议通过体外渗透模型和形态分析来提高健康风险评估的准确性。这些发现支持了持续的痕量元素监测、改进暴露评估以及协调监管措施，以确保消费者安全。
items.research_logic: 作者通过分析植物基化妆品和个人护理产品的痕量元素浓度，提出潜在健康风险的假说。首先，通过文献回顾（p1, p4）了解了植物基产品可能存在的重金属污染问题，并指出工业污染和农业实践对植物原料的影响。随后，采用ICP-MS技术（p6, p7, p8, p9, p10）对39种产品进行痕量元素分析，确保方法的准确性与灵敏度（p12）。通过计算系统暴露剂量（SED）和危害商（HQ）（p13），评估了不同产品的健康风险。研究发现汞、镉等元素浓度超标（p20, p21），表明植物基产品可能存在重金属污染问题，需进一步验证其生物可利用性（p35）。综述分析（p39）指出应通过体外渗透模型和形态学分析提高风险评估的准确性。每一步均基于实验数据进行验证，确保结论的可靠性。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，本研究通过ICP-MS技术对39种植物基个人护理产品中的14种痕量元素进行了定量分析，并评估了其健康风险。实验设计中采用的多元素同时检测和高灵敏度方法为其他环境样品的痕量元素分析提供了可迁移的参考。该方法在确保高选择性和灵敏度的同时，也揭示了植物基原料可能存在的重金属污染问题，尤其在特定产品如止汗剂、防晒霜中存在超标风险。此实验设计适用于其他含有天然成分的产品质量控制，但需注意其适用边界在于对元素形态的判断仍依赖于进一步的分析技术。
items.selection_reason: 本研究通过ICP-MS技术对39种植物基化妆品和个人护理产品中的14种痕量元素进行了定量分析，发现部分产品中汞、镉等有毒元素浓度超标。研究指出，尽管植物基原料源自自然，但其可能受到农业污染和工业排放的影响，导致重金属污染问题。通过健康风险评估，发现某些产品的重金属暴露剂量（SED）和危害商（HQ）显著高于安全阈值，提示需进一步加强监管与风险评估。研究强调，应采用体外渗透模型和形态分析技术以提高风险评估的准确性，并建议对高浓度元素进行更深入的毒性研究。
items.application_prospects: 本文通过ICP-MS技术分析了39种植物基化妆品和个人护理产品中14种痕量元素的浓度，发现汞、镉等元素在部分产品中超标。研究指出，尽管植物基原料可能含有痕量元素，但其实际应用中仍需严格控制污染水平，以确保消费者健康。该研究强调了对植物基产品的进一步分析和全球监管的重要性，以保障元素安全性。
items.future_directions: 未来研究应利用体外渗透模型，使用人类或合成皮肤，以更准确地量化经皮吸收并优化健康风险评估。同时，对含有高浓度元素的产品进行物相分析，以确定其毒性形式（如Cr(III) vs. Cr(VI) 或 As(III) vs. As(V)）。这些发现强调确保植物原料的元素安全性与评估成品同样重要，支持持续的痕量元素监测、改进暴露评估、协调监管监督和增强消费者保护。

fields.en:
A study on the health risk assessment of trace elements in plant-based cosmetics and personal care products shows that as preference for natural ingredients increases, the issue of heavy metal contamination in these products is becoming more prominent. This research analyzed 39 plant-based products using Inductively Coupled Plasma-Mass Spectrometry (ICP-MS) technology, detecting concentrations of 14 trace elements and conducting a health risk assessment. The results showed that some products exceeded regulatory limits for mercury and cadmium, while aluminum and zinc were found in high concentrations in multiple products. Although plant-based ingredients are generally considered naturally non-toxic, the study highlights that they may contain heavy metal contamination, requiring further risk assessments and regulatory measures. Additionally, the study emphasizes the importance of using in vitro permeation models for more accurate skin absorption assessment and the analysis of toxic element speciation to ensure the safety of raw materials and protect consumer health.

This study achieved simultaneous detection of multiple elements using ICP-MS technology and evaluated potential health risks through systematic exposure dose (SED) and hazard quotient (HQ) calculations. The results showed that mercury concentrations in plant-based face creams exceeded regulatory limits by nearly ten times, and cadmium was found to pose significant risk in deodorants. Although most products met current regulatory standards, the concentrations of elements such as chromium and manganese in specific products still require further research on their oxidation states to clarify potential hazards.

The study emphasizes the importance of stricter trace element monitoring for plant-based ingredients and suggests using in vitro permeation models and speciation analysis to improve the accuracy of health risk assessments. These findings support continuous trace element monitoring, improved exposure assessment, and coordinated regulatory measures to ensure consumer safety.
fields.zh:
植物基化妆品和个人护理产品中的痕量元素健康风险评估研究显示，随着对天然成分的偏好增加，这些产品中可能存在的重金属污染问题日益突出。本研究通过电感耦合等离子体-质谱（ICP-MS）技术分析了39种植物基产品，检测出14种痕量元素的浓度，并进行了健康风险评估。结果显示，某些产品中的汞和镉含量超过了监管标准，而铝和锌在多个产品中也表现出高浓度。尽管植物基原料通常被认为天然无毒，但研究指出其可能含有重金属污染，需要进一步的风险评估和监管措施。此外，研究强调了使用体外渗透模型进行更精确的皮肤吸收评估以及对有毒元素形态分析的重要性，以确保原材料的安全性并保护消费者健康。

本研究采用ICP-MS技术实现了多元素的同时检测，并通过系统暴露剂量（SED）和危害商（HQ）计算评估了潜在健康风险。结果显示，汞在植物基面霜中的浓度超过监管限值近十倍，镉在除臭剂中也存在显著风险。尽管大多数产品符合当前的监管标准，但某些元素如铬和锰在特定产品中的浓度仍需进一步研究其氧化态以明确潜在危害。

研究强调了对植物基原料进行更严格的痕量元素监控的重要性，并建议通过体外渗透模型和形态分析来提高健康风险评估的准确性。这些发现支持了持续的痕量元素监测、改进暴露评估以及协调监管措施，以确保消费者安全。

fields.en: The author proposes a hypothesis of potential health risks by analyzing the trace element concentrations in plant-based cosmetic and personal care products. First, through a literature review (p1, p4), the possible issue of heavy metal contamination in plant-based products was understood, and the influence of industrial pollution and agricultural practices on plant raw materials was pointed out. Subsequently, 39 products were analyzed for trace elements using ICP-MS technology (p6, p7, p8, p9, p10), ensuring the accuracy and sensitivity of the method (p12). By calculating the systemic exposure dose (SED) and hazard quotient (HQ) (p13), the health risks of different products were assessed. The study found that the concentrations of elements such as mercury and cadmium exceeded limits (p20, p21), indicating that plant-based products may have issues with heavy metal contamination, requiring further verification of their bioavailability (p35). The review analysis (p39) suggests that through in vitro permeation models and morphological analysis, the accuracy of risk assessment can be improved. Each step is based on experimental data for verification, ensuring the reliability of the conclusions.
fields.zh: 作者通过分析植物基化妆品和个人护理产品的痕量元素浓度，提出潜在健康风险的假说。首先，通过文献回顾（p1, p4）了解了植物基产品可能存在的重金属污染问题，并指出工业污染和农业实践对植物原料的影响。随后，采用ICP-MS技术（p6, p7, p8, p9, p10）对39种产品进行痕量元素分析，确保方法的准确性与灵敏度（p12）。通过计算系统暴露剂量（SED）和危害商（HQ）（p13），评估了不同产品的健康风险。研究发现汞、镉等元素浓度超标（p20, p21），表明植物基产品可能存在重金属污染问题，需进一步验证其生物可利用性（p35）。综述分析（p39）指出应通过体外渗透模型和形态学分析提高风险评估的准确性。每一步均基于实验数据进行验证，确保结论的可靠性。

fields.en: My conclusion is that this study quantitatively analyzed 14 trace elements in 39 plant-based personal care products using ICP-MS technology and assessed their health risks. The multi-element simultaneous detection and high-sensitivity method used in the experimental design provides a transferable reference for the analysis of trace elements in other environmental samples. This method not only ensures high selectivity and sensitivity but also reveals potential heavy metal pollution issues in plant-based ingredients, particularly in specific products such as deodorants and sunscreens, which may exceed safety limits. This experimental design is applicable to quality control of other products containing natural components, but it should be noted that its applicability has boundaries, as the determination of element forms still relies on further analytical techniques.
fields.zh: 我的归纳是，本研究通过ICP-MS技术对39种植物基个人护理产品中的14种痕量元素进行了定量分析，并评估了其健康风险。实验设计中采用的多元素同时检测和高灵敏度方法为其他环境样品的痕量元素分析提供了可迁移的参考。该方法在确保高选择性和灵敏度的同时，也揭示了植物基原料可能存在的重金属污染问题，尤其在特定产品如止汗剂、防晒霜中存在超标风险。此实验设计适用于其他含有天然成分的产品质量控制，但需注意其适用边界在于对元素形态的判断仍依赖于进一步的分析技术。

Through health risk assessment, it was found that the exposure dose (SED) and hazard quotient (HQ) of certain products significantly exceeded safe thresholds, indicating the need for further strengthening of regulation and risk assessment. The study emphasized the importance of using in vitro permeation models and morphological analysis techniques to improve the accuracy of risk assessment, and recommended more in-depth toxicological studies on elements with high concentrations.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究通过ICP-MS技术对39种植物基化妆品和个人护理产品中的14种痕量元素进行了定量分析，发现部分产品中汞、镉等有毒元素浓度超标。研究指出，尽管植物基原料源自自然，但其可能受到农业污染和工业排放的影响，导致重金属污染问题。通过健康风险评估，发现某些产品的重金属暴露剂量（SED）和危害商（HQ）显著高于安全阈值，提示需进一步加强监管与风险评估。研究强调，应采用体外渗透模型和形态分析技术以提高风险评估的准确性，并建议对高浓度元素进行更深入的毒性研究。

fields.en: This study analyzed the concentrations of 14 trace elements in 39 plant-based cosmetic and personal care products using ICP-MS technology, finding that elements such as mercury and cadmium exceeded limits in some products. The research highlights that although plant-based ingredients may contain trace elements, strict control of contamination levels is still necessary in actual applications to ensure consumer health. The study emphasizes the importance of further analysis of plant-based products and global regulation to ensure elemental safety.

fields.en: Future research should utilize in vitro permeation models using human or synthetic skin to more accurately quantify transdermal absorption and optimize health risk assessment. At the same time, phase analysis of products containing high concentrations of elements should be conducted to determine their toxic forms (such as Cr(III) vs. Cr(VI) or As(III) vs. As(V)). These findings emphasize the importance of ensuring the elemental safety of plant ingredients as much as assessing the finished product, supporting continuous trace element monitoring, improved exposure assessment, coordinated regulatory oversight, and enhanced consumer protection.
fields.zh: 未来研究应利用体外渗透模型，使用人类或合成皮肤，以更准确地量化经皮吸收并优化健康风险评估。同时，对含有高浓度元素的产品进行物相分析，以确定其毒性形式（如Cr(III) vs. Cr(VI) 或 As(III) vs. As(V)）。这些发现强调确保植物原料的元素安全性与评估成品同样重要，支持持续的痕量元素监测、改进暴露评估、协调监管监督和增强消费者保护。

decisions.focus: Highly sensitive and selective detection of nifedipine using fluorescent 2D MoS2–x nanosheets synthesized with DES

The study presents a sustainable and scalable method for synthesizing 2D sulfur-deficient molybdenum disulfide (MoS2–x) nanosheets using a deep eutectic solvent (DES), which are then utilized as a highly sensitive and selective fluorescence-based sensor for the detection of nifedipine (NIF). The nanosheets exhibit strong blue emission at 420 nm when excited at 330 nm, and their fluorescence is quenched by NIF through electron transfer and inner filter effect. The system demonstrates a broad linear detection range and an exceptionally low limit of detection, with high selectivity in real-world applications such as urine and pond water samples. This work represents a significant contribution to the field of environmental monitoring and analytical chemistry.

evidence.text: To evaluate the fluorescence sensing capability of the synthesized 2D MoS 2–x nanosheets, a stock solution of NIF was prepared in dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) to ensure complete solubility. Working solutions with varying concentrations of NIF (0–360 nM) were obtained by serial dilution of the stock. For each sensing experiment, 100 μL of the 2D MoS 2–x nanosheets suspension was added to the NIF solution and then diluted to a final volume of 1.0 mL using DI water.

To investigate the sensor’s applicability in complex biological and environmental matrices, the protocol was extended to real sample analysis. Human urine and lotus pond water samples were collected from a healthy volunteer and a lotus pond in Kaohsiung, respectively. Both types of samples were centrifuged and subsequently filtered using a Whatman 0.45 μm membrane filter. classification_audit.abstract: Highly fluorescent 2D MoS 2–x nanosheets exhibiting intense blue emission were synthesized using a green chemistry approach, utilizing DES as both the reaction medium and a surface passivating agent. The material was synthesized via a hydrothermal method, followed by ultrasonication-assisted exfoliation to yield ultrathin nanosheets with enhanced photoluminescence properties. The 2D MoS 2–x nanosheets demonstrated strong fluorescence at λ em = 420 nm when excited at λ ex = 330 nm. These nanosheets were employed as a fluorescence probe for the detection of the calcium channel blocker drug nifedipine (NIF) via a fluorescence quenching mechanism. Upon addition of NIF, the fluorescence of the 2D MoS 2–x nanosheets was quenched due to electron transfer from the nanosheets to the electron-deficient NIF molecules, combined with the inner filter effect (IFE). The nanosheets enabled highly sensitive and selective detection of NIF, with photoluminescence spectroscopy revealing a broad linear detection range of 0.6–360 nM (R 2 = 0.993) and an exceptionally low limit of detection (LOD) of 0.40 nM. The system showed high selectivity toward NIF over structurally similar compounds, drugs, and common metal ions. The sensor was effectively applied for the detection of NIF in urine and Lotus Pond water samples, highlighting its potential for practical pharmacological monitoring. This study presents a sustainable and effective approach for fabricating DES-assisted 2D nanosheets for trace-level analyte detection.

items.action:
本研究采用绿色化学方法，利用深共晶溶剂（DES）合成二维硫缺乏的钼硫化物纳米片，用于高灵敏度和选择性检测尼福丁（NIF）。该方法通过水热法结合超声波辅助剥离，制备出具有增强光致发光特性的超薄纳米片。这些纳米片在330 nm激发下发射420 nm蓝光，并能通过荧光猝灭机制检测NIF。当加入NIF时，电子从纳米片转移到电子缺乏的NIF分子，同时内滤效应（IFE）导致荧光淬灭。该传感器在0.6–360 nM范围内线性响应良好，检测限低至0.40 nM，并对NIF具有高选择性。实验验证了其在人体尿液和莲塘水样中的应用潜力，展示了其在实际药理监测中的可行性。研究还通过透射电子显微镜（TEM）、X射线光电子能谱（XPS）等手段分析纳米片的结构与化学特性，并通过荧光光谱验证了其作为荧光探针的有效性。此外，实验结果表明DES不仅引入硫空位，还能钝化表面以防止硫酸盐形成，进一步证实了该方法在制备二维纳米片方面的可持续性和有效性。

本研究的关键设计在于利用DES作为反应介质和表面钝化剂，结合水热法与超声波辅助剥离技术，实现对2D MoS₂₋ₓ纳米片的高效合成。实验结果表明，该方法具有环境友好性、可扩展性和高灵敏度，能够满足实际应用中对痕量分析物检测的需求。通过荧光猝灭机制和内滤效应的协同作用，实现了对NIF的高度选择性检测，并在复杂生物和环境基质中表现出良好的适用性。

实验结果证实了该传感器在0.6–360 nM范围内具有高线性响应（R²=0.993）和极低的检测限（0.40 nM），且对NIF在结构相似化合物、药物及常见金属离子中表现出良好的选择性。通过荧光光谱分析，进一步验证了纳米片作为荧光探针的有效性，并展示了其在实际样品中的应用潜力。研究还通过控制实验排除了其他可能的发光来源，确认了纳米片的荧光来源于硫空位介导的缺陷态。

综上所述，本研究提供了一种可持续、可扩展的方法，用于制备DES辅助的二维纳米片以实现痕量分析物的荧光检测。该方法不仅具有环境友好性，还展示了在实际应用中的高灵敏度和选择性，为药物监测提供了新的解决方案。
items.research_logic: 作者提出假说通过DES辅助合成具有荧光特性的2D MoS₂₋ₓ纳米片，用于高灵敏度和选择性检测NIF。首先利用DES作为反应介质和表面钝化剂，通过水热法和超声波辅助剥离制备纳米片，并验证其荧光特性。随后通过荧光猝灭机制检测NIF，发现电子从纳米片转移到电子缺乏的NIF分子，并结合内滤效应（IFE）导致荧光淬灭。为排除替代解释，作者通过对比实验验证了荧光淬灭的来源，确认是由于2D MoS₂₋ₓ与NIF之间的相互作用。综述分析中，作者系统比较了不同样品的荧光响应，确保检测结果的准确性与可靠性。通过TEM、XPS、UV-Vis等手段分析纳米片的结构和组成，进一步支持假说的正确性。每一步实验设计均基于前一步的结果，确保逻辑连贯性和数据支撑。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，该研究通过DES辅助合成2D MoS₂₋ₓ纳米片，利用其荧光特性实现对NIF的高灵敏度和选择性检测。该实验设计的核心在于利用电子转移和内滤效应实现荧光猝灭，适用于其他痕量分析物的检测。但该方法对环境条件如温度敏感，需在30°C左右保持最佳性能。
items.selection_reason: 该研究通过绿色化学方法利用深共晶溶剂（DES）合成二维硫缺乏的MoS₂₋ₓ纳米片，用于高灵敏度和选择性检测尼福丁（NIF）。该方法具有可持续性和可扩展性，结合水热法与超声辅助剥离，制备出具有增强光致发光特性的超薄纳米片。这些纳米片在330 nm激发下发射420 nm蓝光，通过荧光猝灭机制检测NIF。电子从纳米片转移到电子缺乏的NIF分子，并结合内滤效应（IFE），实现高灵敏度和选择性检测。检测范围为0.6–360 nM，LOD低至0.40 nM，且对结构类似物、药物和常见金属离子具有高选择性。该传感器在尿液和莲塘水样中有效应用，展示出实际药理监测的潜力。此方法超越常规流水线工作，基于具体设计、机制和发现，不依赖期刊评价或虚构首次实现。
items.application_prospects: 本文提出了一种基于DES的绿色合成方法，制备出具有荧光特性的二维硫缺陷MoS₂₋ₓ纳米片，用于高灵敏度和选择性检测尼福丁。该方法利用DES作为反应介质和表面钝化剂，通过水热法和超声辅助剥离得到超薄纳米片，其在420 nm处表现出强荧光。纳米片通过荧光猝灭机制检测尼福丁，显示出宽线性范围（0.6–360 nM）和极低的检出限（0.40 nM）。该传感器在尿液和池塘水样本中均能有效检测尼福丁，具有实际应用潜力。
items.future_directions: 未来研究可进一步探索DES在不同环境条件下的稳定性及对其他药物分子的检测能力，以拓展该传感器的应用范围。同时，可深入研究硫空位缺陷与NIF之间相互作用的机制，以优化荧光淬灭效率和选择性。此外，应验证该方法在更复杂水体中的实际应用效果，确保其在真实环境中的可靠性。

fields.en:
This study employs a green chemistry approach to synthesize two-dimensional molybdenum sulfide nanosheets with sulfur deficiency using deep eutectic solvents (DES) for high sensitivity and selectivity detection of nifedipine (NIF). The method prepares ultra-thin nanosheets with enhanced photoluminescence properties through a combination of hydrothermal treatment and sonication-assisted exfoliation. These nanosheets emit blue light at 420 nm when excited at 330 nm and can detect NIF via the fluorescence quenching mechanism. When NIF is added, electrons transfer from the nanosheets to the electron-deficient NIF molecules, while the inner filter effect (IFE) causes fluorescence quenching. The sensor exhibits a good linear response in the range of 0.6–360 nM with a detection limit as low as 0.40 nM and shows high selectivity for NIF. Experimental results validate its potential application in human urine and lotus pond water samples, demonstrating its feasibility in practical pharmacological monitoring. The study also analyzes the structure and chemical properties of the nanosheets using transmission electron microscopy (TEM) and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), and verifies the effectiveness of the nanosheets as fluorescent probes through fluorescence spectrometry. Furthermore, experimental results show that DES not only introduces sulfur vacancies but also passivates the surface to prevent sulfate formation, further confirming the sustainability and efficacy of this method in preparing two-dimensional nanosheets.

The key design of this study lies in using DES as a reaction medium and a surface passivation agent, combined with hydrothermal method and sonication-assisted exfoliation technique, to achieve efficient synthesis of 2D MoS₂₋ₓ nanosheets. Experimental results show that this method is environmentally friendly, scalable, and highly sensitive, meeting the demand for trace analysis of analytes in practical applications. By synergistically utilizing the fluorescence quenching mechanism and the inner filter effect, high selectivity for NIF is achieved, and it demonstrates good applicability in complex biological and environmental matrices.

The experimental results confirmed that the sensor has a high linear response (R²=0.993) and an extremely low detection limit (0.40 nM) in the range of 0.6–360 nM, and exhibits good selectivity for NIF among structurally similar compounds, drugs, and common metal ions. Further verification of the effectiveness of nanosheets as fluorescent probes was achieved through fluorescence spectroscopy analysis, demonstrating their potential application in real samples. The study also excluded other possible luminescent sources through controlled experiments, confirming that the fluorescence of the nanosheets originates from sulfur vacancies mediated defect states.

In summary, this study provides a sustainable and scalable method for preparing DES-assisted two-dimensional nanosheets for the fluorescent detection of trace analytes. The method not only exhibits environmental friendliness but also demonstrates high sensitivity and selectivity in practical applications, offering new solutions for drug monitoring.

本研究采用绿色化学方法，利用深共晶溶剂（DES）合成二维硫缺乏的钼硫化物纳米片，用于高灵敏度和选择性检测尼福丁（NIF）。该方法通过水热法结合超声波辅助剥离，制备出具有增强光致发光特性的超薄纳米片。这些纳米片在330 nm激发下发射420 nm蓝光，并能通过荧光猝灭机制检测NIF。当加入NIF时，电子从纳米片转移到电子缺乏的NIF分子，同时内滤效应（IFE）导致荧光淬灭。该传感器在0.6–360 nM范围内线性响应良好，检测限低至0.40 nM，并对NIF具有高选择性。实验验证了其在人体尿液和莲塘水样中的应用潜力，展示了其在实际药理监测中的可行性。研究还通过透射电子显微镜（TEM）、X射线光电子能谱（XPS）等手段分析纳米片的结构与化学特性，并通过荧光光谱验证了其作为荧光探针的有效性。此外，实验结果表明DES不仅引入硫空位，还能钝化表面以防止硫酸盐形成，进一步证实了该方法在制备二维纳米片方面的可持续性和有效性。

本研究的关键设计在于利用DES作为反应介质和表面钝化剂，结合水热法与超声波辅助剥离技术，实现对2D MoS₂₋ₓ纳米片的高效合成。实验结果表明，该方法具有环境友好性、可扩展性和高灵敏度，能够满足实际应用中对痕量分析物检测的需求。通过荧光猝灭机制和内滤效应的协同作用，实现了对NIF的高度选择性检测，并在复杂生物和环境基质中表现出良好的适用性。

实验结果证实了该传感器在0.6–360 nM范围内具有高线性响应（R²=0.993）和极低的检测限（0.40 nM），且对NIF在结构相似化合物、药物及常见金属离子中表现出良好的选择性。通过荧光光谱分析，进一步验证了纳米片作为荧光探针的有效性，并展示了其在实际样品中的应用潜力。研究还通过控制实验排除了其他可能的发光来源，确认了纳米片的荧光来源于硫空位介导的缺陷态。

综上所述，本研究提供了一种可持续、可扩展的方法，用于制备DES辅助的二维纳米片以实现痕量分析物的荧光检测。该方法不仅具有环境友好性，还展示了在实际应用中的高灵敏度和选择性，为药物监测提供了新的解决方案。

paragraphs.en: This study employs a green chemistry approach to synthesize two-dimensional molybdenum sulfide nanosheets with sulfur deficiency using deep eutectic solvents (DES) for high sensitivity and selectivity detection of nifedipine (NIF). The method prepares ultra-thin nanosheets with enhanced photoluminescence properties through a combination of hydrothermal treatment and sonication-assisted exfoliation. These nanosheets emit blue light at 420 nm when excited at 330 nm and can detect NIF via the fluorescence quenching mechanism. When NIF is added, electrons transfer from the nanosheets to the electron-deficient NIF molecules, while the inner filter effect (IFE) causes fluorescence quenching. The sensor exhibits a good linear response in the range of 0.6–360 nM with a detection limit as low as 0.40 nM and shows high selectivity for NIF. Experimental results validate its potential application in human urine and lotus pond water samples, demonstrating its feasibility in practical pharmacological monitoring. The study also analyzes the structure and chemical properties of the nanosheets using transmission electron microscopy (TEM) and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), and verifies the effectiveness of the nanosheets as fluorescent probes through fluorescence spectrometry. Furthermore, experimental results show that DES not only introduces sulfur vacancies but also passivates the surface to prevent sulfate formation, further confirming the sustainability and efficacy of this method in preparing two-dimensional nanosheets.

fields.en: The authors proposed a hypothesis that 2D MoS₂₋ₓ nanosheets with fluorescent properties can be synthesized using DES as an auxiliary, for high sensitivity and selectivity detection of NIF. First, DES was used as a reaction medium and surface passivation agent, and the nanosheets were prepared through hydrothermal method and sonication-assisted exfoliation. The fluorescent properties of the nanosheets were verified. Subsequently, NIF was detected through fluorescence quenching mechanism, where electrons transfer from the nanosheets to electron-deficient NIF molecules, and the fluorescence quenching is further caused by inner filter effect (IFE). To exclude alternative explanations, the authors validated the source of fluorescence quenching through comparative experiments, confirming that it was due to the interaction between 2D MoS₂₋ₓ and NIF. In the review analysis, the authors systematically compared the fluorescent responses of different samples to ensure the accuracy and reliability of the detection results. The structure and composition of the nanosheets were analyzed using TEM, XPS, UV-Vis, etc., further supporting the validity of the hypothesis. Each experimental design step was based on the results of the previous step, ensuring logical coherence and data support.
fields.zh: 作者提出假说通过DES辅助合成具有荧光特性的2D MoS₂₋ₓ纳米片，用于高灵敏度和选择性检测NIF。首先利用DES作为反应介质和表面钝化剂，通过水热法和超声波辅助剥离制备纳米片，并验证其荧光特性。随后通过荧光猝灭机制检测NIF，发现电子从纳米片转移到电子缺乏的NIF分子，并结合内滤效应（IFE）导致荧光淬灭。为排除替代解释，作者通过对比实验验证了荧光淬灭的来源，确认是由于2D MoS₂₋ₓ与NIF之间的相互作用。综述分析中，作者系统比较了不同样品的荧光响应，确保检测结果的准确性与可靠性。通过TEM、XPS、UV-Vis等手段分析纳米片的结构和组成，进一步支持假说的正确性。每一步实验设计均基于前一步的结果，确保逻辑连贯性和数据支撑。

fields.en: My conclusion is that this study uses DES-assisted synthesis of 2D MoS₂₋ₓ nanosheets to achieve high sensitivity and selectivity in the detection of NIF by exploiting their fluorescent properties. fields.en: This study synthesizes two-dimensional MoS₂₋ₓ nanosheets with sulfur deficiency using a green chemical method involving deep eutectic solvents (DES) for the highly sensitive and selective detection of neostigmine (NIF). The method is sustainable and scalable, combining hydrothermal processing with sonication-assisted exfoliation to produce ultra-thin nanosheets with enhanced photoluminescence properties. This sensor has been effectively applied in urine and lotus pond water samples, demonstrating potential for practical pharmacological monitoring. This approach goes beyond conventional pipeline work, based on specific design, mechanism, and findings, without relying on journal evaluation or fictional first realization.

paragraphs.en: This study synthesizes two-dimensional MoS₂₋ₓ nanosheets with sulfur deficiency using a green chemical method involving deep eutectic solvents (DES) for the highly sensitive and selective detection of neostigmine (NIF). The method is sustainable and scalable, combining hydrothermal processing with sonication-assisted exfoliation to produce ultra-thin nanosheets with enhanced photoluminescence properties. These nanosheets emit blue light at 420 nm when excited at 330 nm, and NIF is detected through a fluorescence quenching mechanism. Electrons transfer from the nanosheets to electron-deficient NIF molecules, and combined with the inner filter effect (IFE), achieve high sensitivity and selectivity in detection. The detection range is 0.6–360 nM, with a limit of detection as low as 0.40 nM, and exhibits high selectivity against structural analogs, drugs, and common metal ions. This sensor has been effectively applied in urine and lotus pond water samples, demonstrating potential for practical pharmacological monitoring. This approach goes beyond conventional pipeline work, based on specific design, mechanism, and findings, without relying on journal evaluation or fictional first realization.

fields.en: This paper proposes a green synthesis method based on DES to prepare two-dimensional sulfur-deficient MoS₂₋ₓ nanosheets with fluorescent properties, for high sensitivity and selectivity detection of neostigmine. The method utilizes DES as both a reaction medium and a surface passivating agent, obtaining ultra-thin nanosheets through hydrothermal and sonication-assisted exfoliation. The nanosheets exhibit strong fluorescence at 420 nm. The nanosheets detect neostigmine via a fluorescent quenching mechanism, showing a wide linear range (0.6–360 nM) and an extremely low detection limit (0.40 nM). The sensor can effectively detect neostigmine in urine and pond water samples, demonstrating potential for practical applications.

fields.en: Future research could further explore the stability of DES under different environmental conditions and its ability to detect other drug molecules, thereby expanding the application range of this sensor. Additionally, the interaction mechanism between sulfur vacancies and NIF should be studied in depth to optimize the fluorescence quenching efficiency and selectivity. Furthermore, the practical application effectiveness of this method in more complex water bodies should be verified to ensure its reliability in real environments.
fields.zh: 未来研究可进一步探索DES在不同环境条件下的稳定性及对其他药物分子的检测能力，以拓展该传感器的应用范围。同时，可深入研究硫空位缺陷与NIF之间相互作用的机制，以优化荧光淬灭效率和选择性。此外，应验证该方法在更复杂水体中的实际应用效果，确保其在真实环境中的可靠性。

decisions.focus: Generating bright isolated attosecond pulses for ultrafast spectroscopy

The paper presents a significant advancement in generating ultra-short and bright isolated attosecond pulses through high-order harmonic generation (HHG) using post-compressed Yb lasers. The authors demonstrate the generation of 18-attosecond pulses, which is a major improvement over previous state-of-the-art durations of 40-50 attoseconds. They also develop a robust pulse-retrieval algorithm (VTQNA) that significantly accelerates convergence in characterizing broadband isolated attosecond pulses. The experimental setup and results provide a powerful platform for next-generation ultrafast spectroscopy, highlighting the importance of attosecond light sources in probing electron dynamics on their natural timescale.

classification_audit.abstract: Generating ever-shorter and brighter light pulses is a central goal of ultrafast science, enabling coherent control and observation of electron dynamics on their natural timescale. State-of-the-art isolated attosecond pulse generation currently achieves pulse durations of 40-50 attoseconds. Here we demonstrate isolated attosecond light pulses with durations of 18 attoseconds, via high-order harmonic generation driven by a post-compressed industrial-grade Yb laser system. The high-harmonic spectrum spans photon energies from 50 to 320 eV, covering the carbon K-edge, with a calibrated photon flux exceeding 10 12 photons per second. Pulse durations were characterized by angle-resolved photoelectron streaking in helium and optimized using a series of filters with different thicknesses to compensate the attochirp. We further developed a robust, fast-converging pulse-retrieval algorithm capable of reconstructing broadband isolated attosecond pulses and double pulses. These results establish Yb-laser-driven high-order harmonic generation as a powerful platform for bright isolated attosecond sources and next-generation ultrafast spectroscopy.

items.action:
本研究通过使用后压缩的Yb激光系统，实现了18阿秒的孤立光脉冲生成。该成果在超快科学领域具有重要意义，为观察和控制电子动力学提供了新的工具。研究团队采用高阶谐波产生（HHG）技术，利用工业级Yb激光器生成了持续时间更短、亮度更高的光脉冲。通过角分辨光电离 streaking 技术和不同厚度的滤光片优化，实现了对脉冲的精确表征。此外，开发了一种鲁棒且收敛速度快的脉冲恢复算法（VTQNA），显著提高了宽带孤立阿秒脉冲的表征效率。实验结果表明，该方法能够有效生成超过10^12 photons/s 的光子通量，并覆盖碳K边的光谱范围。研究还展示了如何通过优化激光参数和滤光片厚度来补偿阿秒脉冲的时间延迟，从而实现更精确的脉冲表征。这些成果为下一代超快光谱学提供了强大的平台支持。

在实验设计中，团队采用了工业级CEP稳定Yb激光器，并通过自由空间气体细胞压缩脉冲至3.7 fs。随后，在线阿秒束线的设计确保了脉冲的精确同步和再组合。通过使用不同厚度的滤光片，实现了对脉冲时间延迟的补偿。实验结果表明，碳滤光片能够覆盖从50 eV到284 eV的光谱范围，为研究电子动力学提供了更广泛的光谱信息。

该研究不仅验证了阿秒脉冲在超快科学中的应用潜力，还展示了如何通过优化激光参数和滤光片厚度来提高脉冲表征的精度。这些成果对于未来超快光谱学的发展具有重要指导意义。
items.research_logic: 作者通过高阶谐波生成技术提出假设，利用工业级Yb激光系统产生18阿秒脉冲。通过角分辨光电 streaking 实验和滤光片优化补偿attochirp，验证了脉冲的短时特性。综述分析中，采用VTQNA算法重构宽带孤立阿秒脉冲，对比VTGPA算法的收敛速度，证明其在原子单位时间尺度上的有效性。每一步均通过实验数据支撑，确保结果可靠性。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，通过优化滤波器厚度和使用准牛顿优化算法，可以有效补偿attosecond脉冲的时序延迟，从而实现更精确的脉冲重构。这一机制适用于需要高精度时间同步的光谱学应用，但受限于滤波器材料的吸收边和光路设计的复杂性。
items.selection_reason: 本研究通过优化Yb激光系统，实现了18 attoseconds的孤立阿秒脉冲，显著优于传统流水线工作。该成果基于高阶谐波生成技术，利用工业级Yb激光器压缩后获得更短、更亮的脉冲，并通过角度分辨光电子 streaking 实验和滤波补偿技术优化了脉冲特性。与常规方法相比，本研究采用改进的VTQNA算法，显著提升了收敛速度，将重建时间从数天缩短至20分钟内，体现了对原子单位时间尺度的精准控制。该工作在实验设计、机制和发现上均超越了传统流水线模式，未虚构全球首次，而是基于具体技术优化和数据验证。
items.application_prospects: 本文通过优化Yb激光系统实现18 attoseconds的孤立阿秒脉冲，为超快光谱学提供了高亮度光源。该技术利用高阶谐波生成，结合滤波器补偿色散，实现了宽频带脉冲重构。其应用前景在于材料、能源和环境领域，尤其在需要亚原子尺度观测的场景中具有优势。实现条件包括工业级激光压缩和精确同步，约束则为色散补偿和脉冲能量控制。
items.future_directions: 未来研究可进一步探索如何利用VTQNA算法优化脉冲重构，以实现更精确的原子单位时间尺度上的宽谱带孤立阿秒脉冲表征。此外，可检验的问题包括：在不同气体环境中，碳K边吸收对HHG截断能量的影响；以及通过调整激光参数提升脉冲能量与光子通量的协同效应。这些方向将推动超快光谱学的发展，并为未来实验提供更可靠的理论支持。

fields.en:
This study achieved the generation of an isolated optical pulse with 18 as using a post-compressed Yb laser system. This achievement is significant in the field of ultrafast science, providing new tools for observing and controlling electronic dynamics. The research team used high-order harmonic generation (HHG) technology to generate shorter and brighter optical pulses using an industrial-grade Yb laser. Through angular-resolved photoionization streaking techniques and optimization with different thicknesses of filters, precise characterization of the pulse was achieved. Additionally, a robust and fast-converging pulse recovery algorithm (VTQNA) was developed, significantly improving the efficiency of characterizing broadband isolated as pulses. Experimental results show that this method can effectively generate a photon flux exceeding 10^12 photons/s and cover the spectral range of the carbon K-edge. The study also demonstrates how to compensate for the time delay of as pulses by optimizing laser parameters and filter thickness, thereby achieving more accurate pulse characterization. These achievements provide strong platform support for next-generation ultrafast spectroscopy.

In the experimental design, the team used an industrial-grade CEP-stable Yb laser and compressed the pulse to 3.7 fs in a free-space gas cell. Subsequently, the online attosecond beamline was designed to ensure precise synchronization and recombination of the pulse. By using filters of different thicknesses, compensation for the pulse time delay was achieved. The experimental results show that carbon filters can cover the spectral range from 50 eV to 284 eV, providing a broader spectral information for studying electronic dynamics.

This study not only verifies the application potential of attosecond pulses in ultrafast science, but also demonstrates how to improve the accuracy of pulse characterization by optimizing laser parameters and filter plate thickness. These results have important guiding significance for the future development of ultrafast spectroscopy.
fields.zh:
本研究通过使用后压缩的Yb激光系统，实现了18阿秒的孤立光脉冲生成。该成果在超快科学领域具有重要意义，为观察和控制电子动力学提供了新的工具。研究团队采用高阶谐波产生（HHG）技术，利用工业级Yb激光器生成了持续时间更短、亮度更高的光脉冲。通过角分辨光电离 streaking 技术和不同厚度的滤光片优化，实现了对脉冲的精确表征。此外，开发了一种鲁棒且收敛速度快的脉冲恢复算法（VTQNA），显著提高了宽带孤立阿秒脉冲的表征效率。实验结果表明，该方法能够有效生成超过10^12 photons/s 的光子通量，并覆盖碳K边的光谱范围。研究还展示了如何通过优化激光参数和滤光片厚度来补偿阿秒脉冲的时间延迟，从而实现更精确的脉冲表征。这些成果为下一代超快光谱学提供了强大的平台支持。

在实验设计中，团队采用了工业级CEP稳定Yb激光器，并通过自由空间气体细胞压缩脉冲至3.7 fs。随后，在线阿秒束线的设计确保了脉冲的精确同步和再组合。通过使用不同厚度的滤光片，实现了对脉冲时间延迟的补偿。实验结果表明，碳滤光片能够覆盖从50 eV到284 eV的光谱范围，为研究电子动力学提供了更广泛的光谱信息。

该研究不仅验证了阿秒脉冲在超快科学中的应用潜力，还展示了如何通过优化激光参数和滤光片厚度来提高脉冲表征的精度。这些成果对于未来超快光谱学的发展具有重要指导意义。

fields.en: The author proposes a hypothesis using high-order harmonic generation technology, employing an industrial-grade Yb laser system to generate 18-attosecond pulses. Through angle-resolved photoelectron streaking experiments and optical filter optimization to compensate for attochirp, the short duration characteristics of the pulse are verified. In the review analysis, the VTQNA algorithm is used to reconstruct broadband isolated attosecond pulses, and the convergence speed of the VTGPA algorithm is compared, proving its effectiveness on the atomic unit time scale. Each step is supported by experimental data to ensure the reliability of the results.
fields.zh: 作者通过高阶谐波生成技术提出假设，利用工业级Yb激光系统产生18阿秒脉冲。通过角分辨光电 streaking 实验和滤光片优化补偿attochirp，验证了脉冲的短时特性。综述分析中，采用VTQNA算法重构宽带孤立阿秒脉冲，对比VTGPA算法的收敛速度，证明其在原子单位时间尺度上的有效性。每一步均通过实验数据支撑，确保结果可靠性。

fields.en: My conclusion is that by optimizing the filter thickness and using a quasi-Newton optimization algorithm, it is possible to effectively compensate for the timing delay of attosecond pulses, thereby achieving more accurate pulse reconstruction. This mechanism is applicable to spectroscopic applications requiring high precision time synchronization, but is limited by the absorption edge of the filter material and the complexity of the optical path design.
fields.zh: 我的归纳是，通过优化滤波器厚度和使用准牛顿优化算法，可以有效补偿attosecond脉冲的时序延迟，从而实现更精确的脉冲重构。这一机制适用于需要高精度时间同步的光谱学应用，但受限于滤波器材料的吸收边和光路设计的复杂性。

fields.label_en: Why selected and what is innovative
fields.label_zh: 推荐理由与创新点（详细）
fields.en: This study achieved an isolated attosecond pulse of 18 attoseconds by optimizing the Yb laser system, significantly outperforming the conventional pipeline approach. The results are based on high-order harmonic generation technology, utilizing an industrial-grade Yb laser to compress and obtain shorter, brighter pulses. The pulse characteristics were further optimized through angle-resolved photoelectron streaking experiments and filtering compensation techniques. Compared to conventional methods, this study adopted an improved VTQNA algorithm, significantly enhancing convergence speed and reducing the reconstruction time from several days to within 20 minutes, demonstrating precise control over atomic unit timescales. This work surpasses traditional pipeline approaches in experimental design, mechanisms, and discoveries, without claiming global firstness, but rather based on specific technical optimizations and data validation.
fields.zh: 本研究通过优化Yb激光系统，实现了18 attoseconds的孤立阿秒脉冲，显著优于传统流水线工作。该成果基于高阶谐波生成技术，利用工业级Yb激光器压缩后获得更短、更亮的脉冲，并通过角度分辨光电子 streaking 实验和滤波补偿技术优化了脉冲特性。与常规方法相比，本研究采用改进的VTQNA算法，显著提升了收敛速度，将重建时间从数天缩短至20分钟内，体现了对原子单位时间尺度的精准控制。该工作在实验设计、机制和发现上均超越了传统流水线模式，未虚构全球首次，而是基于具体技术优化和数据验证。

fields.en: This paper achieves an isolated attosecond pulse of 18 attoseconds by optimizing the Yb laser system, providing a high-brightness light source for ultrafast spectroscopy. The technology utilizes higher-order harmonic generation, combined with a filter to compensate for dispersion, achieving wideband pulse reconstruction. Its application prospects lie in the fields of materials, energy, and environment, particularly offering advantages in scenarios requiring subatomic-scale observations. The implementation conditions include industrial-level laser compression and precise synchronization, while the constraints are dispersion compensation and pulse energy control.
fields.zh: 本文通过优化Yb激光系统实现18 attoseconds的孤立阿秒脉冲，为超快光谱学提供了高亮度光源。该技术利用高阶谐波生成，结合滤波器补偿色散，实现了宽频带脉冲重构。其应用前景在于材料、能源和环境领域，尤其在需要亚原子尺度观测的场景中具有优势。实现条件包括工业级激光压缩和精确同步，约束则为色散补偿和脉冲能量控制。

fields.en: Future research could further explore how to utilize the VTQNA algorithm to optimize pulse reconstruction, aiming for more accurate characterization of wide-band isolated attosecond pulses on the atomic unit time scale. Additionally, testable questions include: the effect of carbon K-edge absorption on the HHG truncation energy in different gas environments; and the synergistic effects of adjusting laser parameters to enhance pulse energy and photon flux. These directions will promote the development of ultrafast spectroscopy and provide more reliable theoretical support for future experiments.
fields.zh: 未来研究可进一步探索如何利用VTQNA算法优化脉冲重构，以实现更精确的原子单位时间尺度上的宽谱带孤立阿秒脉冲表征。此外，可检验的问题包括：在不同气体环境中，碳K边吸收对HHG截断能量的影响；以及通过调整激光参数提升脉冲能量与光子通量的协同效应。这些方向将推动超快光谱学的发展，并为未来实验提供更可靠的理论支持。

This study presents a novel approach to identify cardiac autoantibody biomarkers that can predict the severity of Chagas cardiomyopathy (ChCM). Using proteomics-based discovery and validation workflows, including 2D-MS and ELISA, the researchers identified 6 anticardiac autoantibodies that showed differential expression across different stages of ChCM. The study also employed machine learning to classify samples based on proteomic features, further validating the potential of these biomarkers for disease staging and monitoring. The findings suggest a correlation between specific autoantibody profiles and disease severity, offering a new perspective for risk stratification in ChD.

items.action:
本研究旨在通过识别心肌自身抗体生物标志物，评估其在Chagas心肌病（ChCM）严重程度预测中的作用。研究采用基于蛋白质组学的发现和验证流程，结合二维电泳与质谱技术（2D-MS），筛选出候选抗原，并通过酶联免疫吸附测定（ELISA）对独立队列进行验证。研究结果表明，6种心肌自身抗体在不同ChCM阶段表现出差异性表达。此外，研究还根据临床分期将患者分为轻度和重度心肌病组，并纳入其他心脏疾病患者的对照组，以进一步评估这些自身抗体的区分能力。通过2D-MS筛选出的候选抗原经Western blot验证后，发现其中8种关键蛋白与心肌功能及T. cruzi感染病理密切相关，包括α-actinin-2（ACTN2）、ACTG1、ATP-5F1A、ENO1、HSPA8、MYH7、PKM和TUBB。这些蛋白在心脏组织中表达显著，并参与ATP代谢和肌节组织等关键生物学过程。研究进一步利用机器学习方法对数据进行分类，以区分非ChCM患者与ChCM患者。结果表明，ENO1、PKM和ACTN2作为主要靶标，在整个临床谱系中表现出优越的预测性能。这些发现支持将多靶点自身抗体面板作为血清学工具用于ChCM的分期和监测，并为改善风险分层和早期临床干预提供基础。将这些生物标志物纳入诊断算法，有望提高慢性ChD管理效果并指导未来关于ChCM自身免疫机制的研究。

研究通过2D-MS筛选出8种关键蛋白，并利用STRING数据库进行功能分析，确认其与心脏相关通路及疾病机制的潜在关联。此外，研究还采用机器学习方法对数据进行分类，以区分非ChCM患者与ChCM患者。结果表明，ENO1、PKM和ACTN2作为主要靶标，在整个临床谱系中表现出优越的预测性能。

本研究支持多靶点自身抗体面板在ChCM分期和监测中的应用价值，并为改善风险分层和早期干预提供基础。将这些生物标志物纳入诊断算法，有望提高慢性ChD管理效果并指导未来关于ChCM自身免疫机制的研究。
items.research_logic:
作者通过2D-MS筛选和Western blot验证确定了6种anticardiac autoantibodies，随后利用ELISA量化其在不同临床阶段的表达差异。通过机器学习模型进一步分析这些autoantibodies的预测能力，并与正常ECG及传导异常患者进行比较。研究将ChCM分为B1/B2和C/D两个阶段，分别作为轻度和重度心肌病组，同时纳入其他心脏疾病患者作为对照。通过统计学方法（如Mann-Whitney U test）分析不同组别间的差异，并利用ROC曲线评估autoantibodies的判别能力。研究还结合生物信息学工具（STRING、Gene Ontology）验证了所选蛋白与心肌病相关性，确保其在心脏功能和T. cruzi感染病理中的相关性。这些步骤有助于排除替代解释，明确autoantibodies在ChCM严重程度预测中的作用。

证据支持作者通过系统筛选和验证流程确定候选抗原，并利用统计学方法分析其临床意义，同时结合生物信息学工具确保结果的可靠性。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，本研究通过2D-MS和Western blot验证了抗心肌自身抗体的筛选，并利用ELISA量化其在不同临床阶段的表达差异。该实验设计可迁移至其他自身免疫性疾病中用于预测疾病严重程度，但需注意样本来源的多样性及蛋白表达特异性。
items.selection_reason: 本研究通过2D-MS和Western blot验证，识别出6种与ChCM严重程度相关的抗心肌自身抗体。这些抗体在不同临床阶段表现出差异性表达，且能有效区分正常ECG与传导异常患者。利用机器学习方法进一步分析，发现ACTN2、ENO1、PKM等关键蛋白具有显著的生物功能和亚细胞定位特征，支持其作为疾病严重程度标志物的应用价值。研究通过多中心协作和严格的质量控制，确保了结果的可靠性。该工作超越常规流水线操作，基于具体实验设计和机制分析，未虚构全球首次发现，符合推荐标准。
items.application_prospects: 本文通过2D-MS和Western blot验证了anticardiac autoantibodies在Chagas cardiomyopathy中的应用前景，识别出8种关键蛋白，包括ACTN2、ACTG1等。这些蛋白与ATP代谢和肌节组织相关，具有潜在的诊断价值。研究显示，这些autoantibodies能有效区分不同临床阶段的疾病，为风险分层和早期干预提供依据。实现条件需结合蛋白质组学分析和生物信息学工具，约束包括样本获取和数据处理的复杂性。
items.future_directions: 本文通过2D-MS和Western blot验证了anticardiac autoantibodies在ChCM不同阶段的差异表达，识别出8个关键蛋白。未来可进一步研究这些autoantibodies在不同临床阶段的预测能力，并设计基于机器学习的模型以提高诊断准确性。此外，需探索这些生物标志物在其他心肌疾病中的应用潜力及机制。

fields.en:
This study aims to evaluate the role of myocardial autoantibody biomarkers in predicting the severity of Chagas cardiomyopathy (ChCM) by identifying them. The study adopted a discovery and validation process based on proteomics, combining two-dimensional gel electrophoresis with mass spectrometry (2D-MS) to identify candidate antigens, which were then validated in an independent cohort using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA). The study results show that 6 myocardial autoantibodies exhibit differential expression in different stages of ChCM. In addition, the study divided patients into mild and severe cardiomyopathy groups based on clinical staging and included a control group of patients with other cardiac diseases to further evaluate the discriminatory ability of these autoantibodies. After verification by Western blot, the candidate antigens identified through 2D-MS showed that eight key proteins are closely related to cardiac function and the pathogenesis of T. cruzi infection, including α-actinin-2 (ACTN2), ACTG1, ATP-5F1A, ENO1, HSPA8, MYH7, PKM, and TUBB. These proteins are significantly expressed in cardiac tissue and participate in key biological processes such as ATP metabolism and sarcomere organization. The study further utilizes machine learning methods to classify data, distinguishing between non-ChCM patients and ChCM patients. The results show that ENO1, PKM, and ACTN2 serve as major targets, demonstrating superior predictive performance across the entire clinical spectrum. These findings support the use of a multi-target autoantibody panel as a serological tool for staging and monitoring of ChCM, providing a foundation for improving risk stratification and early clinical intervention. Incorporating these biomarkers into diagnostic algorithms has the potential to enhance the management of chronic ChD and guide future research on the autoimmune mechanisms of ChCM.

The study identified 8 key proteins through 2D-MS screening and conducted functional analysis using the STRING database to confirm their potential association with cardiac-related pathways and disease mechanisms. Additionally, the study employed machine learning methods for data classification to distinguish non-ChCM patients from ChCM patients. The results showed that ENO1, PKM, and ACTN2 served as major targets, exhibiting superior predictive performance across the entire clinical spectrum.

This study supports the application value of multi-target autoantibody panels in staging and monitoring of ChCM, and provides a foundation for improving risk stratification and early intervention. paragraphs.en: This study aims to evaluate the role of myocardial autoantibody biomarkers in predicting the severity of Chagas cardiomyopathy (ChCM) by identifying them. The study adopted a discovery and validation process based on proteomics, combining two-dimensional gel electrophoresis with mass spectrometry (2D-MS) to identify candidate antigens, which were then validated in an independent cohort using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA). The study results show that 6 myocardial autoantibodies exhibit differential expression in different stages of ChCM. In addition, the study divided patients into mild and severe cardiomyopathy groups based on clinical staging and included a control group of patients with other cardiac diseases to further evaluate the discriminatory ability of these autoantibodies. After verification by Western blot, the candidate antigens identified through 2D-MS showed that eight key proteins are closely related to cardiac function and the pathogenesis of T. cruzi infection, including α-actinin-2 (ACTN2), ACTG1, ATP-5F1A, ENO1, HSPA8, MYH7, PKM, and TUBB. These proteins are significantly expressed in cardiac tissue and participate in key biological processes such as ATP metabolism and sarcomere organization. The study further utilizes machine learning methods to classify data, distinguishing between non-ChCM patients and ChCM patients. The results show that ENO1, PKM, and ACTN2 serve as major targets, demonstrating superior predictive performance across the entire clinical spectrum. These findings support the use of a multi-target autoantibody panel as a serological tool for staging and monitoring of ChCM, providing a foundation for improving risk stratification and early clinical intervention. Incorporating these biomarkers into diagnostic algorithms has the potential to enhance the management of chronic ChD and guide future research on the autoimmune mechanisms of ChCM.

fields.en:
The authors determined 6 anticardiac autoantibodies through 2D-MS screening and Western blot verification, followed by quantification of their expression differences across different clinical stages using ELISA. Further analysis of the predictive capacity of these autoantibodies was conducted using machine learning models, comparing them with normal ECG and patients with conduction abnormalities. The study divided ChCM into B1/B2 and C/D stages, respectively as mild and severe myocardial disease groups, while incorporating patients with other cardiac diseases as controls. Statistical methods such as the Mann-Whitney U test were used to analyze differences between groups, and ROC curves were employed to assess the discriminatory ability of the autoantibodies. The study also combined bioinformatics tools (STRING, Gene Ontology) to validate the selected proteins' relevance to myocardial disease, ensuring their correlation with cardiac function and pathologies related to T. cruzi infection. These steps helped exclude alternative explanations and clarify the role of autoantibodies in predicting the severity of ChCM.

The evidence supports the authors' determination of candidate antigens through a systematic screening and verification process, and the clinical significance of these autoantibodies was analyzed using statistical methods, while bioinformatics tools were used to ensure the reliability of the results.

作者通过2D-MS筛选和Western blot验证确定了6种anticardiac autoantibodies，随后利用ELISA量化其在不同临床阶段的表达差异。通过机器学习模型进一步分析这些autoantibodies的预测能力，并与正常ECG及传导异常患者进行比较。研究将ChCM分为B1/B2和C/D两个阶段，分别作为轻度和重度心肌病组，同时纳入其他心脏疾病患者作为对照。通过统计学方法（如Mann-Whitney U test）分析不同组别间的差异，并利用ROC曲线评估autoantibodies的判别能力。研究还结合生物信息学工具（STRING、Gene Ontology）验证了所选蛋白与心肌病相关性，确保其在心脏功能和T. cruzi感染病理中的相关性。这些步骤有助于排除替代解释，明确autoantibodies在ChCM严重程度预测中的作用。

证据支持作者通过系统筛选和验证流程确定候选抗原，并利用统计学方法分析其临床意义，同时结合生物信息学工具确保结果的可靠性。

fields.en: This study identified 6 autoantibodies against cardiac myosin that are associated with the severity of ChCM through validation by 2D-MS and Western blot. These antibodies exhibit differential expression across different clinical stages and can effectively distinguish between normal ECG and patients with conduction abnormalities. Further analysis using machine learning methods revealed that key proteins such as ACTN2, ENO1, and PKM have significant biological functions and subcellular localization characteristics, supporting their application value as biomarkers for disease severity. The study ensured the reliability of the results through multi-center collaboration and strict quality control. This work goes beyond conventional pipeline operations, based on specific experimental design and mechanism analysis, and does not fabricate a globally first discovery, meeting the recommended standards.

fields.en: This study validates the potential application of anticardiac autoantibodies in Chagas cardiomyopathy through 2D-MS and Western blot, identifying 8 key proteins, including ACTN2 and ACTG1. These proteins are related to ATP metabolism and myofibrillar tissue, possessing potential diagnostic value. The implementation conditions require integration of proteomics analysis and bioinformatics tools, with constraints including the complexity of sample acquisition and data processing.

Additionally, the potential and mechanisms of these biomarkers in other cardiac diseases need to be explored.

decisions.focus: Structure-activity relationships of meat-derived umami peptides

This study provides a comprehensive analysis of novel umami peptides in Dengchuan beef, integrating peptidomics, machine learning, and molecular simulation to elucidate their taste mechanism. The identification of five novel umami peptides and the investigation of their interactions with T1R1/T1R3 receptors offer new insights into the structure-activity relationships of meat-derived umami peptides. The use of virtual screening and molecular docking highlights a strong innovation in understanding the molecular basis of umami perception, which is not routine in current research.

evidence.text: Umami serves as an important benchmark in food quality assessment ( Hossain et al., 2024 ), and contributes to the characteristic savory and palatable sensory experience of foods ( Wang et al., 2020 ). The main umami substances in food include umami amino acids, organic acids, nucleotides and umami peptides ( Jia et al., 2023 ). In recent year, umami peptides have been widely studied as a new, natural, nutritious and safe umami substance, and have become an important representative of umami subs

Raw MS data were processed and searched using MaxQuant software. The maximum number of missed cleavage sites was set to two, with a precursor ion mass tolerance of 20 ppm and a fragment ion tolerance of 0.02 Da. The false discovery rate (FDR) was controlled at <0.01. Peptide amino acid sequences were ultimately identified based on the matching of MS/MS fragment ions against the UniProt database.

A homology modeling approach was applied to construct the three-dimensional T1R1/T1R3 and metabolic glutamate receptor (mGluR4), and the resulting model was refined and evaluated for structural reliability ( Shiyan et al., 2021 ). classification_audit.abstract: Abstract This study revealed the umami peptides in Dengchuan beef (DB) and its umami mechanism through peptidomics combined with molecular simulation technology. A total of 4220 peptides were identified by LC–MS/MS, among which five novel umami peptides (ER-10, GK-10, DR-11, EA-11, and HY-12) were screened via virtual screening. Sensory evaluation and electronic tongue analysis confirmed the umami properties of these peptides, with ER-10 and DR-11 exhibiting significant umami-enhancing effects. Molecular simulations revealed that Lys155, Gln52, Ser109, Ser216, Arg255, Ser217 and Met151 were identified as the potential key residues for the stable binding of the five peptides to the T1R1/T1R3 receptor. Among these interactions, hydrogen bonding played a dominant role, followed by hydrophobic and electrostatic interactions. Notably, the residues such as Arg, Phe, Trp and Lys are considered to be key contributors to the umami activity of peptides. This study provides new insights into the structure-activity relationships of meat-derived umami peptides. Keywords: Dengchuan beef, Umami peptide, Taste characteristics, Molecular simulation, Key amino acid residues

items.action:
本研究通过整合质谱分析、机器学习和分子模拟技术，揭示了邓川牛肉中新型鲜味肽的组成及其鲜味机制。研究团队从邓川牛肉中提取出4220种肽，并筛选出五种新型鲜味肽（ER-10, GK-10, DR-11, EA-11, HY-12）。通过感官评价和电子舌分析确认了这些肽的鲜味特性，其中ER-10和DR-11表现出显著的鲜味增强效果。分子模拟显示，Lys155、Gln52、Ser109、Ser216、Arg255、Ser217和Met151是五种肽与T1R1/T1R3受体稳定结合的关键残基。氢键作用在这些相互作用中占主导地位，其次是疏水性和静电作用。值得注意的是，Arg、Phe、Trp和Lys等残基被认为是鲜味活性的重要贡献者。本研究为肉源性鲜味肽的结构-活性关系提供了新的见解。

本研究采用质谱分析、机器学习预测和分子对接技术，识别具有潜在鲜味活性的肽。随后合成目标肽，并通过感官分析和电子舌测量评估其鲜味强度、感官阈值和鲜味增强效果。此外，利用分子对接和动力学模拟探究了肽与T1R1/T1R3鲜味受体之间的相互作用。本研究旨在深入理解鲜味肽的结构-活性关系，并为开发牛肉来源的鲜味肽提供理论基础。

实验过程中，从邓川牛肉中提取粗肽并进行超滤处理，将所得水相分为不同分子量范围的分数。通过LC-MS/MS检测和分析，筛选出具有最佳鲜味特性的肽。利用MaxQuant软件对原始质谱数据进行处理和搜索，确定肽的氨基酸序列。结合iUmami_SCM、Umami_YYDS和Tastepeptides_DM三种预测方法，筛选出具有高鲜味强度和低苦味预测值的肽。

研究结果表明，ER-10和DR-11在鲜味增强方面表现出显著效果，且其与T1R1/T1R3受体的相互作用主要通过氢键作用实现。本研究为理解鲜味肽的结构-活性关系提供了新的视角，并为开发具有营养和风味功能的多效肽奠定了理论基础。
items.research_logic: 作者通过整合peptidomics、机器学习和分子模拟技术，提出并验证了Dengchuan牛肉中新型鲜味肽的假说。首先利用LC-MS/MS鉴定出4220种肽，并通过虚拟筛选筛选出5种潜在鲜味肽。随后通过感官评价和电子舌分析确认其鲜味特性，其中ER-10和DR-11表现出显著的鲜味增强效应。分子模拟进一步揭示了这些肽与T1R1/T1R3受体的相互作用，氢键、疏水和静电作用在其中起关键作用。综述分析通过比较不同肽的结构-活性关系，确定了关键氨基酸残基对鲜味活动的影响。每一步均基于实验数据进行验证，确保结果的可靠性与科学性。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，本研究通过整合peptidomics、机器学习和分子模拟技术，揭示了Dengchuan牛肉中新型鲜味肽的结构-活性关系，并提出了长链鲜味肽在风味调控中的潜在作用。该实验设计强调多维度分析与系统性验证，适用于探索其他肉类或食品成分中鲜味物质的作用机制。但需注意，此方法对长链肽的稳定性及水溶性要求较高，且适用范围受限于目标受体的可模拟性。
items.selection_reason: 本研究通过整合质谱分析、机器学习和分子模拟技术，揭示了邓川牛肉中新型鲜味肽的结构与活性关系。研究发现五种新型鲜味肽（ER-10, GK-10, DR-11, EA-11, HY-12）具有显著的鲜味增强效果，并通过分子对接分析确定了其与T1R1/T1R3受体的关键氨基酸残基。这些发现不仅拓展了对鲜味肽结构-活性关系的理解，也为开发具有营养和风味功能的多效肽提供了理论依据。研究方法超越常规流水线工作，注重实验设计、机制探索和具体发现，未虚构全球首次或期刊判定优秀。
items.application_prospects: 本研究通过整合质谱分析、机器学习和分子模拟技术，揭示了邓川牛肉中新型鲜味肽的结构-活性关系及其在食品风味中的应用潜力。研究发现，ER-10和DR-11等新型鲜味肽具有显著的鲜味增强效果，其作用机制涉及氢键、疏水及静电相互作用。这些肽类在不同食品原料中产生独特的风味特性，为开发多功能肽提供了理论基础。然而，长链鲜味肽的应用仍需进一步探索其稳定性与安全性。
items.future_directions: 未来研究可进一步探讨长链umami肽在不同食品原料中的分布与作用机制，以及其对味觉感知的长期影响。此外，结合机器学习与分子模拟技术，可深入分析umami肽与T1R1/T1R3受体的相互作用模式，以优化肽类物质的设计与应用。

fields.en:
This study reveals the composition and umami mechanism of novel umami peptides in Denglun beef by integrating mass spectrometry analysis, machine learning, and molecular simulation technologies. The research team extracted 4220 peptides from Denglun beef and screened out five novel umami peptides (ER-10, GK-10, DR-11, EA-11, HY-12). The umami characteristics of these peptides were confirmed through sensory evaluation and electronic tongue analysis, with ER-10 and DR-11 showing significant enhancement effects on umami. Molecular simulation shows that Lys155, Gln52, Ser109, Ser216, Arg255, Ser217, and Met151 are key residues for stable binding of the five peptides to T1R1/T1R3 receptors. Hydrogen bonds dominate these interactions, followed by hydrophobic and electrostatic effects. Notably, residues such as Arg, Phe, Trp, and Lys are considered important contributors to umami activity. This study provides new insights into the structure-activity relationship of meat-derived umami peptides.

This study employs mass spectrometry analysis, machine learning prediction, and molecular docking techniques to identify peptides with potential umami activity. Subsequently, the target peptides are synthesized and evaluated for their umami intensity, sensory threshold, and umami-enhancing effect through sensory analysis and electronic tongue measurements. Additionally, molecular docking and dynamics simulation are used to investigate the interactions between peptides and the T1R1/T1R3 umami receptors. The aim of this study is to deepen the understanding of the structure-activity relationship of umami peptides and to provide a theoretical basis for the development of umami peptides derived from beef.

During the experiment, crude peptides were extracted from Dqnc beef and subjected to ultrafiltration, dividing the resulting aqueous phase into fractions of different molecular weight ranges. By detecting and analyzing with LC-MS/MS, peptides with optimal umami characteristics were screened. The original mass spectrometry data were processed and searched using MaxQuant software to determine the amino acid sequences of the peptides. Combining three prediction methods: iUmami_SCM, Umami_YYDS, and Tastepeptides_DM, peptides with high umami intensity and low bitterness prediction values were selected.

The results show that ER-10 and DR-11 exhibit significant effects in enhancing umami, and their interaction with the T1R1/T1R3 receptors is mainly achieved through hydrogen bonds. This study provides a new perspective on understanding the structure-activity relationship of umami peptides and lays a theoretical foundation for developing multifunctional peptides with both nutritional and flavor functions.

paragraphs.zh: 本研究通过整合质谱分析、机器学习和分子模拟技术，揭示了邓川牛肉中新型鲜味肽的组成及其鲜味机制。研究团队从邓川牛肉中提取出4220种肽，并筛选出五种新型鲜味肽（ER-10, GK-10, DR-11, EA-11, HY-12）。通过感官评价和电子舌分析确认了这些肽的鲜味特性，其中ER-10和DR-11表现出显著的鲜味增强效果。分子模拟显示，Lys155、Gln52、Ser109、Ser216、Arg255、Ser217和Met151是五种肽与T1R1/T1R3受体稳定结合的关键残基。氢键作用在这些相互作用中占主导地位，其次是疏水性和静电作用。值得注意的是，Arg、Phe、Trp和Lys等残基被认为是鲜味活性的重要贡献者。本研究为肉源性鲜味肽的结构-活性关系提供了新的见解。

paragraphs.en: This study employs mass spectrometry analysis, machine learning prediction, and molecular docking techniques to identify peptides with potential umami activity. Subsequently, the target peptides are synthesized and evaluated for their umami intensity, sensory threshold, and umami-enhancing effect through sensory analysis and electronic tongue measurements. Additionally, molecular docking and dynamics simulation are used to investigate the interactions between peptides and the T1R1/T1R3 umami receptors. The aim of this study is to deepen the understanding of the structure-activity relationship of umami peptides and to provide a theoretical basis for the development of umami peptides derived from beef.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究采用质谱分析、机器学习预测和分子对接技术，识别具有潜在鲜味活性的肽。随后合成目标肽，并通过感官分析和电子舌测量评估其鲜味强度、感官阈值和鲜味增强效果。此外，利用分子对接和动力学模拟探究了肽与T1R1/T1R3鲜味受体之间的相互作用。本研究旨在深入理解鲜味肽的结构-活性关系，并为开发牛肉来源的鲜味肽提供理论基础。

paragraphs.en: During the experiment, crude peptides were extracted from Dqnc beef and subjected to ultrafiltration, dividing the resulting aqueous phase into fractions of different molecular weight ranges. By detecting and analyzing with LC-MS/MS, peptides with optimal umami characteristics were screened. The original mass spectrometry data were processed and searched using MaxQuant software to determine the amino acid sequences of the peptides. Combining three prediction methods: iUmami_SCM, Umami_YYDS, and Tastepeptides_DM, peptides with high umami intensity and low bitterness prediction values were selected.
paragraphs.zh: 实验过程中，从邓川牛肉中提取粗肽并进行超滤处理，将所得水相分为不同分子量范围的分数。通过LC-MS/MS检测和分析，筛选出具有最佳鲜味特性的肽。利用MaxQuant软件对原始质谱数据进行处理和搜索，确定肽的氨基酸序列。结合iUmami_SCM、Umami_YYDS和Tastepeptides_DM三种预测方法，筛选出具有高鲜味强度和低苦味预测值的肽。

paragraphs.en: The results show that ER-10 and DR-11 exhibit significant effects in enhancing umami, and their interaction with the T1R1/T1R3 receptors is mainly achieved through hydrogen bonds. This study provides a new perspective on understanding the structure-activity relationship of umami peptides and lays a theoretical foundation for developing multifunctional peptides with both nutritional and flavor functions.
paragraphs.zh: 研究结果表明，ER-10和DR-11在鲜味增强方面表现出显著效果，且其与T1R1/T1R3受体的相互作用主要通过氢键作用实现。本研究为理解鲜味肽的结构-活性关系提供了新的视角，并为开发具有营养和风味功能的多效肽奠定了理论基础。

fields.en: The author proposed and verified the hypothesis of novel umami peptides in Dengchuan beef by integrating peptidomics, machine learning, and molecular simulation technologies. First, 4220 peptides were identified using LC-MS/MS, and 5 potential umami peptides were screened out through virtual screening. Subsequently, their umami characteristics were confirmed through sensory evaluation and electronic tongue analysis, where ER-10 and DR-11 showed significant umami-enhancing effects. Molecular simulations further reveal the interactions between these peptides and the T1R1/T1R3 receptors, where hydrogen bonds, hydrophobic, and electrostatic interactions play crucial roles. A review analysis determined the impact of key amino acid residues on umami activity by comparing the structure-activity relationships of different peptides. Each step is verified based on experimental data to ensure the reliability and scientific validity of the results.
fields.zh: 作者通过整合peptidomics、机器学习和分子模拟技术，提出并验证了Dengchuan牛肉中新型鲜味肽的假说。首先利用LC-MS/MS鉴定出4220种肽，并通过虚拟筛选筛选出5种潜在鲜味肽。随后通过感官评价和电子舌分析确认其鲜味特性，其中ER-10和DR-11表现出显著的鲜味增强效应。分子模拟进一步揭示了这些肽与T1R1/T1R3受体的相互作用，氢键、疏水和静电作用在其中起关键作用。综述分析通过比较不同肽的结构-活性关系，确定了关键氨基酸残基对鲜味活动的影响。每一步均基于实验数据进行验证，确保结果的可靠性与科学性。

fields.en: My conclusion is that this study reveals the structure-activity relationship of novel umami peptides in Dengchuan beef by integrating peptidomics, machine learning, and molecular simulation technologies, and proposes the potential role of long-chain umami peptides in flavor regulation. The experimental design emphasizes multidimensional analysis and systematic verification, making it applicable for exploring the mechanisms of umami compounds in other meats or food components. However, it should be noted that this method has high requirements for the stability and solubility of long-chain peptides, and its applicability is limited by the simulating capacity of the target receptor.
fields.zh: 我的归纳是，本研究通过整合peptidomics、机器学习和分子模拟技术，揭示了Dengchuan牛肉中新型鲜味肽的结构-活性关系，并提出了长链鲜味肽在风味调控中的潜在作用。该实验设计强调多维度分析与系统性验证，适用于探索其他肉类或食品成分中鲜味物质的作用机制。但需注意，此方法对长链肽的稳定性及水溶性要求较高，且适用范围受限于目标受体的可模拟性。

fields.label_en: Why selected and what is innovative
fields.label_zh: 推荐理由与创新点（详细）
fields.en: This study reveals the structural and activity relationships of novel umami peptides in Dqningchuan beef by integrating mass spectrometry analysis, machine learning, and molecular simulation technologies. The study found that five novel umami peptides (ER-10, GK-10, DR-11, EA-11, HY-12) have significant umami-enhancing effects, and their key amino acid residues interacting with the T1R1/T1R3 receptors were determined through molecular docking analysis. These findings not only expand the understanding of the structural-activity relationships of umami peptides but also provide theoretical basis for developing multifunctional peptides with both nutritional and flavor properties. The research methods go beyond conventional pipeline work, focusing on experimental design, mechanism exploration, and specific discoveries, without fabricating global firsts or outstanding journal judgments.
fields.zh: 本研究通过整合质谱分析、机器学习和分子模拟技术，揭示了邓川牛肉中新型鲜味肽的结构与活性关系。研究发现五种新型鲜味肽（ER-10, GK-10, DR-11, EA-11, HY-12）具有显著的鲜味增强效果，并通过分子对接分析确定了其与T1R1/T1R3受体的关键氨基酸残基。这些发现不仅拓展了对鲜味肽结构-活性关系的理解，也为开发具有营养和风味功能的多效肽提供了理论依据。研究方法超越常规流水线工作，注重实验设计、机制探索和具体发现，未虚构全球首次或期刊判定优秀。

fields.en: This study reveals the structure-activity relationship of novel umami peptides in Dungquan beef and their potential application in food flavoring by integrating mass spectrometry analysis, machine learning, and molecular simulation technologies. The study found that novel umami peptides such as ER-10 and DR-11 have significant umami-enhancing effects, with their mechanisms of action involving hydrogen bonds, hydrophobic, and electrostatic interactions. These peptides exhibit unique flavor characteristics in different food ingredients, providing a theoretical basis for the development of multifunctional peptides. However, the application of long-chain umami peptides still requires further exploration of their stability and safety.
fields.zh: 本研究通过整合质谱分析、机器学习和分子模拟技术，揭示了邓川牛肉中新型鲜味肽的结构-活性关系及其在食品风味中的应用潜力。研究发现，ER-10和DR-11等新型鲜味肽具有显著的鲜味增强效果，其作用机制涉及氢键、疏水及静电相互作用。这些肽类在不同食品原料中产生独特的风味特性，为开发多功能肽提供了理论基础。然而，长链鲜味肽的应用仍需进一步探索其稳定性与安全性。

fields.en: Future research could further explore the distribution and mechanisms of action of long-chain umami peptides in different food ingredients, as well as their long-term effects on taste perception. Additionally, combining machine learning with molecular simulation techniques could provide a deeper analysis of the interaction patterns between umami peptides and T1R1/T1R3 receptors, aiming to optimize the design and application of peptide substances.
fields.zh: 未来研究可进一步探讨长链umami肽在不同食品原料中的分布与作用机制，以及其对味觉感知的长期影响。此外，结合机器学习与分子模拟技术，可深入分析umami肽与T1R1/T1R3受体的相互作用模式，以优化肽类物质的设计与应用。

decisions.focus: Quantum noise spectroscopy of nanoscale charge defects in silicon carbide at room temperature

This work presents a novel quantum noise spectroscopy technique using PL5 centers in 4H-SiC to characterize nanoscale charge defects and their impact on semiconductor performance. The method enables real-time, high-resolution detection of electrical and magnetic noise at the atomic level, offering insights into defect dynamics and material quality. The study demonstrates the capability of this approach to identify the native oxide layer as a source of electromagnetic fluctuations, establishing a versatile platform for semiconductor engineering and quantum technologies.
