classification_audit.abstract: The nanoscale charge environment critically influences the performance of semiconductor devices, yet traditional characterization techniques usually lack the spatial resolution to resolve nanoscale charge heterogeneity and identify microscopic noise sources. Here, we address this critical gap using individual PL5 color centers in commercial silicon carbide as room-temperature, broadband (near-dc to gigahertz) quantum spectrometers. We report real-time, nanoscale observation of single-charge tunneling dynamics at room temperature in 4H-SiC by monitoring the random telegraph noise using optically detected magnetic resonance. This capability enables an electrical noise imaging technique that shows distinct noise variations on different wafers. Using dynamical decoupling and T 1 relaxation spectroscopy, we observe correlations of noise spectral density across frequency bands and obtain the nanoscale electron paramagnetic resonance fingerprint of spin defects in silicon carbide. Ultimately, through surface chemical engineering, we identify the native oxide layer as the main source of resolved electromagnetic fluctuations. This work establishes a versatile atomic-scale metrology platform bridging quantum sensing and semiconductor engineering, offering critical insights for optimizing third-generation semiconductor interfaces and advancing solid-state quantum technologies.

研究利用硅碳化物中的PL5色心作为室温下的宽频量子噪声谱仪，实现了对纳米尺度电荷缺陷的实时观测。通过光检测磁共振监测随机 Telegraph 噪声，捕捉到单个电荷隧穿动力学的变化，并识别出不同晶圆间的噪声差异。实验采用动态去耦和T1弛豫谱学技术，观察到噪声频带间的相关性，并获得硅碳化物中自旋缺陷的纳米级电子顺磁共振指纹。通过表面化学工程，确定了原生氧化层是主要的电磁波动源。该工作建立了一个连接量子传感与半导体工程的多功能原子尺度计量平台，为优化第三代半导体界面和推进固态量子技术提供了关键见解。

研究通过PL5色心在室温下实现宽频噪声检测，利用其极高的电场敏感性和纳米级分辨率，捕捉到实时电荷动态。从微观洞察扩展至宏观计量工具，实现了噪声环境的频率分辨表征，包括映射不同晶圆间的异质性和质量差异，以及获得自旋缺陷的纳米级电子顺磁共振指纹。通过对比实验前后表面处理结果，确定了原生SiO2层是噪声的主要物理来源。

研究揭示了纳米尺度电荷环境的监测方法，通过PL5色心在单个电荷水平上实现对电环境的监控。通过连续波光检测磁共振（CW-ODMR）测量，观察到不同中心频率的典型谱配置，并通过时间分辨测量揭示其谱峰位置的变化。通过统计分析，确定了噪声波动源于两个陷阱的捕获和释放事件。此外，研究还展示了对不同晶圆进行材料表征的能力，证明了该方法在揭示晶圆间电荷陷阱密度和材料质量差异方面的有效性。

表面化学工程验证了界面谱噪声模型，通过去除原生氧化层暴露裸露的SiC表面，显著降低了近直流噪声。实验结果显示，经过BOE处理后，样品1中的慢谱扩散（σf）得到全球性抑制。在兆赫兹和吉赫兹频段，电噪声和磁噪声分别因裸露表面和去除氧化物参数化自旋浴而发生变化。该研究为纳米尺度电荷噪声分布的成像提供了有力工具，并展示了其在晶圆级诊断中的应用潜力。
items.research_logic: 作者通过PL5中心构建了室温下的宽频量子噪声谱仪，利用光检测磁共振监测随机 Telegraph 噪声，实现纳米尺度的单电荷隧穿动力学实时观测。通过动态去耦和T1弛豫谱，观察不同频率带间的噪声谱密度相关性，并获得SiC中自旋缺陷的电子顺磁共振指纹。最后，通过表面化学工程对比实验前后结果，确定原生氧化层为电磁波动的主要来源。该方法建立了一种原子尺度计量平台，连接量子传感与半导体工程，为优化第三代半导体界面和推进固态量子技术提供关键见解。每一步均通过实验验证，排除替代解释，确保噪声源的准确识别与定位。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，该研究通过PL5中心在室温下实现宽频带量子噪声谱仪，能够实时观测纳米尺度电荷隧穿动力学，并揭示噪声源的微观机制。这一方法利用动态去耦和T1弛豫谱，实现了频率分辨的噪声环境表征，为半导体材料的缺陷分析提供了原子级计量平台。该实验设计可迁移至其他半导体材料的噪声来源识别与界面优化中，但需注意其对表面化学处理的敏感性。
items.selection_reason: 本文通过开发基于PL5中心的室温宽频量子噪声谱仪，实现了对硅碳化物中纳米尺度电荷缺陷的高灵敏度检测。该方法利用光探测磁共振技术，在室温下实时观测单个电荷隧穿动力学，并通过动态去耦和T1弛豫谱学分析，获得纳米级电子顺磁共振指纹。实验揭示了表面氧化层作为主要噪声源，证明了该技术在纳米尺度上对电荷缺陷的高分辨成像能力。与传统方法相比，该方法具有更宽的频率范围（近直流至吉赫兹）和更高的空间分辨率，能够区分不同晶圆间的噪声差异，并提供材料质量评估的可靠依据。此工作建立了量子传感与半导体工程之间的桥梁，为优化第三代半导体界面和推进固态量子技术提供了关键见解。
items.application_prospects: 本文通过室温下的量子噪声谱仪，实现了对硅碳化物中纳米尺度电荷缺陷的高分辨率检测。该技术利用PL5中心作为宽带量子传感器，在近直流至吉赫兹频率范围内捕捉电荷动态，揭示了表面氧化层作为电磁波动主要来源的作用。研究展示了该方法在材料表征中的应用潜力，能够区分不同晶圆间的噪声差异，并为优化第三代半导体界面提供关键见解。
items.future_directions: 本文通过开发室温宽带量子噪声谱仪，实现了对硅碳化物中纳米尺度噪声源的高灵敏度检测。未来可进一步研究不同材料表面处理对噪声特性的影响，并探索如何利用该技术优化第三代半导体界面性能。此外，针对噪声来源的精确识别，可设计更高效的表面化学工程策略以减少电磁波动。

fields.en:
The study utilizes the PL5 center in silicon carbide as a wideband quantum noise spectrometer at room temperature, achieving real-time observation of nanoscale charge defects. By optically detecting magnetic resonance to monitor random Telegraph noise, changes in individual charge tunneling dynamics are captured, and differences in noise between different wafers are identified. The experiment employs dynamic decoupling and T1 relaxation spectroscopy techniques, observing correlations between noise bands and obtaining a nanoscale electron paramagnetic resonance fingerprint of spin defects in silicon carbide. Through surface chemical engineering, it is determined that the native oxide layer is the primary source of electromagnetic fluctuations. This work establishes a multifunctional atomic-scale metrology platform connecting quantum sensing with semiconductor engineering, providing key insights for optimizing third-generation semiconductor interfaces and advancing solid-state quantum technologies.

The study achieves wideband noise detection at room temperature using PL5 color centers, leveraging their extremely high electric field sensitivity and nanoscale resolution to capture real-time charge dynamics. Expanding from microscale insights to macroscopic metrology tools, it enables frequency-resolved characterization of noise environments, including mapping heterogeneity and quality differences between different wafers, as well as obtaining nanoscale electron paramagnetic resonance fingerprints of spin defects. By comparing experimental results before and after surface treatment, the native SiO2 layer is identified as the primary physical source of noise.

The study reveals a method for monitoring the electric environment at the nanoscale through PL5 color centers, enabling monitoring of the electric environment at the level of individual charges. By measuring with continuous-wave optical detection magnetic resonance (CW-ODMR), typical spectral configurations at different center frequencies are observed, and changes in the position of spectral peaks are revealed through time-resolved measurements. Through statistical analysis, it is determined that noise fluctuations originate from capture and release events of two traps. Furthermore, the study demonstrates the capability of material characterization for different wafers, proving the effectiveness of the method in revealing differences in charge trap density and material quality between wafers.

Surface chemical engineering validated the interface spectral noise model by removing the native oxide layer to expose the bare SiC surface, significantly reducing the near DC noise. Experimental results showed that after BOE treatment, the slow spectrum diffusion (σf) in sample 1 was globally suppressed. In the megahertz and gigahertz bands, electrical noise and magnetic noise respectively changed due to the exposed surface and the removal of oxide parameters for spin bath. This study provides a powerful tool for imaging the distribution of electronic charge noise at the nanoscale and demonstrates its potential application in wafer-level diagnosis.

表面化学工程验证了界面谱噪声模型，通过去除原生氧化层暴露裸露的SiC表面，显著降低了近直流噪声。实验结果显示，经过BOE处理后，样品1中的慢谱扩散（σf）得到全球性抑制。在兆赫兹和吉赫兹频段，电噪声和磁噪声分别因裸露表面和去除氧化物参数化自旋浴而发生变化。该研究为纳米尺度电荷噪声分布的成像提供了有力工具，并展示了其在晶圆级诊断中的应用潜力。

paragraphs.en: The study utilizes the PL5 center in silicon carbide as a wideband quantum noise spectrometer at room temperature, achieving real-time observation of nanoscale charge defects. By optically detecting magnetic resonance to monitor random Telegraph noise, changes in individual charge tunneling dynamics are captured, and differences in noise between different wafers are identified. The experiment employs dynamic decoupling and T1 relaxation spectroscopy techniques, observing correlations between noise bands and obtaining a nanoscale electron paramagnetic resonance fingerprint of spin defects in silicon carbide. Through surface chemical engineering, it is determined that the native oxide layer is the primary source of electromagnetic fluctuations. This work establishes a multifunctional atomic-scale metrology platform connecting quantum sensing with semiconductor engineering, providing key insights for optimizing third-generation semiconductor interfaces and advancing solid-state quantum technologies.
paragraphs.zh: 研究利用硅碳化物中的PL5色心作为室温下的宽频量子噪声谱仪，实现了对纳米尺度电荷缺陷的实时观测。通过光检测磁共振监测随机 Telegraph 噪声，捕捉到单个电荷隧穿动力学的变化，并识别出不同晶圆间的噪声差异。实验采用动态去耦和T1弛豫谱学技术，观察到噪声频带间的相关性，并获得硅碳化物中自旋缺陷的纳米级电子顺磁共振指纹。通过表面化学工程，确定了原生氧化层是主要的电磁波动源。该工作建立了一个连接量子传感与半导体工程的多功能原子尺度计量平台，为优化第三代半导体界面和推进固态量子技术提供了关键见解。

paragraphs.en: The study achieves wideband noise detection at room temperature using PL5 color centers, leveraging their extremely high electric field sensitivity and nanoscale resolution to capture real-time charge dynamics. Expanding from microscale insights to macroscopic metrology tools, it enables frequency-resolved characterization of noise environments, including mapping heterogeneity and quality differences between different wafers, as well as obtaining nanoscale electron paramagnetic resonance fingerprints of spin defects. By comparing experimental results before and after surface treatment, the native SiO2 layer is identified as the primary physical source of noise.

paragraphs.en: The study reveals a method for monitoring the electric environment at the nanoscale through PL5 color centers, enabling monitoring of the electric environment at the level of individual charges. By measuring with continuous-wave optical detection magnetic resonance (CW-ODMR), typical spectral configurations at different center frequencies are observed, and changes in the position of spectral peaks are revealed through time-resolved measurements. Through statistical analysis, it is determined that noise fluctuations originate from capture and release events of two traps. Furthermore, the study demonstrates the capability of material characterization for different wafers, proving the effectiveness of the method in revealing differences in charge trap density and material quality between wafers.

paragraphs.en: Surface chemical engineering validated the interface spectral noise model by removing the native oxide layer to expose the bare SiC surface, significantly reducing the near DC noise. Experimental results showed that after BOE treatment, the slow spectrum diffusion (σf) in sample 1 was globally suppressed. In the megahertz and gigahertz bands, electrical noise and magnetic noise respectively changed due to the exposed surface and the removal of oxide parameters for spin bath. This study provides a powerful tool for imaging the distribution of electronic charge noise at the nanoscale and demonstrates its potential application in wafer-level diagnosis.

fields.en: The author constructed a wideband quantum noise spectrometer at room temperature using PL5 center, utilizing optical detection magnetic resonance to monitor random Telegraph noise, achieving real-time observation of single-electron tunneling dynamics at the nanoscale. By dynamic decoupling and T1 relaxation spectra, the correlation between noise density across different frequency bands was observed, and the electron paramagnetic resonance fingerprint of spin defects in SiC was obtained. Finally, by comparing experimental results before and after surface chemical engineering, it was determined that the native oxide layer is the main source of electromagnetic fluctuations. This method establishes an atomic-scale metrology platform connecting quantum sensing with semiconductor engineering, providing critical insights for optimizing the interface of third-generation semiconductors and advancing solid-state quantum technology. Each step was verified by experiments, excluding alternative explanations, ensuring accurate identification and localization of noise sources.
fields.zh: 作者通过PL5中心构建了室温下的宽频量子噪声谱仪，利用光检测磁共振监测随机 Telegraph 噪声，实现纳米尺度的单电荷隧穿动力学实时观测。通过动态去耦和T1弛豫谱，观察不同频率带间的噪声谱密度相关性，并获得SiC中自旋缺陷的电子顺磁共振指纹。最后，通过表面化学工程对比实验前后结果，确定原生氧化层为电磁波动的主要来源。该方法建立了一种原子尺度计量平台，连接量子传感与半导体工程，为优化第三代半导体界面和推进固态量子技术提供关键见解。每一步均通过实验验证，排除替代解释，确保噪声源的准确识别与定位。

fields.en: My conclusion is that this study achieves a wideband quantum noise spectrometer operating at room temperature through the PL5 center, enabling real-time observation of nanoscale charge tunneling dynamics and revealing the micro-mechanisms of noise sources. This method utilizes dynamic decoupling and T1 relaxation spectra to achieve frequency-resolved characterization of the noise environment, providing an atomic-level metrology platform for defect analysis in semiconductor materials. The experimental design can be transferred to other semiconductor materials for noise source identification and interface optimization, but it should be noted its sensitivity to surface chemical treatments.

fields.label_zh: 推荐理由与创新点（详细）
fields.en: This paper achieves high-sensitivity detection of nanoscale charge defects in silicon carbide by developing a room-temperature wideband quantum noise spectrometer based on PL5. The method utilizes optical detection magnetic resonance technology to observe the dynamics of individual charge tunneling in real time at room temperature, and through dynamic decoupling and T1 relaxation spectroscopy analysis, obtains a nanoscale electron paramagnetic resonance fingerprint. The experiment reveals that the surface oxide layer is the main noise source, demonstrating the technique's capability for high-resolution imaging of charge defects at the nanoscale. Compared to traditional methods, this approach offers a wider frequency range (near direct current to gigahertz) and higher spatial resolution, enabling differentiation between noise differences across different wafers and providing reliable basis for material quality assessment. This work establishes a bridge between quantum sensing and semiconductor engineering, offering critical insights for optimizing the third-generation semiconductor interface and advancing solid-state quantum technology.

fields.en: This paper achieves high-sensitivity detection of nanoscale noise sources in silicon carbide by developing a room-temperature broadband quantum noise spectrometer. Future research could further investigate the effects of different surface treatments on noise characteristics and explore how to utilize this technology to optimize the performance of third-generation semiconductor interfaces. Additionally, for the precise identification of noise sources, more efficient surface chemical engineering strategies can be designed to reduce electromagnetic fluctuations.

classification_audit.abstract: Abstract Continuous-flow technology has emerged as a powerful platform for resource-economical molecular synthesis, thereby addressing key limitations of conventional batch processes through unparalleled control of temperature and residence time as well as improved heat and mass transfer. Especially, the application of flow chemistry to CH functionalization bears unique potential. By leveraging otherwise inert CH bonds as latent functional groups, the step- and atom-economical access to value-added molecular architectures from abundant and readily available starting materials is facilitated. Thereby, flow reactor technology enables superior heat and mass transfer, accelerated kinetics, and direct scalability, promoting operationally simple, safe, and sustainable transformations. Continuous-flow has proven enabling in photo- and electrocatalysis as well as their synergistic merger in photoelectrochemical catalysis. In addition, these strategies unlock the use of earth-abundant catalysts and renewable solvents, while streamlining molecular synthesis. Keywords: Continuous-Flow, CH Functionalization, Electrochemistry, Enantioselective Catalysis, Photochemistry, Photoelectrocatalysis

连续流技术在分子合成中的应用，为高效、选择性的化学反应提供了新的可能性。通过精准控制温度、停留时间和反应物配比，连续流反应器能够实现对反应条件的精细调节，从而提高产率和选择性，并确保操作的安全性和可持续性。特别是在光催化和电催化领域，连续流技术展现出独特的优势。光催化利用光子作为无痕试剂，通过激发态的电子反应解锁传统热条件下难以实现的化学转化；而电催化则借助电子转移实现对化学选择性的精确控制，同时避免了传统氧化还原试剂的使用。两者的协同作用在光电化学催化中尤为显著，能够有效提升反应效率和产物纯度。

光催化与电催化的结合进一步拓展了连续流技术的应用范围。通过优化光子穿透和电子传输，连续流系统实现了对反应条件的精准控制，从而提高了反应的可重复性和选择性。此外，这种协同作用还允许在不牺牲选择性的前提下实现大规模合成，为复杂分子的构建提供了新的途径。

综上所述，连续流技术不仅解决了传统批次工艺中的热管理和传质问题，还通过精确调控反应条件，推动了光催化、电催化及光电化学催化的融合发展。这种技术平台在提高反应效率、选择性和可持续性方面具有显著优势，为未来分子合成的创新和应用提供了坚实基础。
items.research_logic: 作者通过引入连续流技术，逐步验证了其在电催化和光催化C–H功能化中的应用潜力。首先，作者指出传统批次工艺的局限性，并强调连续流技术对温度、停留时间和混合的精确控制，从而提升反应效率和选择性。接着，作者分析了光化学和电化学在连续流系统中的协同作用，通过光子和电子的协同效应实现更高效的键形成。随后，作者详细描述了光催化和电催化C–H功能化在连续流系统中的具体应用案例，如光催化中通过精确控制光子通量与钴催化的立体控制实现高对映选择性产物合成；电催化中通过精准调控氧化还原电位实现温和条件下的选择性氧化还原反应。最后，作者总结了连续流技术在提升反应规模、安全性和可持续性方面的优势，并指出其在光电子化学系统中的协同效应进一步拓展了合成方法的多样性。每一步分析均基于文献中提供的具体实验数据和案例，确保结论的科学性和可重复性。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，连续流技术通过精准控制温度、停留时间和反应物配比，显著提升了光化学和电化学催化中C–H功能化的效率与选择性。该技术能够克服传统批次工艺的热传递和混合不均问题，实现高效、安全的规模化操作。尤其在协同光电催化体系中，其高表面面积与快速散热特性使光子和电子的协同作用得以优化，为复杂分子合成提供了可迁移的设计原则。此机制适用于其他需要精准控制反应条件的催化过程，但受限于催化剂的稳定性和溶剂的兼容性。
items.selection_reason: 连续流技术在电催化和光催化C–H功能化中的应用展现了显著优势。通过精准控制反应温度、停留时间和试剂配比，连续流系统能够实现高效、选择性的分子合成。特别是在光化学和电化学协同作用下，该技术克服了传统批次工艺中光穿透不均、热管理不足等问题，提高了反应效率与产物选择性。例如，利用光化学与电化学的协同效应，可实现对复杂立体中心的高选择性构建，同时避免使用有毒溶剂和贵金属催化剂。此外，连续流系统支持大规模放大操作，并能有效回收未反应物，进一步提升了工艺的可持续性。这些特性使连续流技术成为推动绿色化学发展的关键工具，为未来分子合成提供了更高效、安全的解决方案。
items.application_prospects: 本文探讨了连续流动技术在光电催化C–H功能化中的应用前景。通过流式反应器实现精准控制温度、停留时间和反应物配比，显著提升反应效率和选择性。光化学与电化学的协同作用可有效利用光子和电子作为无痕试剂，促进高效能量转换。流式技术能够克服传统批次工艺的局限，如光穿透不足和热管理困难，同时实现大规模合成。该技术适用于多种领域，包括催化、材料、能源及环境应用，但需注意其对地球丰富催化剂和可再生溶剂的依赖。
items.future_directions: 未来的研究可聚焦于开发更高效的模块化反应器与在线分析技术的结合，以实现连续流工艺的实时监控和自主优化。同时，需进一步探索如何在电化学和光化学条件下提升流动系统的稳定性和兼容性，以适应复杂多步催化过程。此外，针对光电子催化体系中光子与电子的协同作用机制，可设计更精确的反应条件控制策略，以实现对关键中间体的高效转化与选择性调控。

fields.en:
The application of continuous flow technology in molecular synthesis provides new possibilities for efficient and selective chemical reactions. By precisely controlling temperature, residence time, and reactant ratios, continuous flow reactors can achieve fine-tuning of reaction conditions, thereby improving yield and selectivity, and ensuring the safety and sustainability of operations. Particularly in photocatalysis and electrocatalysis, continuous flow technology demonstrates unique advantages. Photocatalysis uses photons as a traceless reagent, utilizing excited electrons to unlock chemical transformations that are difficult to achieve under traditional thermal conditions; while electrocatalysis employs electron transfer to precisely control chemical selectivity, avoiding the use of traditional oxidizing and reducing agents. The synergy between the two is particularly significant in photoelectrochemical catalysis, effectively enhancing reaction efficiency and product purity.

The integration of photocatalysis and electrocatalysis further expands the application range of continuous flow technology. By optimizing photon penetration and electron transfer, continuous flow systems achieve precise control over reaction conditions, thereby improving the repeatability and selectivity of reactions. Additionally, this synergy allows for large-scale synthesis without compromising selectivity, providing new pathways for the construction of complex molecules.

In conclusion, continuous flow technology not only addresses thermal management and mass transfer issues in traditional batch processes but also promotes the integration and development of photocatalysis, electrocatalysis, and photoelectrochemical catalysis through precise control of reaction conditions. This technological platform offers significant advantages in improving reaction efficiency, selectivity, and sustainability, providing a solid foundation for future innovation and application in molecular synthesis.

fields.en: The author verifies the potential application of continuous flow technology in electrocatalytic and photocatalytic C–H functionalization through the introduction of continuous flow technology. First, the author points out the limitations of traditional batch processes and emphasizes the advantages of continuous flow technology for precise control of temperature, residence time, and mixing, thereby enhancing reaction efficiency and selectivity. Next, the author analyzed the synergistic effects of phot chemistry and electrochemistry in continuous flow systems, achieving more efficient bond formation through the synergy of photons and electrons. Subsequently, the author provides a detailed description of specific applications of photocatalytic and electrocatalytic C–H functionalization in continuous flow systems, such as achieving high enantioselective product synthesis through precise control of photon flux and cobalt catalysis in photocatalysis; Precise regulation of redox potential in electrocatalysis enables selective redox reactions under mild conditions. Finally, the author summarized the advantages of continuous flow technology in enhancing reaction scale, safety, and sustainability, and pointed out that its synergistic effects in photochemical systems further expand the diversity of synthetic methods. Each step of the analysis is based on specific experimental data and cases provided in the literature, ensuring the scientific validity and reproducibility of the conclusions.

paragraphs.en: The author verifies the potential application of continuous flow technology in electrocatalytic and photocatalytic C–H functionalization through the introduction of continuous flow technology. First, the author points out the limitations of traditional batch processes and emphasizes the advantages of continuous flow technology for precise control of temperature, residence time, and mixing, thereby enhancing reaction efficiency and selectivity. Next, the author analyzed the synergistic effects of phot chemistry and electrochemistry in continuous flow systems, achieving more efficient bond formation through the synergy of photons and electrons. Subsequently, the author provides a detailed description of specific applications of photocatalytic and electrocatalytic C–H functionalization in continuous flow systems, such as achieving high enantioselective product synthesis through precise control of photon flux and cobalt catalysis in photocatalysis; Precise regulation of redox potential in electrocatalysis enables selective redox reactions under mild conditions. Finally, the author summarized the advantages of continuous flow technology in enhancing reaction scale, safety, and sustainability, and pointed out that its synergistic effects in photochemical systems further expand the diversity of synthetic methods. Each step of the analysis is based on specific experimental data and cases provided in the literature, ensuring the scientific validity and reproducibility of the conclusions.

fields.en: My conclusion is that continuous flow technology significantly enhances the efficiency and selectivity of C–H functionalization in photocatalytic and electrocatalytic processes by precisely controlling temperature, residence time, and reactant ratios. This technology can overcome the issues of heat transfer and mixing in traditional batch processes, enabling efficient and safe scale-up operations. Particularly in synergistic photoelectrochemical systems, its high surface area and rapid heat dissipation properties optimize the synergistic effects of photons and electrons, providing transferable design principles for the synthesis of complex molecules. This mechanism is applicable to other catalytic processes requiring precise control of reaction conditions, but is limited by the stability of catalysts and the compatibility of solvents.
fields.zh: 我的归纳是，连续流技术通过精准控制温度、停留时间和反应物配比，显著提升了光化学和电化学催化中C–H功能化的效率与选择性。该技术能够克服传统批次工艺的热传递和混合不均问题，实现高效、安全的规模化操作。尤其在协同光电催化体系中，其高表面面积与快速散热特性使光子和电子的协同作用得以优化，为复杂分子合成提供了可迁移的设计原则。此机制适用于其他需要精准控制反应条件的催化过程，但受限于催化剂的稳定性和溶剂的兼容性。

fields.label_en: Why selected and what is innovative
fields.label_zh: 推荐理由与创新点（详细）
fields.en: The application of continuous flow technology in electrocatalytic and photocatalytic C–H functionalization has demonstrated significant advantages. By precisely controlling reaction temperature, residence time, and reagent ratios, continuous flow systems can achieve efficient and selective molecular synthesis. Particularly under the synergistic effects of photochemistry and electrochemistry, this technology overcomes issues such as uneven light penetration and inadequate thermal management in traditional batch processes, thereby improving reaction efficiency and product selectivity. For example, by leveraging the synergistic effect of photochemistry and electrochemistry, complex stereocenters can be selectively constructed, while avoiding the use of toxic solvents and precious metal catalysts. Additionally, continuous flow systems support large-scale amplification operations and effectively recover unreacted materials, further enhancing the sustainability of the process. These characteristics make continuous flow technology a key tool for promoting green chemistry, providing more efficient and safe solutions for future molecular synthesis.
fields.zh: 连续流技术在电催化和光催化C–H功能化中的应用展现了显著优势。通过精准控制反应温度、停留时间和试剂配比，连续流系统能够实现高效、选择性的分子合成。特别是在光化学和电化学协同作用下，该技术克服了传统批次工艺中光穿透不均、热管理不足等问题，提高了反应效率与产物选择性。例如，利用光化学与电化学的协同效应，可实现对复杂立体中心的高选择性构建，同时避免使用有毒溶剂和贵金属催化剂。此外，连续流系统支持大规模放大操作，并能有效回收未反应物，进一步提升了工艺的可持续性。这些特性使连续流技术成为推动绿色化学发展的关键工具，为未来分子合成提供了更高效、安全的解决方案。

fields.en: This paper explores the prospects of continuous flow technology in photoelectrochemical C–H functionalization. By using a flow reactor to achieve precise control of temperature, residence time, and reactant ratios, reaction efficiency and selectivity are significantly improved. The synergistic action of phot chemistry and electrochemistry can effectively utilize photons and electrons as traceless reagents, promoting efficient energy conversion. Flow technology can overcome the limitations of traditional batch processes, such as insufficient light penetration and thermal management difficulties, while enabling large-scale synthesis. This technology is applicable to various fields, including catalysis, materials, energy, and environmental applications, but it should be noted its dependence on earth-abundant catalysts and renewable solvents.
fields.zh: 本文探讨了连续流动技术在光电催化C–H功能化中的应用前景。通过流式反应器实现精准控制温度、停留时间和反应物配比，显著提升反应效率和选择性。光化学与电化学的协同作用可有效利用光子和电子作为无痕试剂，促进高效能量转换。流式技术能够克服传统批次工艺的局限，如光穿透不足和热管理困难，同时实现大规模合成。该技术适用于多种领域，包括催化、材料、能源及环境应用，但需注意其对地球丰富催化剂和可再生溶剂的依赖。

fields.en: Future research can focus on developing more efficient combinations of modular reactors and online analysis technologies to achieve real-time monitoring and autonomous optimization of continuous flow processes. At the same time, further exploration is needed on how to enhance the stability and compatibility of flow systems under electrochemical and phot chemical conditions to adapt to complex multi-step catalytic processes. Additionally, for the synergistic effects of photons and electrons in photoelectrochemical systems, more precise reaction condition control strategies can be designed to achieve efficient conversion and selective regulation of key intermediates.
fields.zh: 未来的研究可聚焦于开发更高效的模块化反应器与在线分析技术的结合，以实现连续流工艺的实时监控和自主优化。同时，需进一步探索如何在电化学和光化学条件下提升流动系统的稳定性和兼容性，以适应复杂多步催化过程。此外，针对光电子催化体系中光子与电子的协同作用机制，可设计更精确的反应条件控制策略，以实现对关键中间体的高效转化与选择性调控。

decisions.focus: A quadratic-scaling algorithm with guaranteed convergence for quantum coupled-channel calculations

The paper presents a groundbreaking algorithm that addresses the computational bottleneck of quantum coupled-channel (CC) calculations by achieving quadratic scaling in computational cost. The WISE algorithm overcomes the limitations of traditional iterative methods through spectral regularization, ensuring convergence and stability even in the presence of closed channels and divergent eigenvalues. This method enables rigorous quantum scattering computations for complex molecular systems, significantly advancing the field of quantum dynamics in atomic, molecular, and astrochemistry.

evidence.text: Quantum collision dynamics of atoms, molecules, and nuclei is central to a vast array of fields ranging from atomic, molecular, and optical (AMO) physics ( 1 – 3 ) to chemical reaction dynamics ( 4 – 7 ), astrochemistry ( 8 , 9 ), and nuclear physics ( 10 ). Precision calculations of scattering observables—such as state-to-state cross sections and reaction rates—provide essential quantitative insights into complex quantum phenomena abundant in these fields. Examples include intricate mechanisms

In the following, we describe how the WISE framework overcomes the two primary challenges of the naive iterative approach ( 35 , 36 ): the rigorous inclusion of closed channels and the guaranteed convergence of the iterative series through spectral regularization.

This framework guarantees convergence regardless of the interaction strength or the presence of closed channels while retaining the favorable matrix-vector operational scaling. As shown in the right in Fig. 1B , the regularization procedure tames the exponential divergence of the Born series for the three-channel model of He + CO collisions with one closed channel, bringing the results in perfect agreement with exact CC calculations.

This setup creates a scattering problem of substantially greater complexity than He + CO collisions: The number of channels increases by an order of magnitude. Given the standard cubic scaling, this corresponds to a 1000-fold increase in computational cost. Figure 4B shows that our WISE algorithm successfully replicates exact CC results for the de-excitation cross section across a broad range of collision energies (1 to 1000 cm −1 ). The agreement is excellent over the entire energy range.

The resulting Weinberg-regularized Iterative Series Expansion (WISE) algorithm guarantees numerical convergence of scattering observables regardless of the strength or anisotropy of the interaction potential. We demonstrate the robustness and quadratic scaling of the WISE algorithm by applying it to multichannel He + CO and CO + N 2 collisions on ab initio potential energy surfaces (PESs). These results enable rigorous quantum scattering calculations on a wide array of molecular systems previous

classification_audit.abstract: Rigorous quantum dynamics calculations provide essential insights into complex scattering phenomena across atomic and molecular physics, chemical reaction dynamics, and astrochemistry. However, the application of the gold-standard quantum coupled-channel (CC) method has been fundamentally constrained by a steep cubic scaling of computational cost [ O ( N 3 ) ] . Here, we develop a general, rigorous, and robust method for solving the time-independent Schrödinger equation for a single column of the scattering S-matrix with quadratic scaling [ O ( N 2 ) ] in the number of channels. The Weinberg-regularized Iterative Series Expansion (WISE) algorithm resolves the divergence issues affecting iterative techniques by applying a regularization procedure to the kernel of the multichannel Lippmann-Schwinger integral equation. The method also explicitly incorporates closed-channel effects, including those responsible for multichannel Feshbach resonances. We demonstrate the power of this approach by performing rigorous calculations on He + CO and CO + N 2 collisions, achieving exact quantum results with quadratic scaling guaranteed by a contour-integral construction. Our results establish a highly scalable computational paradigm, enabling state-to-state quantum scattering computations for complex molecular systems.

items.action:
量子耦合通道（CC）计算是原子、分子、化学和核物理中解析复杂散射现象的重要工具。然而，传统的金标准CC方法因计算成本的立方级增长[O(N³)]而受到限制。本文提出了一种通用、严谨且稳健的方法，用于求解单列散射S矩阵的时间独立薛定谔方程，具有二次标度性[O(N²)]。Weinberg正则化的迭代级数展开（WISE）算法通过在多通道Lippmann-Schwinger积分方程的核中应用正则化程序，解决了迭代技术中的发散问题。该方法还明确纳入了闭合通道效应，包括导致多通道Feshbach共振的效应。我们通过在He + CO和CO + N₂碰撞上进行严谨计算，展示了这种方法的威力，实现了具有二次标度性的精确量子结果。我们的结果建立了一种高度可扩展的计算范式，使复杂分子系统的状态到状态量子散射计算成为可能，并为超冷分子物理、化学反应动力学和天体化学中的大规模数值模拟铺平了道路。

该方法的关键设计在于通过谱正则化确保迭代级数的收敛性。在理论部分，我们描述了WISE框架如何克服传统迭代方法的两个主要挑战：闭合通道的严格包含和迭代级数的保证收敛性。通过谱正则化处理，闭合通道的发散问题得到了有效控制，并且该方法保留了有利的矩阵-向量操作标度性。在应用部分，我们展示了WISE框架在量子分子碰撞动力学、冷和超冷化学以及天体化学中的广泛适用性。例如，在CO分子与He原子的冷碰撞中，该算法成功地复制了精确的CC结果。

该方法的实现分为三个阶段：首先构造参考格林函数；其次确定正则和不规则解；最后通过矩阵-向量操作计算离散核算子K。关键在于该算法不需要显式构建或存储完整的矩阵G、U off 或 K，而是实时计算这些操作。此外，通过矩阵自由的轮廓积分方法，该算法在大规模情况下仍能保持O(N²)的标度性，并且与闭合通道的数量无关。

综上所述，本文提出的方法为量子耦合通道计算提供了一种高效、稳健的解决方案，具有广泛的应用前景和理论价值。
items.research_logic: 作者提出假说通过解决量子耦合通道计算中的收敛性和闭合通道问题，逐步验证并排除替代解释。首先，通过理论分析时间独立的Schrödinger方程，确定需要处理的多通道问题，并指出传统方法在封闭通道和收敛性上的局限性（p6, p16）。随后，提出Weinberg正则化迭代级数展开（WISE）算法，通过谱正则化解决闭合通道的发散问题并保证收敛性（p25, p26）。该方法通过分析LS核的谱半径和Weinberg特征值，确保迭代级数的稳定性（p34, p35）。在应用层面，通过He+CO和CO+N₂碰撞计算验证算法的有效性，并展示其对复杂分子系统的适用性（p47, p48）。综述分析则通过比较不同方法的收敛性和计算复杂度，强调WISE算法在处理大规模系统时的优势。每一步均基于理论推导和实验验证，确保结果的可靠性与可扩展性。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，该研究通过引入谱正则化方法，成功解决了多通道量子散射计算中闭合通道导致的发散问题，并实现了二次方标度的高效算法。这一机制可迁移至其他需要处理复杂多通道相互作用的问题，如化学反应动力学、天体化学等，但需确保交互势的perturbativeness在单位圆内。该方法通过矩阵-向量操作避免存储全矩阵，适用于大规模分子系统计算。
items.selection_reason: 该算法通过引入谱正则化技术，有效解决了量子耦合通道计算中闭合通道的收敛性问题，并实现了二次方标度。与传统方法相比，该方法在处理复杂分子系统时具有更高的可扩展性和稳定性。通过将多通道Lippmann-Schwinger积分方程的核分解为正则部分和发散部分，算法能够保证迭代级数的收敛性，同时避免了闭合通道对计算结果的影响。这种方法不仅提高了计算效率，还确保了在不同能量范围内的精确量子结果。实验表明，该方法在He+CO和CO+N2碰撞中实现了与精确耦合通道计算一致的结果，证明了其在复杂分子系统中的应用价值。
items.application_prospects: 本文提出了一种具有二次标度的量子耦合通道计算算法，能够有效解决复杂分子碰撞中的闭合通道问题。该方法通过谱正则化技术克服了传统迭代方法在收敛性和稳定性上的局限性，实现了对多通道系统的高效计算。其应用前景广泛，可应用于冷原子、分子物理、天体化学等领域的量子散射计算，尤其在处理大规模复杂系统时具有显著优势。实现条件要求具备高精度的势能面数据和稳定的数值方法，而约束主要来自计算资源和闭合通道的复杂性。
items.future_directions: 本文提出了一种基于谱正则化的二次标度算法，能够有效解决量子多通道计算中的闭合通道问题和迭代发散问题。未来可进一步研究该方法在更复杂分子系统中的应用，并探索其在超冷化学、天体化学等领域的扩展性。此外，需验证该算法在不同势能面下的鲁棒性和计算效率。

fields.en:
Quantum coupled channel (CC) calculations are important tools for parsing complex scattering phenomena in atomic, molecular, chemical, and nuclear physics. However, traditional gold standard CC methods are limited by the cubic cost of computation [O(N³)]. This paper proposes a general, rigorous, and robust method for solving the time-independent Schrödinger equation for single-channel scattering S matrix, with quadratic scaling [O(N²)]. The WISE algorithm, which is an iterative series expansion based on Weinberg regularization, addresses divergence issues in iterative techniques by applying regularization procedures to the kernel of the multi-channel Lippmann-Schwinger integral equation. The method also explicitly incorporates closure channel effects, including those leading to multi-channel Feshbach resonances. We demonstrate the power of this approach through rigorous calculations on He + CO and CO + N₂ collisions, achieving precise quantum results with quadratic scaling. Our results establish a highly scalable computational paradigm, making state-to-state quantum scattering calculations for complex molecular systems possible, and paving the way for large-scale numerical simulations in ultracold molecular physics, chemical reaction dynamics, and astrochemistry.

The key design of this method lies in ensuring the convergence of the iterative series through spectral regularization. In the theoretical part, we describe how the WISE framework overcomes two major challenges of traditional iterative methods: the strict inclusion of closed channels and the guaranteed convergence of the iterative series. By means of spectral regularization, the divergence problem of closed channels is effectively controlled, and the method retains the favorable scalability of matrix-vector operations. In the application part, we demonstrate the wide applicability of the WISE framework in quantum molecular collision dynamics, cold and ultra-cold chemistry, and astrochemistry. For example, in the cold collision of CO molecules with He atoms, the algorithm successfully replicates the accurate CC results.

The implementation of this method is divided into three stages: first, constructing the reference Green's function; second, determining regular and irregular solutions; and finally, computing the discrete kernel K through matrix-vector operations. The key lies in the fact that this algorithm does not require explicitly building or storing the complete matrices G, U off, or K, but rather computes these operations in real time. Additionally, through a matrix-free contour integral method, the algorithm maintains an O(N²) scalability for large-scale cases and is independent of the number of closed channels.

In summary, the method proposed in this paper provides an efficient and robust solution for quantum coupled-channel calculations, with broad application prospects and theoretical significance.

fields.en: The author proposes a hypothesis that addresses the convergence and closure issues in quantum coupling channels to gradually verify and exclude alternative explanations. First, by theoretical analysis of the time-independent Schrödinger equation, the multi-channel problem to be addressed is determined, and the limitations of traditional methods in closed channels and convergence are pointed out (p6, p16). Subsequently, the Weinberg regularized iterative series expansion (WISE) algorithm is proposed, which solves the divergence problem in closed channels and ensures convergence through spectral regularization (p25, p26). This method ensures the stability of the iterative series by analyzing the spectral radius of the LS kernel and the Weinberg eigenvalues (p34, p35). In terms of application, the effectiveness of the algorithm is validated through collision calculations of He+CO and CO+N₂, demonstrating its applicability to complex molecular systems (p47, p48). The review analysis compares the convergence and computational complexity of different methods, emphasizing the advantages of the WISE algorithm in handling large-scale systems. Each step is based on theoretical derivation and experimental verification, ensuring the reliability and scalability of the results.

paragraphs.en: The author proposes a hypothesis that addresses the convergence and closure issues in quantum coupling channels to gradually verify and exclude alternative explanations. First, by theoretical analysis of the time-independent Schrödinger equation, the multi-channel problem to be addressed is determined, and the limitations of traditional methods in closed channels and convergence are pointed out (p6, p16). Subsequently, the Weinberg regularized iterative series expansion (WISE) algorithm is proposed, which solves the divergence problem in closed channels and ensures convergence through spectral regularization (p25, p26). This method ensures the stability of the iterative series by analyzing the spectral radius of the LS kernel and the Weinberg eigenvalues (p34, p35). In terms of application, the effectiveness of the algorithm is validated through collision calculations of He+CO and CO+N₂, demonstrating its applicability to complex molecular systems (p47, p48). The review analysis compares the convergence and computational complexity of different methods, emphasizing the advantages of the WISE algorithm in handling large-scale systems. Each step is based on theoretical derivation and experimental verification, ensuring the reliability and scalability of the results.

fields.en: My conclusion is that this study successfully addressed the divergence problem caused by closed channels in multi-channel quantum scattering calculations by introducing a spectral regularization method, and achieved an efficient algorithm with quadratic scaling. This mechanism can be transferred to other problems requiring the treatment of complex multi-channel interactions, such as chemical reaction dynamics and astrochemistry, but it is necessary to ensure that the interaction potential is perturbative within the unit circle. The method avoids storing the full matrix by using matrix-vector operations, making it suitable for calculations involving large-scale molecular systems.
fields.zh: 我的归纳是，该研究通过引入谱正则化方法，成功解决了多通道量子散射计算中闭合通道导致的发散问题，并实现了二次方标度的高效算法。这一机制可迁移至其他需要处理复杂多通道相互作用的问题，如化学反应动力学、天体化学等，但需确保交互势的perturbativeness在单位圆内。该方法通过矩阵-向量操作避免存储全矩阵，适用于大规模分子系统计算。

fields.label_en: Why selected and what is innovative
fields.label_zh: 推荐理由与创新点（详细）
fields.en: The algorithm effectively addresses the convergence issue of closed channels in quantum coupled channel calculations by introducing spectral regularization, achieving quadratic scaling. Compared to traditional methods, this approach exhibits higher scalability and stability when handling complex molecular systems. By decomposing the kernel of the multi-channel Lippmann-Schwinger integral equation into regular and divergent parts, the algorithm ensures the convergence of iterative series while avoiding the influence of closed channels on computational results. This method not only improves computational efficiency but also ensures precise quantum results across different energy ranges. Experimental results show that this method achieves consistent results with exact coupled channel calculations in He+CO and CO+N2 collisions, demonstrating its application value in complex molecular systems.
fields.zh: 该算法通过引入谱正则化技术，有效解决了量子耦合通道计算中闭合通道的收敛性问题，并实现了二次方标度。与传统方法相比，该方法在处理复杂分子系统时具有更高的可扩展性和稳定性。通过将多通道Lippmann-Schwinger积分方程的核分解为正则部分和发散部分，算法能够保证迭代级数的收敛性，同时避免了闭合通道对计算结果的影响。这种方法不仅提高了计算效率，还确保了在不同能量范围内的精确量子结果。实验表明，该方法在He+CO和CO+N2碰撞中实现了与精确耦合通道计算一致的结果，证明了其在复杂分子系统中的应用价值。

fields.en: This paper proposes a quantum coupled channel calculation algorithm with quadratic scaling, which can effectively solve the closed channel problem in complex molecular collisions. The method overcomes the limitations of traditional iterative methods in convergence and stability through spectral regularization technology, achieving efficient computation for multi-channel systems. Its application prospects are broad, applicable to quantum scattering calculations in fields such as cold atom, molecular physics, and astrochemistry, particularly showing significant advantages in handling large-scale complex systems. The implementation requirements include high-precision potential energy surface data and stable numerical methods, while constraints mainly come from computational resources and the complexity of closed channels.
fields.zh: 本文提出了一种具有二次标度的量子耦合通道计算算法，能够有效解决复杂分子碰撞中的闭合通道问题。该方法通过谱正则化技术克服了传统迭代方法在收敛性和稳定性上的局限性，实现了对多通道系统的高效计算。其应用前景广泛，可应用于冷原子、分子物理、天体化学等领域的量子散射计算，尤其在处理大规模复杂系统时具有显著优势。实现条件要求具备高精度的势能面数据和稳定的数值方法，而约束主要来自计算资源和闭合通道的复杂性。

Future research could further explore the application of this method in more complex molecular systems and investigate its extensibility in fields such as ultracold chemistry and astrochemistry. Additionally, the robustness and computational efficiency of the algorithm need to be verified under different potential energy surfaces.

decisions.focus: The study investigates the role of MOF-5 in enhancing Li+ ion transport in polymer electrolytes through molecular dynamics and metadynamics simulations.

The study presents a comprehensive analysis of how MOF-5 influences ion transport in polymer electrolytes through classical and well-tempered metadynamics simulations. The findings reveal that MOF-5 significantly enhances Li+ ion mobility by creating favorable local environments, reducing ion-trapping effects, and lowering free-energy barriers for ion movement. These results provide critical insights into the molecular mechanisms underlying improved ion transport in hybrid MOF-polymer electrolytes, offering valuable guidance for designing advanced solid-state batteries.

classification_audit.abstract: Abstract The structural and dynamical properties of simulation systems consisting of metal organic frameworks (MOFs), particularly MOF-5, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide (LiTFSI) salt, and two well-known polymers, poly(vinylidene fluoride) (PVDF) and poly(ethylene oxide) (PEO), in different compositions were investigated using classical molecular dynamics (cMD) and well-tempered metadynamics (WT-MD) simulations. The cMD simulations revealed that the PEO-based hybrid electrolyte system containing LiTFSI salt and MOF-5 (System D) exhibits the highest diffusion coefficient for Li + ions and comparatively weaker interactions between Li + ions and the surrounding TFSI − anions than the other investigated systems. The enhanced ionic mobility is attributed to the favorable local environment generated by the incorporation of MOF-5, which facilitates efficient Li + ion transport while reducing ion-trapping effects, as evidenced by structural properties in terms of radial distribution functions, structure factors, spatial distribution functions, three-dimensional density distributions, ion pairing, and contact number analysis obtained from cMD. In addition, consistent with the structural properties, the dynamical and thermodynamic properties, evaluated through mean squared displacement and potential of mean force analysis, also indicate a high diffusion coefficient for Li + ions and favorable free-energy of Li + –PEO interactions in System D. Furthermore, WT-MD simulations demonstrated that System D possesses a relatively lower free-energy barrier for Li + ion mobility, indicating energetically favorable ion transport pathways. The combined findings from cMD and WT-MD simulations highlight the critical role of MOF-5 in regulating the dynamics and transport behavior of Li + ions. Therefore, this study provides valuable design guidelines for engineering hybrid MOF–polymer electrolytes with optimized ion transport properties for solid-state battery applications.

items.action:
研究论文探讨了金属有机框架-5（MOF-5）对聚乙烯氧化物（PEO）和聚偏二氟乙烯（PVDF）电解质中锂离子传输的增强作用，通过经典分子动力学（cMD）和温控元动力学（WT-MD）模拟分析其结构与动态特性。研究发现，在包含LiTFSI盐和MOF-5的PEO基混合电解质系统（System D）中，锂离子的扩散系数最高，且锂离子与周围TFSI⁻阴离子之间的相互作用较弱。这一现象归因于MOF-5的引入所形成的有利局部环境，有效促进了锂离子传输并减少了离子陷阱效应。通过cMD模拟获得的径向分布函数、结构因子、空间分布函数、三维密度分布、离子配对和接触数分析等结构性质，以及通过均方位移和平均势能分析得到的动力学与热力学性质，均表明System D中锂离子具有较高的扩散系数和有利的自由能。此外，WT-MD模拟进一步显示System D中锂离子迁移的自由能屏障较低，表明其能量上更有利于离子传输路径。综合cMD和WT-MD模拟结果，MOF-5在调节锂离子动态行为和传输特性方面发挥了关键作用。因此，该研究为设计具有优化离子传输性能的混合MOF-聚合物电解质提供了有价值的指导，以满足固态电池的应用需求。

论文中通过对比PEO和PVDF两种聚合物矩阵，探讨了MOF-5在不同聚合物基质中的离子传输能力。研究采用经典分子动力学模拟分析了MOF-5与PVDF、PEO聚合物及LiTFSI盐的结构与动态特性，并利用WT-MD模拟确定了锂离子迁移相关的自由能分布，提供了分子层面的能量因素描述。通过结合结构性质、动力学和热力学性质的综合分析，研究明确了MOF-5在不同聚合物系统中对锂离子传输的影响机制。

综述文献指出，MOF-5在增强固态电解质中锂离子传输方面具有潜在优势，但其分子作用机制尚不完全明确。本文通过cMD和WT-MD模拟揭示了MOF-5如何通过优化局部环境促进锂离子传输，并提供了分子层面的结构与动力学分析结果。研究结果表明，MOF-5的引入能够有效改善聚合物电解质中锂离子的扩散行为，为设计高性能固态电池电解质提供了理论依据和实践指导。

items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，本研究通过结合经典分子动力学（cMD）和温控元动力学（WT-MD）模拟，揭示了MOF-5在聚合物电解质中调控Li+离子传输的机制。MOF-5通过优化局部溶剂化环境，降低离子迁移能垒，从而提升Li+扩散系数和与PEO的相互作用自由能。这一设计原则可应用于其他离子传输受限的固态电池材料开发，但需注意聚合物基质性质对MOF-5效果的影响。

items.application_prospects: 本文通过cMD和WT-MD模拟研究了MOF-5在PEO和PVDF电解质中的作用，发现MOF-5显著提高了Li+离子的扩散系数和传输效率。实验表明，MOF-5优化了局部环境，减少了离子陷阱效应，从而改善了离子传输行为。该研究为设计高性能固态聚合物电解质提供了理论依据，适用于下一代锂离子电池应用。
items.future_directions: 未来研究可进一步探讨MOF-5在不同聚合物基质中的作用机制，特别是其对离子迁移路径和自由能屏障的影响。通过结合cMD与WT-MD模拟结果，可以设计更精确的计算方法来预测MOF-5对Li+传输的优化效果，并验证其在固态电池中的实际应用潜力。此外，可进一步研究MOF-5与其他金属有机框架材料的协同效应，以提升离子传导性能和电解质稳定性。

fields.en:
The research paper explores the enhancing effect of metal-organic framework-5 (MOF-5) on lithium ion transport in polyethylene oxide (PEO) and polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) electrolytes. The study analyzes the structural and dynamic properties of MOF-5 through classical molecular dynamics (cMD) and temperature-controlled molecular dynamics (WT-MD) simulations. The research findings show that in a PEO-based mixed electrolyte system (System D) containing LiTFSI salt and MOF-5, the diffusion coefficient of lithium ions is highest, and the interaction between lithium ions and surrounding TFSI⁻ anions is relatively weak. This phenomenon is attributed to the favorable local environment formed by the introduction of MOF-5, which effectively promotes lithium ion transport and reduces the ion trapping effect. Structural properties obtained from cMD simulations include radial distribution functions, structure factors, spatial distribution functions, three-dimensional density distributions, ion pairing, and contact numbers. Dynamic and thermodynamic properties derived from mean square displacement and average potential energy analysis also indicate that lithium ions in System D have a high diffusion coefficient and favorable free energy. Furthermore, WT-MD simulations further show that the free energy barrier for lithium ion migration in System D is low, indicating that it is more energetically favorable for the ion transport pathway. Combining cMD and WT-MD simulation results, MOF-5 plays a key role in regulating the dynamic behavior and transport characteristics of lithium ions. Therefore, this study provides valuable guidance for designing mixed MOF-polymer electrolytes with optimized ion transport performance to meet the application requirements of solid-state batteries.

The paper compares PEO and PVDF as polymer matrices to explore the ion transport capability of MOF-5 in different polymer matrices. The study employs classical molecular dynamics simulations to analyze the structure and dynamic properties of MOF-5 with PVDF, PEO polymers, and LiTFSI salt, and uses WT-MD simulations to determine the free energy distribution related to lithium ion migration, providing a molecular-level description of energy factors. By integrating structural properties, kinetic, and thermodynamic properties, the study clarifies the mechanism by which MOF-5 affects lithium ion transport in different polymer systems.

Review literature indicates that MOF-5 has potential advantages in enhancing lithium ion transport in solid electrolytes, but its molecular interaction mechanism is still not fully elucidated. This paper reveals how MOF-5 promotes lithium ion transport by optimizing the local environment through cMD and WT-MD simulations, and provides structural and dynamic analysis results at the molecular level. The study shows that the introduction of MOF-5 can effectively improve the diffusion behavior of lithium ions in polymer electrolytes, providing theoretical basis and practical guidance for designing high-performance solid-state battery electrolytes.

paragraphs.en: The author systematically studied the effect of MOF-5 on Li+ transport in PEO and PVDF-based electrolytes through cMD and WT-MD simulations. First, the cMD simulation revealed that System D with MOF-5 doping has the highest Li+ diffusion coefficient and weaker Li+ interaction with TFSI−, indicating that MOF-5 optimizes the local environment to promote Li+ transport and reduce ion trapping effects. Subsequently, the WT-MD simulation further confirmed that the energy barrier for Li+ migration in System D is lower, suggesting favorable energy pathways for transmission. These results were supported by structural and dynamic property analyses (such as radial distribution functions, spatial distribution functions, etc.). The review analysis revealed the key role of MOF-5 in regulating the dynamics and transport behavior of electrolytes by comparing the effects of different polymer matrices on MOF-5 ion transport capability. Each step was validated based on simulation data to ensure the reliability of the conclusions.

fields.en: My conclusion is that this study reveals the mechanism by which MOF-5 regulates Li+ ion transport in polymer electrolytes through the combination of classical molecular dynamics (cMD) and temperature-controlled ensemble dynamics (WT-MD) simulations. MOF-5 optimizes the local solvation environment to reduce the ion migration energy barrier, thereby enhancing the diffusion coefficient of Li+ and the interaction free energy with PEO. This design principle can be applied to the development of other solid-state battery materials with restricted ion transport, but attention should be paid to the effect of polymer matrix properties on the effectiveness of MOF-5.
fields.zh: 我的归纳是，本研究通过结合经典分子动力学（cMD）和温控元动力学（WT-MD）模拟，揭示了MOF-5在聚合物电解质中调控Li+离子传输的机制。MOF-5通过优化局部溶剂化环境，降低离子迁移能垒，从而提升Li+扩散系数和与PEO的相互作用自由能。这一设计原则可应用于其他离子传输受限的固态电池材料开发，但需注意聚合物基质性质对MOF-5效果的影响。

fields.label_zh: 推荐理由与创新点（详细）
fields.en: This study systematically analyzed the effect of MOF-5 on the transport of Li+ ions in polymer electrolytes based on polyethylene oxide (PEO) and polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) through classical molecular dynamics (cMD) and temperature-controlled Monte Carlo dynamics (WT-MD) simulations. The results showed that the introduction of MOF-5 significantly increased the diffusion coefficient of Li+ ions and reduced the ion trap effect in PEO-based electrolyte systems, which is mainly attributed to the favorable local environment generated by MOF-5. Through structural and dynamic analyses, such as radial distribution functions and spatial distribution functions, it was confirmed that MOF-5 has a positive impact on the free energy of interaction between Li+ and PEO. Furthermore, WT-MD simulations further demonstrated that MOF-5 lowers the free energy barrier for Li+ ion migration, providing an energetically favorable pathway for ion transport. These findings highlight the key role of MOF-5 in regulating the dynamic and transport behavior of polymer electrolytes, providing a theoretical basis for designing hybrid MOF-polymer electrolytes with optimized ion transport performance. The results are consistent with experimental data and have been verified through structural and dynamic analyses to confirm the promoting effect of MOF-5 on Li+ transport.

fields.en: This study investigates the role of MOF-5 in PEO and PVDF electrolytes through cMD and WT-MD simulations, revealing that MOF-5 significantly enhances the diffusion coefficient and transmission efficiency of Li+ ions. Experimental results show that MOF-5 optimizes the local environment, reduces the ion trap effect, thereby improving ion transport behavior. This research provides theoretical insights for designing high-performance solid polymer electrolytes, applicable to next-generation lithium-ion battery applications.
fields.zh: 本文通过cMD和WT-MD模拟研究了MOF-5在PEO和PVDF电解质中的作用，发现MOF-5显著提高了Li+离子的扩散系数和传输效率。实验表明，MOF-5优化了局部环境，减少了离子陷阱效应，从而改善了离子传输行为。该研究为设计高性能固态聚合物电解质提供了理论依据，适用于下一代锂离子电池应用。

fields.en: Future research could further explore the mechanism of MOF-5 in different polymer matrices, particularly its effects on ion migration pathways and free energy barriers. By combining cMD with WT-MD simulation results, more accurate computational methods can be designed to predict the optimized performance of MOF-5 for Li+ transport and verify its potential application in solid-state batteries. Additionally, further research could investigate the synergistic effects of MOF-5 with other metal-organic framework materials to enhance ion conductivity and electrolyte stability.
fields.zh: 未来研究可进一步探讨MOF-5在不同聚合物基质中的作用机制，特别是其对离子迁移路径和自由能屏障的影响。通过结合cMD与WT-MD模拟结果，可以设计更精确的计算方法来预测MOF-5对Li+传输的优化效果，并验证其在固态电池中的实际应用潜力。此外，可进一步研究MOF-5与其他金属有机框架材料的协同效应，以提升离子传导性能和电解质稳定性。

decisions.focus: Simplification of dosimetry workflows in radiopharmaceutical therapy

This review presents a critical analysis of current challenges in dosimetry for radiopharmaceutical therapy (RPT) and introduces simplification techniques to make dosimetry more practical. The article highlights the limitations of traditional dosimetry workflows, such as the need for multiple time-point imaging and complex computational modeling, which hinder their use in clinical settings. It proposes a theoretical framework that classifies simplification methods into three categories: data acquisition reduction, computational automation via AI, and advanced modeling strategies. The review emphasizes the importance of developing efficient and validated approaches to enable widespread adoption of personalized dosimetry in RPT.

classification_audit.abstract: Abstract Radiopharmaceutical therapy (RPT) plays an important role in modern precision oncology. However, treatment activity is still prescribed by fixed-dose protocols rather than adjusted to planned patient-specific absorbed dose (AD). Individualized dosimetry holds promise for improving treatment planning but is not yet standard. One main reason is that present dosimetry workflows depend on repeated imaging at multiple time points and require kinetic modeling and computational modeling. This review covers recent approaches to make dosimetry more practical and easier to use in everyday RPT workflows. We introduce a theoretical framework in which simplification methods, which help ease the clinical burden of dosimetry, are classified into three related categories. The first two categories simplify the process through direct reduction in the burdens of either the acquisition or processing of data: (1) Methodological simplifications through reduction in the imaging burden, such as reduced- or single-time point (STP) imaging; and (2) Computational automation via artificial intelligence (AI) to automate dosimetry, including image processing, segmentation, registration, and AD estimation. Advanced modeling strategies in the third category improve efficiency through inference, thereby enabling estimation of AD from sparsely sampled data. Reduced imaging played a major role in defining these areas. While all of these have their promise, every category of methods has certain drawbacks. STP techniques are less reliable for heterogeneous tumors, black box models have poor transferability and explainability, and digital twin/physiologically-based pharmacokinetic (DT/PBPK) models lack clinical validation. Fundamental dosimetry, with appropriate validity conditions, could allow for reduced reliance on imaging skills and expertise while still retaining sufficient precision for its intended purposes. Standardization of imaging and multicenter analysis is essential for wider adoption of RPTs. A detailed description of models and their effectiveness would be helpful in the clinical application of dosimetry. Keywords: radiopharmaceutical therapy (RPT), theranostics/radiotheranostics, patient-specific dosimetry, single-time-point imaging, digital twins (DTs), physiologically-based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) models, nonlinear mixed-effect (NLME) modeling

放射性药物治疗计划的实践化是精准医学的重要组成部分，但目前仍依赖于固定剂量协议而非根据患者特定吸收剂量（AD）进行调整。个体化剂量学具有潜力，但尚未成为标准。主要原因是当前剂量学流程依赖多次时间点的影像采集和动力学建模与计算建模。本文综述了近期使剂量学更实用、便于日常RPT工作流程的方法。我们提出一个理论框架，将简化方法分为三类：（1）通过减少数据获取或处理负担进行方法简化；（2）利用人工智能自动化剂量学计算；（3）通过推理提高效率，从而从稀疏采样数据中估计AD。减少影像采集在定义这些领域中发挥了重要作用。尽管所有方法都有其潜力，但每种方法都存在一定的缺点。STP技术对异质性肿瘤的可靠性较低，黑箱模型具有较差的可迁移性和可解释性，而数字孪生/生理学基于药代动力学（DT/PBPK）模型缺乏临床验证。基础剂量学在适当的有效条件下可以减少对影像技能和专业知识的依赖，同时仍保持足够的精度用于其目的。影像标准化和多中心分析对于更广泛地采用RPTs至关重要。对模型及其有效性的详细描述将有助于剂量学的临床应用。

本文讨论了传统内部剂量学工作流程中的挑战与局限性。RPT使决策基于活动剂量输送成为可能，因为它考虑了患者间的差异以及患者内的差异，旨在优化肿瘤的剂量输送并最小化对OARs的影响。然而，常规治疗框架中存在许多临床和技术挑战，阻碍其常规实施。基于剂量学的个性化治疗可以分为五个关键阶段，每个阶段都有自己的局限性，因此引入了第4节描述的简化方法。这些阶段包括数据获取、配准和分割、AD转换建模、整合以及最终的AD计算。

本文还讨论了减少影像时间点的方法。MTP成像由于其复杂性和高工作量，已成为RPT中使用剂量学的一个障碍。如图4A所示，需要在4、24、48和72小时等时间点进行采集以获得TAC拟合和TIACs，这会影响患者的依从性和成本。

items.research_logic: 作者提出假说，即通过简化流程来提高放射性药物治疗计划的实用性。首先，通过减少影像采集负担（如单时间点成像）和计算自动化（如AI辅助剂量估算），降低临床工作量；其次，利用先进建模策略（如推理方法）提升效率，从稀疏数据中估计吸收剂量。这些步骤需区分实验、理论与综述引用，并排除替代解释。例如，STP技术在异质肿瘤中可靠性差，黑盒模型转移性差，DT/PBPK模型缺乏临床验证。综述分析通过组织和比较证据，如表3所示，评估简化方法的准确性、临床挑战、精度等。每一步均需验证其必要性，确保剂量估算的精确性和实用性。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，本文提出了一种将简化方法分类为三类的理论框架，旨在降低放射性药物治疗中剂量学工作的临床负担。其中，第一类通过减少数据采集或处理的负担实现简化，第二类利用AI自动化剂量计算，第三类通过先进建模策略提高效率。该框架可应用于其他需要精准剂量估算的医疗场景，但需注意其适用边界，如肿瘤异质性、模型可解释性和临床验证不足等问题。
items.selection_reason: 本文综述了放射性药物治疗计划中剂量简化技术的实践应用，强调了通过减少数据采集负担和自动化计算来优化剂量学流程的重要性。文中指出，传统剂量学方法依赖多次影像采集和复杂建模，导致工作量大且难以在日常诊疗中广泛应用。为解决这些问题，文章提出了一系列简化策略，包括减少SPECT扫描时间、降低时间点数量、利用人工智能实现自动化处理以及采用数字孪生/药理动力学模型等。这些方法通过减少影像采集负担和优化计算流程，在保证精度的前提下提高了剂量学工作的可操作性。尽管存在一定的局限性，如单时间点技术在异质肿瘤中的可靠性不足，但整体上这些简化策略为实现个性化剂量学提供了可行路径。
items.application_prospects: 本文探讨了放射性药物治疗中剂量简化技术的应用前景、实现条件及约束。通过减少影像采集时间点和使用深度学习等方法，可有效降低剂量计算的复杂度。然而，单时间点成像在异质肿瘤中可靠性较低，黑盒模型存在迁移性和解释性问题，数字孪生/药代动力学模型缺乏临床验证。因此，需在保证精度的前提下，优化影像标准化和多中心分析以推动放射性药物治疗的广泛应用。
items.future_directions: 本文探讨了放射性药物治疗计划中剂量简化技术的实践应用，指出传统方法依赖多次影像采集和复杂建模，导致效率低下。未来研究可聚焦于开发更高效的自动化算法，如结合深度学习与AI进行剂量计算，以减少对高精度影像的需求。同时，需验证数字孪生/生理学模型在临床中的适用性，并探索多中心数据整合以提升标准化水平。这些方向有助于实现个性化剂量计算的实用化和普及化。

fields.en:
The practical implementation of radiopharmaceutical treatment plans is an important component of precision medicine, but currently still relies on fixed dose protocols rather than adjusting based on the patient-specific absorbed dose (AD). Individualized dosimetry holds potential but has not become standard. The main reason is that current dosimetric workflows depend on multiple time-point imaging acquisitions and kinetic modeling with computational modeling. This paper reviews recent methods that make dosimetry more practical and convenient for daily RPT workflow. We propose a theoretical framework that classifies simplified approaches into three categories: (1) method simplification by reducing data acquisition or processing burden; (2) using artificial intelligence to automate dosimetric calculations; (3) improving efficiency through reasoning, thereby estimating AD from sparse sampling data. Reducing imaging acquisitions has played an important role in defining these areas. Although all methods have potential, each method has certain drawbacks. STP technology has lower reliability for heterogeneous tumors, black-box models have poorer transferability and interpretability, and digital twin/physiological based pharmacokinetic (DT/PBPK) models lack clinical validation. Basic dosimetry can reduce reliance on imaging skills and expertise under appropriate effective conditions while maintaining sufficient accuracy for its purpose. Imaging standardization and multi-center analysis are crucial for the broader adoption of RPTs. Detailed descriptions of the model and its validity will help in the clinical application of dosimetry.

This paper discusses the challenges and limitations in traditional internal dosimetry workflows. RPT makes decision-based activity dose delivery possible, as it considers inter-patient and intra-patient variations, aiming to optimize tumor dose delivery and minimize the impact on OARs. However, there are many clinical and technical challenges in the conventional treatment framework that hinder its routine implementation. Dosage-based personalized treatment can be divided into five key stages, each with its own limitations, thus introducing the simplified approach described in Section 4. These stages include data acquisition, registration and segmentation, AD conversion modeling, integration, and finally the AD calculation.

This paper also discusses methods to reduce the number of imaging time points. MTP imaging has become a barrier to dosimetry in RPT due to its complexity and workload. As shown in Figure 4A, data acquisition is required at time points such as 4, 24, 48, and 72 hours to obtain TAC fitting and TIACs, which affects patient compliance and costs.

This paper also discusses approximate methods based on baseline analysis (such as the Hänscheid method). The Hänscheid technique is an STP technique that calculates AD through abdominal activity measurements, thereby reducing patient burden and procedural complexity. fields.en: The author proposes a hypothesis that simplifying the process can enhance the practicality of radiopharmaceutical treatment plans. First, by reducing the burden of image acquisition (such as single-time-point imaging) and computational automation (such as AI-assisted dose estimation), clinical workload is reduced; second, by utilizing advanced modeling strategies (such as reasoning methods) to improve efficiency, absorption doses can be estimated from sparse data. These steps require distinguishing between experimental, theoretical, and review citations, and excluding alternative explanations. For example, STP technology has poor reliability in heterogeneous tumors, black-box models have poor transferability, and DT/PBPK models lack clinical validation. Review analysis evaluates the accuracy, clinical challenges, precision, etc., of simplified methods, as shown in Table 3. First, by reducing the burden of image acquisition (such as single-time-point imaging) and computational automation (such as AI-assisted dose estimation), clinical workload is reduced; second, by utilizing advanced modeling strategies (such as reasoning methods) to improve efficiency, absorption doses can be estimated from sparse data. These steps require distinguishing between experimental, theoretical, and review citations, and excluding alternative explanations. For example, STP technology has poor reliability in heterogeneous tumors, black-box models have poor transferability, and DT/PBPK models lack clinical validation. Review analysis evaluates the accuracy, clinical challenges, precision, etc., of simplified methods, as shown in Table 3. Each step must be verified for its necessity to ensure the accuracy and practicality of dose estimation.

fields.en: My conclusion is that this paper proposes a theoretical framework for classifying simplified methods into three categories, aimed at reducing the clinical burden of dosimetry work in radiopharmaceutical therapy. The first category achieves simplification by reducing the burden of data acquisition or processing, the second category utilizes AI to automate dose calculation, and the third category improves efficiency through advanced modeling strategies. This framework can be applied to other medical scenarios requiring precise dose estimation, but it is important to note its limitations, such as tumor heterogeneity, model interpretability, and insufficient clinical validation.
fields.zh: 我的归纳是，本文提出了一种将简化方法分类为三类的理论框架，旨在降低放射性药物治疗中剂量学工作的临床负担。其中，第一类通过减少数据采集或处理的负担实现简化，第二类利用AI自动化剂量计算，第三类通过先进建模策略提高效率。该框架可应用于其他需要精准剂量估算的医疗场景，但需注意其适用边界，如肿瘤异质性、模型可解释性和临床验证不足等问题。

fields.en: This paper reviews the practical application of dose simplification techniques in radiopharmaceutical treatment plans, emphasizing the importance of optimizing the dosimetry process by reducing the burden of data acquisition and automating calculations. The text points out that traditional dosimetry methods rely on multiple imaging acquisitions and complex modeling, leading to a large workload and difficulty in widespread application in routine clinical practice. To address these issues, the article proposes a series of simplification strategies, including reducing the duration of SPECT scans, decreasing the number of time points, utilizing artificial intelligence for automated processing, and adopting digital twin/pharmacokinetic models. These methods reduce the burden of imaging data acquisition and optimize computational processes, enhancing the operability of dosimetry while maintaining accuracy. Although there are certain limitations, such as the reliability of single-time-point techniques in heterogeneous tumors, overall these simplification strategies provide a feasible path for achieving personalized dosimetry.
fields.zh: 本文综述了放射性药物治疗计划中剂量简化技术的实践应用，强调了通过减少数据采集负担和自动化计算来优化剂量学流程的重要性。文中指出，传统剂量学方法依赖多次影像采集和复杂建模，导致工作量大且难以在日常诊疗中广泛应用。为解决这些问题，文章提出了一系列简化策略，包括减少SPECT扫描时间、降低时间点数量、利用人工智能实现自动化处理以及采用数字孪生/药理动力学模型等。这些方法通过减少影像采集负担和优化计算流程，在保证精度的前提下提高了剂量学工作的可操作性。尽管存在一定的局限性，如单时间点技术在异质肿瘤中的可靠性不足，但整体上这些简化策略为实现个性化剂量学提供了可行路径。

fields.en: This paper explores the prospects, implementation conditions, and constraints of dose simplification techniques in radiopharmaceutical therapy. By reducing the number of imaging time points and using methods such as deep learning, the complexity of dose calculation can be effectively reduced. However, single-time-point imaging has lower reliability in heterogeneous tumors, black-box models have issues with transferability and interpretability, and digital twin/pharmacokinetic models lack clinical validation. Therefore, it is necessary to optimize image standardization and multi-center analysis while ensuring accuracy to promote the widespread application of radiopharmaceutical therapy.
fields.zh: 本文探讨了放射性药物治疗中剂量简化技术的应用前景、实现条件及约束。通过减少影像采集时间点和使用深度学习等方法，可有效降低剂量计算的复杂度。然而，单时间点成像在异质肿瘤中可靠性较低，黑盒模型存在迁移性和解释性问题，数字孪生/药代动力学模型缺乏临床验证。因此，需在保证精度的前提下，优化影像标准化和多中心分析以推动放射性药物治疗的广泛应用。

fields.en: This paper explores the practical application of dose simplification techniques in radiotherapy treatment plans, pointing out that traditional methods rely on multiple image acquisitions and complex modeling, leading to inefficiency. Future research can focus on developing more efficient automated algorithms, such as combining deep learning with AI for dose calculation, to reduce the need for high-precision imaging. At the same time, it is necessary to verify the applicability of digital twin/physiological models in clinical settings and explore multi-center data integration to enhance standardization. These directions will help achieve the practicality and widespread adoption of personalized dose calculations.
fields.zh: 本文探讨了放射性药物治疗计划中剂量简化技术的实践应用，指出传统方法依赖多次影像采集和复杂建模，导致效率低下。未来研究可聚焦于开发更高效的自动化算法，如结合深度学习与AI进行剂量计算，以减少对高精度影像的需求。同时，需验证数字孪生/生理学模型在临床中的适用性，并探索多中心数据整合以提升标准化水平。这些方向有助于实现个性化剂量计算的实用化和普及化。

decisions.focus: Human breath as a carbon dioxide source for organic synthesis

The study presents a novel approach to utilizing human breath as a CO2 source for organic synthesis, demonstrating the efficient preparation of urea compounds under solvent-free conditions. The research provides direct evidence for CO2 capture from human breath by primary amines and shows the utility of these urea compounds as co-catalysts in CO2 fixation reactions with epoxides. This work represents a significant contribution to chemical biology and sustainable organic synthesis, offering practical applications for carbon utilization in space and other resource-limited environments.

classification_audit.abstract: The capture and utilization of low-concentration CO 2 as a C1 feedstock for organic synthesis have emerged as important research areas. Although atmospheric CO 2 is an ideal carbon source for sustainable organic transformations, its extremely low concentration (0.04%) presents a significant challenge to the development of efficient CO 2 conversion processes. In this context, we turned our attention to human breath as an alternative CO 2 source, which contains approximately 4% CO 2 . The capture and utilization of CO 2 from human breath is also expected to play an important role in sustaining life in space, where readily available carbon sources are scarce and exhaled CO 2 represents a valuable renewable carbon resource for life-support systems. Herein, we demonstrate that human breath can serve as a practical and readily available CO 2 source for the efficient synthesis of urea compounds. Furthermore, the prepared urea compounds proved to be effective co-catalysts for the CO 2 fixation with epoxides under pure CO 2 .

人类呼吸作为有机合成的二氧化碳来源的研究表明，利用人体呼出的二氧化碳进行有机合成具有实际应用价值。该研究通过高效制备尿素化合物，证明了人体呼吸可以作为一种便捷且可获得的二氧化碳源用于有机合成。在实验中，使用人体呼吸作为二氧化碳来源，在无溶剂条件下成功合成了多种尿素化合物，并验证了其作为共催化剂在二氧化碳与环氧乙烷反应中的作用。研究还发现，当使用四丁基碘化铵和尿素化合物作为双催化体系时，能够高效促进二氧化碳与环氧乙烷的固定反应，生成高产率的环状碳酸酯。此外，该方法在常压下无需使用高压釜即可实现无溶剂条件下的二氧化碳固定，降低了能耗。研究还指出，尽管人体呼吸中的水分含量较低，但尿素化合物合成过程对水分的影响不大。然而，该方法在胺类底物的应用范围上仍存在一定的局限性。综上所述，利用人体呼吸作为二氧化碳来源进行有机合成不仅具有环境友好性，而且在航天等特殊环境中也具有重要的应用前景。

研究中通过NMR分析提供了直接证据，证明了尿素化合物的形成与人体呼吸中的二氧化碳捕获有关。实验表明，在无溶剂条件下，使用人体呼吸作为二氧化碳源可以高效合成多种尿素化合物，并且这些尿素化合物在作为共催化剂时能够显著促进二氧化碳与环氧乙烷的反应。此外，研究还发现，当使用四丁基碘化铵和尿素化合物作为双催化体系时，能够有效提高反应效率，生成高产率的环状碳酸酯。该方法不仅适用于有机合成，而且在航天等特殊环境中也具有重要的应用价值。

综上所述，本研究成功证明了人体呼吸可以作为一种实用的二氧化碳来源用于有机合成，并且通过高效制备尿素化合物，验证了其作为共催化剂在二氧化碳与环氧乙烷反应中的作用。该方法不仅具有环境友好性，而且在航天等特殊环境中也具有重要的应用前景。

items.selection_reason: 本研究通过利用人体呼吸作为二氧化碳来源，成功实现了有机合成中的高效尿素化合物制备，并展示了其在CO₂固定反应中的应用。人体呼吸中CO₂浓度约为4%，显著高于空气中的0.04%，为有机合成提供了便捷的碳源。实验表明，在无溶剂条件下，通过人体呼吸可高效生成尿素化合物，且该方法具有良好的重复性和稳定性。此外，所制备的尿素化合物作为共催化剂，能有效促进CO₂与环氧物的固定反应，提高产物收率。本研究不仅展示了人体呼吸作为碳源的可行性，也为可持续化学提供了新思路。

items.future_directions: 本文研究了人体呼吸作为尿素合成的二氧化碳来源，并展示了其在有机合成中的实用性。通过人体呼吸获取的二氧化碳可高效合成尿素化合物，且这些尿素化合物能作为共催化剂促进二氧化碳与环氧乙烷的固定反应。未来可进一步探索人体呼吸作为C1源在制备有价值有机化合物中的应用，例如开发更高效的催化体系或优化反应条件以提高产率和选择性。

fields.en:
Studies on human respiration as a source of carbon dioxide for organic synthesis indicate that using carbon dioxide exhaled by humans for organic synthesis has practical application value. This research demonstrates that human respiration can serve as a convenient and accessible source of carbon dioxide for organic synthesis through the efficient preparation of urea compounds. In the experiments, using human respiration as a carbon dioxide source, multiple urea compounds were successfully synthesized under solvent-free conditions, and their role as co-catalysts in the reaction of carbon dioxide with ethylene oxide was verified. The study also found that when tetramethylammonium iodide and urea compounds are used as a dual catalytic system, they can efficiently promote the fixation reaction of carbon dioxide with ethylene oxide, generating high-yield cyclic carbonates. Furthermore, this method achieves carbon dioxide fixation under atmospheric pressure without the need for a high-pressure reactor, reducing energy consumption. The study also points out that although the water content in human respiration is low, the synthesis process of urea compounds is not significantly affected by water. However, there are still certain limitations in the application range of this method for amine substrates. In conclusion, using human respiration as a source of carbon dioxide for organic synthesis not only has environmental friendliness but also has important application prospects in special environments such as space.

The study provided direct evidence through NMR analysis, proving that the formation of urea compounds is related to the capture of carbon dioxide in human respiration. The experiments showed that under solvent-free conditions, using human respiration as a carbon dioxide source can efficiently synthesize various urea compounds, and these urea compounds can significantly promote the reaction between carbon dioxide and ethylene oxide when acting as co-catalysts. Furthermore, the study found that using tetramethylammonium iodide and urea compounds as a dual catalytic system can effectively enhance reaction efficiency, producing high-yield cyclic carbonates. This method is not only applicable to organic synthesis but also has important application value in special environments such as space travel.

In summary, this study successfully demonstrated that human respiration can serve as a practical source of carbon dioxide for organic synthesis, and verified the role of urea compounds as co-catalysts in the reaction of carbon dioxide with ethylene oxide. The method not only exhibits environmental friendliness but also holds significant application prospects in special environments such as space.

fields.en: The author verified the feasibility of human respiration as a source of CO₂ through experiments. First, it was proven that CO₂ from human respiration could be captured and converted into organic compounds by amino groups through the synthesis of dodecylurea (2a) (p3, p5, p7). Subsequently, NMR analysis confirmed that CO₂ reacted with amino groups to form adducts (p6, p7, p8), further verifying the capture process of CO₂. Then, using the synthesized urea-like compounds as co-catalysts, the fixation reaction of ethylene oxide with CO₂ was promoted under pure CO₂ conditions (p10, p11). By comparing the reaction efficiency under different conditions, it was proven that human respiration has advantages as a source of CO₂. In the review analysis, the author systematically compared the capture efficiency and application prospects of different CO₂ sources, emphasizing the potential value of human respiration in space life support (p2, p9, p12). Each experimental step was verified through repeatability tests and control group validation to ensure the reliability of the results; at the same time, the influence of interfering factors such as water vapor was excluded.

fields.en: My conclusion is that using human respiration as a source of carbon dioxide for organic synthesis is feasible, and the method can efficiently achieve this under solvent-free conditions. Experiments show that carbon dioxide captured from human respiration can react with primary amines to form urea-like compounds, and these can act as co-catalysts to promote the fixation reaction of carbon dioxide with ethylene oxide. fields.en: This study successfully achieved efficient preparation of organic compounds through the utilization of human respiration as a carbon dioxide source, and demonstrated its application in CO₂ fixation reactions. The concentration of CO₂ in human respiration is approximately 4%, significantly higher than that in air (0.04%), providing a convenient carbon source for organic synthesis. Experimental results showed that urea compounds could be efficiently synthesized under solvent-free conditions using human respiration, and the method exhibited good repeatability and stability. Furthermore, the prepared urea compounds, as co-catalysts, effectively promote the fixation reaction of CO₂ with epoxides, increasing the yield of the product. This study not only demonstrated the feasibility of using human respiration as a carbon source but also provided new insights for sustainable chemistry.
fields.zh: 本研究通过利用人体呼吸作为二氧化碳来源，成功实现了有机合成中的高效尿素化合物制备，并展示了其在CO₂固定反应中的应用。人体呼吸中CO₂浓度约为4%，显著高于空气中的0.04%，为有机合成提供了便捷的碳源。实验表明，在无溶剂条件下，通过人体呼吸可高效生成尿素化合物，且该方法具有良好的重复性和稳定性。此外，所制备的尿素化合物作为共催化剂，能有效促进CO₂与环氧物的固定反应，提高产物收率。本研究不仅展示了人体呼吸作为碳源的可行性，也为可持续化学提供了新思路。

fields.en: This paper demonstrates the potential application of human respiration as a source of carbon dioxide in organic synthesis. By efficiently preparing urea compounds, it is proven that human respiration can serve as a practical CO₂ source for organic synthesis. The method is achieved under solvent-free conditions and is insensitive to water vapor. Urea compounds can also act as co-catalysts to promote the fixation reaction of CO₂ with ethylene oxide, effectively enhancing reaction efficiency in pure CO₂ environments. However, this method has certain limitations with amine substrates.
fields.zh: 本文展示了人类呼吸作为二氧化碳来源在有机合成中的应用前景。通过高效制备尿素化合物，证明了人类呼吸可作为实用的CO₂源进行有机合成。该方法在无溶剂条件下实现，且对水蒸气不敏感。尿素化合物还可作为共催化剂促进CO₂与环氧乙烷的固定反应，在纯CO₂环境中有效提升反应效率。然而，该方法对胺类底物存在一定限制。

fields.en: This study investigates human respiration as a source of carbon dioxide for the synthesis of urea and demonstrates its practicality in organic synthesis. Carbon dioxide obtained from human respiration can efficiently synthesize urea compounds, which can act as co-catalysts to promote the fixation reaction of carbon dioxide with ethylene oxide. Future research could further explore the application of human respiration as a C1 source in the preparation of valuable organic compounds, such as developing more efficient catalytic systems or optimizing reaction conditions to improve yield and selectivity.
fields.zh: 本文研究了人体呼吸作为尿素合成的二氧化碳来源，并展示了其在有机合成中的实用性。通过人体呼吸获取的二氧化碳可高效合成尿素化合物，且这些尿素化合物能作为共催化剂促进二氧化碳与环氧乙烷的固定反应。未来可进一步探索人体呼吸作为C1源在制备有价值有机化合物中的应用，例如开发更高效的催化体系或优化反应条件以提高产率和选择性。

decisions.focus: Polymer fibrous aerogels for thermal insulation: from molecular building blocks to structural reliability

This review provides a comprehensive analysis of polymer fibrous aerogels for thermal insulation, emphasizing the importance of structural reliability and service performance over pristine material properties. It critically evaluates how molecular design, fiber formation, three-dimensional assembly, interfiber stabilization, and drying influence heat transfer pathways, particularly under real-world conditions like deformation, humidity, and fire exposure. The review highlights the need for a processing–structure–transport–retention framework to translate laboratory specimens into reproducible insulation systems with verifiable service reliability.

These forms perform different structural functions. Nanofibrils generate numerous contact points and form continuous skeletons at low solid contents, whereas microfilaments and short fibers span larger pores and distribute stress over longer distances. However, these molecular advantages contribute to insulation only when they are translated into an appropriate fibrous architecture.
